Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le programme RiSE (Roche Stages for Scientific Exchange) est un programme de recherche étudiant hautement compétitif à Roche. Il offre aux étudiants diplômés et aux étudiants en médecine les plus talentueux la possibilité d'être pleinement intégrés dans notre environnement de R-D interdisciplinaire et international. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE, vous améliorerez vos compétences, gagnerez une expérience de travail précieuse avec nous et finirez par faire partie d'un réseau mondial d'anciens RiSE. La zone de découverte et de traduction des neurosciences et des maladies rares (DNT) met au point des médicaments pour diverses maladies neurologiques graves, dont la sclérose en plaques, la maladie d'Alzheimer, la maladie de Parkinson, l'autisme, l'atrophie musculaire de la colonne vertébrale et la maladie de Huntington. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE au NRD DTA, vous rejoindrez le groupe Brain Delivery au Roche Innovation Center Basel, en Suisse, pour effectuer des analyses de données omiques et des travaux expérimentaux in vitro pour cartographier le paysage réglementaire des cibles de la maladie d'Alzheimer. Vous serez accueilli et encadré par un scientifique de Roche qui vous guidera dans vos recherches et vous fournira l'infrastructure de travail et le réseau de collaboration nécessaires. L'opportunité
• Collaborer étroitement avec les chercheurs en calcul pour analyser les ensembles de données séquentielles afin de générer des données biologiques.
• Concevoir des expériences in vitro rigoureuses en fonction de votre expertise en interprétation des données transcriptomiques.
• Appliquer un ensemble complet de méthodes de biologie cellulaire moléculaire dans des modèles dérivés de cellules souches pour tester des hypothèses biologiques spécifiques
• Présentez et discutez de votre travail lors de réunions internes.
• Synthétiser les données expérimentales pour la préparation et la soumission de manuscrits à fort impact pour publication par des pairs. Qui vous êtes
• Vous avez obtenu votre diplôme de maîtrise au cours de la dernière année
• Ou vous êtes inscrit à un programme de doctorat ou de diplôme médical dans une université
• Vous cherchez à développer votre expérience avec un stage dans l'industrie
• Expérience approfondie dans la production et l'analyse de données scRNAseq
• Expérience pratique des modèles iPSC d'ingénierie des types de cellules cérébrales pour les approches génomiques fonctionnelles (par exemple CRISPR)
• Un vaste ensemble de compétences avec des tests de biologie cellulaire et moléculaire Informations complémentaires La date de début préférée du stage est 11/2026 ou selon disponibilité. Processus de demande Les demandes doivent comprendre un CV et une lettre d'accompagnement, ainsi qu'une lettre de votre superviseur scolaire actuel ou ancien appuyant votre demande au Programme RiSE. Les lettres de référence sont également les bienvenues. Veuillez noter qu'en raison de la réglementation des citoyens non membres de l'UE ou de l'AELE doivent être inscrits à un programme de doctorat ou de diplôme en médecine dans une université et fournir un certificat de l'université indiquant qu'un stage dans l'industrie est obligatoire dans le cadre de la formation universitaire. Curieux, motivé et prêt à apprendre? Faites votre demande pour notre stage RiSE. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: IVD Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Product Manager at Roche Diagnostics.

What will you do?

• Identify market opportunities and customer needs in order to create value for the customers and patients

• Define an overarching business strategy for the current and future product portfolio

• Develop specific marketing plans for the product portfolio

• Represent marketing group on local and global cross-functional teams driving innovation and market penetration

• Manage resources and budget to target all assigned programs and initiatives

• Organize training programs for the sales team about product specifications, product marketing strategies, and competition

• Co-create and implement customized solutions to meet defined outcomes

• Drive process improvements to deliver higher productivity

• Work in cross-functional teams for the success of projects

• Work closely with Healthcare Consultants, Product Managers and global teams for required projects

Who are you?

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Science or Business in the related field

• Previous experience in Marketing is highly preferred

• Ability to build relationships and work in the project team, trust and influence with internal members and other key stakeholders

• Strong project management skills

• Excellent written and oral communication skills

• Ability to manage multiple projects

• At least an upper-intermediate level of English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise

• Having a driving license and being willing to travel

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Junior DevOps Engineer

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Junior DevOps Engineer is focused on learning and execution. You will fulfil given tasks within deadlines, raise problems when they appear, and solve straightforward technical problems with guidance. Your focus will be on understanding immediate project goals, applying foundational programming skills, and demonstrating an eagerness to learn and grow within the organization.

The opportunity:

• Design, implement, maintain and manage multiple highly available solutions and platforms with thousands of users for supporting software engineers and DevOps engineers at Roche.

• Develop and maintain technical specifications, diagrams and supporting system documentation and system architecture documentation.

• Continuously learn and upskill on relevant technology products and methodologies, leveraging and training resources provided.

• Participate in technical peer reviews (design reviews, code walkthroughs, test reviews and root cause analysis sessions).

• Champion automation and evangelize lean development.

Who you are:

• Eager to learn and grow within the software engineering field, with a focus on executing tasks based on established procedures.

• Basic understanding of DevOps principles.

• Understanding of software validation and regulatory requirements.

• Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

• Proficient in English.

Nice to have:

• Experience with repository managers like Artifactory.

• Experience with SCM tools (Git) and project management tools.

• Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions and Gitlab.

• Experience in container technologies (e.g. Docker, LXC) and container platforms (e.g. Kubernetes, Rancher).

• Experience automating using infrastructure as code (e.g. Packer, Vagrant, Terraform) and configuration management (e.g. Ansible, Puppet, Chef) tools and ability to understand and implement immutable infrastructure.

• Experience with Public (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure) and Private clouds (e.g. VMWare, OpenStack).

• Experience in mainstream programming languages (Java, Python) and scripting languages (Bash, Python).

What you get:

• Salary range 7 525-13 975 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (pos

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Service Engineer – Medical Diagnostics (Stoke-on-Trent to Wrexham)
A Healthier Future. It’s What Drives Us.
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate, to continuously advance science, and to ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Together, we’re creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.
Roche Diagnostics presents an exceptional opportunity for you to leverage your technical expertise while providing vital, life-saving support to our valued customers.
As an integral member of the Central Customer-Centric Field Support Team in the UK, this role offers the possibility of field-based assignments across Stoke and surrounding areas or focusing on a designated customer base. (North Wales, Shropshire, and Staffordshire)

The Opportunity: Technical Excellence in the Field
Ideal Location: Based out of Stoke or the surrounding areas to the west, with excellent access to motorway networks.
As a Field Service Engineer, your focus is to ensure the seamless operation and maximum uptime of Roche’s innovative Systems/Products, ranging from serum work area, pre/post analytics and our digital portfolio.
You will utilise a combination of on-site support and remote diagnostic tools to identify and resolve complex electro-mechanical faults efficiently. Additionally, you will perform preventive maintenance and generate insightful reports to enhance operational efficiency across assigned customer sites.
Key Responsibilities

• Deliver Essential Support: Deliver electro-mechanical hardware support, including routine proactive and reactive tasks and technical training.

• Resolve Complex Faults: Perform troubleshooting and fault resolution, conduct preventive maintenance, and generate reports to enhance operational efficiency.

• Customer Training: Provide technical training and guidance to customers, enabling them to excel in the use of Roche diagnostic systems.

• Compliance & Administration: Maintain rigorous administration and regulatory documentation to ensure compliance and efficient service delivery.

• Stakeholder Management: Build productive relationships with peers and key stakeholders to align service and sales objectives seamlessly.

• Service Excellence: Attend internal review meetings to showcase progress, discuss objectives, and ensure service excellence.

Who you are
We are seeking resilient, adaptable, and customer-focused individuals who thrive on solving technical challenges and exceeding expectations. Ideally, you will bring:

• Educational Qualifications: A degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering is preferred. Candidates with equivalent experience at the HNC/HND level with a proven track record are also encouraged to apply.

• Experience: Extensive experience within the IVD industry, with a history of delivering exceptional technical support.

• Skills: Excellent analytical ability, self-motivation, advanced troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a collaborative team environment.

• Attributes: Resilience, tenacity, motivation to exceed customer expectations, and the ability to grow and mentor others through training, coaching, and continuous development.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Field Service Engineer – Diagnostica Medica (Stoke-on-Trent to Wrexham) Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci guida. Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare, a avanzare continuamente la scienza, e a garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni future. Insieme, stiamo creando un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche Diagnostics offre un'opportunità eccezionale per voi di sfruttare la vostra esperienza tecnica, fornendo un supporto vitale e salvavita ai nostri clienti apprezzati. Come membro integrante del Central Customer-Centric Field Support Team nel Regno Unito, questo ruolo offre la possibilità di assegnazioni basate sul campo attraverso Stoke e aree circostanti o focalizzandosi su una base clienti designata. (North Wales, Shropshire e Staffordshire) Opportunità: Eccellenza tecnica nel campo Posizione ideale: Basato su Stoke o sulle aree circostanti ad ovest, con un ottimo accesso alle reti autostradali. In qualità di Field Service Engineer, il vostro obiettivo è quello di garantire il funzionamento senza soluzione di continuità e il massimo uptime dei sistemi/prodotti innovativi di Roche, che vanno dall'area di lavoro siero, dall'analisi pre/post e dal nostro portafoglio digitale. Utilizzerai una combinazione di supporto in loco e strumenti diagnostici remoti per identificare e risolvere efficacemente i guasti elettromeccanici complessi. Inoltre, eseguire la manutenzione preventiva e generare report approfonditi per migliorare l'efficienza operativa attraverso i siti dei clienti assegnati. Principali responsabilità
• Fornire supporto essenziale: fornire supporto hardware elettromeccanico, tra cui attività proattive e reattive di routine e formazione tecnica.
• Risolvere errori complessi: Eseguire la risoluzione dei problemi e dei guasti, condurre la manutenzione preventiva e generare report per migliorare l'efficienza operativa.
• Customer Training: fornire formazione tecnica e guida ai clienti, consentendo loro di eccellere nell'uso dei sistemi diagnostici Roche.
• Compliance & Administration: Mantenere una rigorosa amministrazione e documentazione normativa per garantire la conformità e la consegna efficiente dei servizi.
• Gestione Stakeholder: Costruire relazioni produttive con colleghi e stakeholder chiave per allineare gli obiettivi di servizio e di vendita senza soluzione di continuità.
• Eccellenza del servizio: partecipare a riunioni di revisione interna per mostrare i progressi, discutere gli obiettivi e garantire l'eccellenza del servizio. Chi sei Stiamo cercando individui resilienti, adattabili e orientati al cliente che prosperano sulla soluzione di sfide tecniche e superando le aspettative. Idealmente, si porterà:
• Qualifiche didattiche: Si preferisce una laurea o una qualifica equivalente in Ingegneria Elettrica/Meccanica. I candidati con esperienza equivalente a livello HNC/HND con un record di traccia collaudato sono anche incoraggiati ad applicare.
• Esperienza: Ampia esperienza nell'industria IVD, con una storia di supporto tecnico eccezionale.
• Competenze: eccellente capacità analitica, automotivazione, esperienza avanzata di risoluzione dei problemi, e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente sotto pressione in un ambiente di team collaborativo.
• Attributi: Resilienza, tenacia, motivazione per superare le aspettative dei clienti, e la capacità di crescere e mentore gli altri attraverso formazione, coaching e sviluppo continuo. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Field Service Engineer – Medizinische Diagnostik (Stoke-on-Trent nach Wrexham) Eine gesunde Zukunft. Es ist, was uns treibt. Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns dazu antreibt, die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheit hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Roche Diagnostics bietet Ihnen eine außergewöhnliche Gelegenheit, Ihr technisches Know-how zu nutzen und unseren geschätzten Kunden eine lebenserhaltende Unterstützung zu bieten. Als integraler Bestandteil des zentralen Kunden-Zentrums-Support-Teams in Großbritannien bietet diese Rolle die Möglichkeit feldbasierter Aufgaben in Stoke- und Umgebungsbereichen oder die Fokussierung auf eine ausgewiesene Kundenbasis. (Nord Wales, Shropshire und Staffordshire) Die Gelegenheit: Technische Exzellenz im Bereich Ideale Lage: Aus Stoke oder den umliegenden Gebieten im Westen, mit hervorragendem Zugang zu Autobahnnetzen. Als Field Service Engineer steht Ihnen im Fokus, den nahtlosen Betrieb und die maximale Verfügbarkeit der innovativen Systeme/Produkte von Roche zu gewährleisten, angefangen von Serum-Arbeitsbereich, Pre/Post-Analysen und unserem digitalen Portfolio. Sie werden eine Kombination aus Vor-Ort-Unterstützung und Ferndiagnose-Tools verwenden, um komplexe elektromechanische Fehler effizient zu identifizieren und zu beheben. Darüber hinaus führen Sie vorbeugende Wartung durch und erstellen einsichtsreiche Berichte, um die operative Effizienz auf den zugewiesenen Kundenseiten zu verbessern. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
• Liefern Sie wesentliche Unterstützung: Liefern Sie elektromechanische Hardware-Unterstützung, einschließlich routinemäßiger proaktiver und reaktiver Aufgaben und technischer Ausbildung.
• Komplexe Fehler beheben: Fehlerbehebung und Fehlerauflösung durchführen, vorbeugende Wartung durchführen und Berichte erstellen, um die Betriebseffizienz zu verbessern.
• Kundenschulung: Bereitstellung technischer Schulungen und Beratung für Kunden, damit sie sich bei der Anwendung von Roche-Diagnostiksystemen auszeichnen können.
• Compliance & Administration: Einhaltung strenger Verwaltungs- und Regulierungsdokumente, um die Einhaltung und effiziente Service-Lieferung zu gewährleisten.
• Stakeholder Management: Erstellen Sie produktive Beziehungen zu Peers und wichtigen Stakeholdern, um Service- und Verkaufsziele nahtlos auszurichten.
• Service Excellence: Besuchen Sie interne Überprüfungssitzungen, um Fortschritte zu zeigen, Ziele zu diskutieren und Service-Exzellenz zu gewährleisten. Wer bist du? Wir suchen nach widerstandsfähigen, anpassungsfähigen und kundenorientierten Individuen, die auf die Lösung technischer Herausforderungen und über die Erwartungen drängen. Idealerweise bringen Sie:
• Bildungsqualifikationen: Ein Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation in Elektro- und Maschinenbau ist bevorzugt. Auch Kandidaten mit äquivalenter Erfahrung auf der HNC/HND-Ebene mit bewährtem Track Record werden ermutigt, sich zu bewerben.
• Erfahrung: Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der IVD-Branche, mit einer Geschichte, außergewöhnliche technische Unterstützung zu liefern.
• Fähigkeiten: Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeit, Selbstmotivation, erweiterte Fehlerbehebungsexpertise und die Fähigkeit, effektiv unter Druck in einer kollaborativen Teamumgebung zu arbeiten.
• Attribute: Widerstandsfähigkeit, Zähigkeit, Motivation, die Erwartungen der Kunden zu übertreffen, und die Fähigkeit zu wachsen und Mentor andere durch Training, Coaching und kontinuierliche Entwicklung. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Ingénieur du Service mobile – Diagnostic médical (Stoke-on-Trent à Wrexham) Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous conduit. Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover, à faire progresser continuellement la science et à garantir à tous l'accès aux soins de santé dont ils ont besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Ensemble, nous créons un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Roche Diagnostics vous offre une occasion exceptionnelle de tirer parti de votre expertise technique tout en apportant un soutien vital et vital à nos clients. En tant que membre à part entière de la Central Customer-Centric Field Support Team au Royaume-Uni, ce rôle offre la possibilité d'effectuer des missions sur le terrain dans Stoke et les environs ou de se concentrer sur une clientèle désignée. (Galles du Nord, Shropshire et Staffordshire) L'occasion : excellence technique sur le terrain Emplacement idéal: Basé à partir de Stoke ou les environs à l'ouest, avec un excellent accès aux réseaux autoroutiers. En tant qu'ingénieur de service sur le terrain, votre objectif est d'assurer le fonctionnement sans faille et le maximum de disponibilité de systèmes/produits innovants de Roches, allant de la zone de travail du sérum, de l'analyse pré/post et de notre portefeuille numérique. Vous utiliserez une combinaison d'outils de soutien sur place et de diagnostic à distance pour identifier et résoudre efficacement les défauts électromécaniques complexes. De plus, vous effectuerez l'entretien préventif et générerez des rapports perspicaces pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle sur les sites clients assignés. Principales responsabilités
• Offrez un soutien essentiel: Offrez un soutien matériel électromécanique, y compris des tâches de routine proactives et réactives et une formation technique.
• Résoudre les défaillances complexes: Effectuer le dépannage et la résolution des défaillances, effectuer l'entretien préventif et générer des rapports pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle.
• Formation à la clientèle : fournir une formation technique et des conseils aux clients, leur permettant d'exceller dans l'utilisation des systèmes de diagnostic Roche.
• Conformité et administration : Tenir à jour des documents administratifs et réglementaires rigoureux pour assurer la conformité et l'efficacité de la prestation des services.
• Gestion des parties prenantes : établir des relations productives avec les pairs et les principales parties prenantes afin d'harmoniser les objectifs de service et de vente de façon transparente.
• Excellence en matière de services : Assister à des réunions d'examen interne pour présenter les progrès accomplis, discuter des objectifs et assurer l'excellence en matière de services. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des personnes résilientes, adaptables et axées sur le client qui prospèrent en résolvant les défis techniques et en dépassant les attentes. Idéalement, vous apporterez:
• Qualifications scolaires: Un diplôme ou une qualification équivalente en génie électrique/mécanique est préféré. Les candidats ayant une expérience équivalente au niveau HNC/HND et ayant fait leurs preuves sont également encouragés à postuler.
• Expérience: Expérience étendue dans l'industrie IVD, avec une histoire de fournir un soutien technique exceptionnel.
• Compétences : Excellente capacité d'analyse, automotivation, expertise avancée en dépannage et capacité de travailler efficacement sous pression dans un environnement d'équipe collaborative.
• Attributs: Résilience, ténacité, motivation pour dépasser les attentes des clients, et capacité de grandir et de guider les autres par la formation, le coaching et le développement continu. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking an experienced SAP EWM Specialist who independently leads EWM solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to the architecture for the global Roche ASPIRE EWM System.

In this role, you will guide product developments, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level. By bringing advanced EWM knowledge, expertise within GxP environments, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and the evolution of our warehouse processes across Roche.

Description of the area:
Job Responsibilities

• Scope: Works and leads independently to deliver solution design with increased complexity (e.g., technical, scope, stakeholders) in the EWM area that meet product requirements and business priorities. Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Determines methods and procedures on assignments and coordinates or guides the activities of others in the team. Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the product level under limited direction. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.

• Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product teams within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders from the business and within IT. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across work-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, and facilitating discussions.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to the EWM system and its interfaces. Identifies opportunities and improves existing solutions to enhance value and business processes, providing technical oversight and guidance for the product teams.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• A minimum of five years of experience is required in independently leading and delivering complex solution designs and products within the Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) domain.

• Background in logistics or supply chain.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.

• Experience working within a validated environment, including the creation and execution of test scripts and solution documentation.

Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Determines methods and procedures on assignments and coordinates or guides the activities of others in the team. Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the product level under limited direction. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.
• Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product teams within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders from the business and within IT. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across work-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, and facilitating discussions.

Identifies opportunities and improves existing solutions to enhance value and business processes, providing technical oversight and guidance for the product teams. • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.
• Experience working within a validated environment, including the creation and execution of test scripts and solution documentation. Technical Skills
• SAP EWM certifications.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
1. 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求
2. 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
a) 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b) 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c) 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
1. 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程
2. 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点
3. 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育
4. 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2．了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
3. 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
1. 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗
2. 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
1. 成为产品和疾病领域的专家
2. 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

Years of Working Experience工作年限
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能工作经验为佳

Education/Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
•在试用期内通过RDPAC考试
•在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Ingénieur IA - Fusions et acquisitions À propos de notre équipe: Partenaires Solutions numériques Rejoignez notre équipe de Solutions numériques partenaires, un groupe stratégique axé sur la maximisation de l'impact du partenariat grâce aux écosystèmes numériques et à l'IA pour faire progresser les activités de Partenariats Pharma et DIA. Nous sommes à l'avant-garde de l'innovation - construire une infrastructure de données évolutive, appliquer des pratiques avancées en matière d'ingénierie des données et intégrer des capacités externes de pointe pour accélérer la prise de décisions et débloquer la valeur commerciale. Notre travail s'étend à de multiples initiatives à impact élevé, depuis le développement de produits de données intelligents jusqu'aux flux de travail d'IA de bout en bout. Qu'il s'agisse de structurer des écosystèmes de données complexes ou de collaborer avec des institutions de recherche externes, il s'agit d'une occasion unique de contribuer à façonner l'avenir des données et de l'IA à Roche en appuyant directement les décisions stratégiques clés de notre organisation mondiale de partenariat. Responsabilités En tant qu'ingénieur d'IA Full-Stack, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la conception et la construction d'applications d'IA orientées vers les utilisateurs qui permettent l'analyse en libre-service et la prise de décisions intelligentes. Vous développerez des expériences de frontend modernes et les intégrerez aux services de backend, aux plateformes de données et aux systèmes d'intelligence artificielle. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les ingénieurs des données, les ingénieurs de l'IA/ML et les intervenants commerciaux pour fournir des applications évolutives, sécurisées et intuitives qui apportent des capacités d'IA aux utilisateurs finaux. Vous serez responsable : Principales responsabilités :
• Mise au point d'applications frontales (expérience de l'IA):
• Concevoir et construire des interfaces utilisateur modernes et réactives en utilisant React (préféré) ou OutSystems pour prendre en charge les cas d'utilisation liés à l'IA tels que les tableaux de bord, les chatbots et les assistants d'IA.
• Développer des expériences interactives en temps réel, y compris des réponses en streaming et des visualisations dynamiques de données.
• Intégration backend & développement d'API:
• Développer et gérer les services et les API (par exemple FastAPI) pour connecter les applications frontend aux plateformes de données, aux systèmes d'intelligence artificielle et aux services d'entreprise.
• Assurer l'évolutivité, la fiabilité et la performance des intégrations d'applications.
• Intégration AI/Agent:
• Intégrer les applications frontend avec des systèmes d'IA agents alimentés par des cadres tels que LangGraph.
• Permettre une interaction transparente entre les utilisateurs et les agents de l'IA, y compris l'orchestration de flux de travail en plusieurs étapes et des informations basées sur l'IA.
• Intégration de données et de systèmes :
• Connectez les applications aux sources de données internes et externes via les API, permettant l'ingestion de nouvelles données et la visualisation des sorties des modèles d'IA.
• Assurer un traitement efficace des données structurées et non structurées entre les systèmes
• Développement d'applications Cloud-Native :
• Construisez et déployez des applications en utilisant des services AWS comme ECS et Lambda.
• Veiller à ce que les solutions soient évolutives, sécurisées et alignées sur les normes d'architecture d'entreprise
• Intégration des entreprises (sécurité et identité):
• Intégrer les mécanismes d'authentification et d'autorisation des entreprises, y compris la gestion active de l'identité par répertoire et le contrôle d'accès par rôle (RBAC).
• Assurer la mise en œuvre sûre de la SSO et le respect des normes de sécurité Roche.
• Conception et réflexion des produits :
• Traduire les besoins des entreprises en flux de travail d'application intuitifs et les expériences des utilisateurs. Faites équipe avec les intervenants pour concevoir des solutions qui permettent l'analyse en libre-service et maximisent la convivialité et l'adoption.

• Mettre en œuvre des pratiques de surveillance, d'enregistrement et d'optimisation des performances pour assurer le respect des règles

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. • verantwortlich für die Förderung der molekularen Diagnostik, einschließlich Infektionskrankheiten, Atemwegserkrankungen und Transplantation.

• Erzeugung der Nachfrage und Maximierung des Produktbewusstseins durch die Zusammenarbeit und Bereitstellung von Bildung und Information an die Kunden.
• Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen und Pläne zur Erleichterung des Verkaufsprozesses und der Produktivität.

• die notwendige Raumplanung und -führung für die Effizienz durchführen und organisieren. Durchführung der Geschäftsanalyse und -planung.
• übermittelt wettbewerbsfähige Marktinformationen intern.

• 3+ Jahre relevante Verkaufs- oder gleichwertige Erfahrung
• Die Teilnahme an einem genehmigten beschleunigten Entwicklungs-, Stipendiums- oder Rotationsprogramm kann statt der Erfahrung betrachtet werden. Bevorzugte Anforderungen:
• Die Erfahrung in der Diagnostik ist stark bevorzugt
• Gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, einschließlich der wirkungsvollen Präsentationen
• Bewährte Führungsfähigkeiten
• Verhandlung, Vermittlung und Problemlösungsfähigkeit
• Fähigkeit, in einer geregelten Umgebung zu arbeiten

• promouvoir les tests de diagnostic moléculaire, y compris les maladies infectieuses, respiratoires et les transplantations.
• contacter des clients nouveaux et existants pour atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente dans des comptes ciblés, en développant de nouvelles activités, en développant des activités existantes, en maintenant des relations avec les clients et en dépannant les problèmes des clients. • générer la demande et maximiser la sensibilisation aux produits en travaillant avec et en fournissant de l'éducation et de l'information aux clients.
• met en oeuvre des initiatives et des plans stratégiques pour faciliter le processus de vente et la productivité.
• travailler avec d'autres, selon les besoins ou les besoins, à l'élaboration de propositions de comptes attribués. Présente toutes les propositions de contrats aux clients afin de maximiser l'ensemble des activités et de la rentabilité, ce qui peut nécessiter des négociations.
• réaliser et organiser la planification et l'acheminement du territoire nécessaires à l'efficacité. Effectuer des analyses et des plans opérationnels.
• communique en interne des informations sur le marché concurrentiel.
• des réseaux et des interfaces avec des collègues internes afin d'échanger des informations et des pratiques exemplaires tout en continuant à participer activement aux activités de l'industrie et des organisations de clients qui ont une incidence sur les entreprises. C'est un rôle de terrain - le territoire est le Massachusetts, le Connecticut, le Vermont et l'Est de NY. Jusqu'à 50 % de la nuit prévue. Qui vous êtes :
• Licence ou expérience équivalente
• 3+ ans de ventes pertinentes ou expérience équivalente
• La participation à un programme de développement accéléré, de bourses ou de rotation approuvé peut être envisagée au lieu de l'expérience. Exigences préférées :
• L'expérience dans les ventes de diagnostic est fortement préférée
• Bonnes aptitudes à la communication orale et écrite, y compris des présentations utiles
• Capacités éprouvées de leadership
• Compétences en négociation, négociation et résolution de problèmes
• Capacité de travailler dans un environnement réglementé

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Imagine working for an organisation that focuses on putting people at the heart of what they do. Where every single person within the organisation is aligned to one main motivating force, that at the center of everything they do, and their number one priority; patients. Imagine you are at Roche.

We're looking for a dynamic and strategic leader for the position of Head of Site Services and SHE to define and drive the strategy, performance, and continuous development of our sites and workplaces. This role is essential in shaping the future of our facilities and ensuring optimal safety, sustainability, and operational excellence. You will lead all aspects of facilities, Sustainability, Safety, Health & Environment (SHE). By fostering a culture of collaboration and customer-centric service, you will create an environment that anticipates future needs and enhances the employee and customer experience.

The Opportunity

• Lead Your Team : Develop and lead a high-performing team by fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You will also provide coaching and mentorship, and support professional development.

• Lead Strategy & Innovation : Define and drive local workplace strategy in alignment with local and global ambitions. You will also participate in the International Real Estate/Facilities Management (RE/FM) portfolio and support corporate initiatives.

• Ensure Compliance : Collaborate closely with colleagues to ensure business continuity including local emergency plans. You'll ensure compliance with all local and global regulations and maintain necessary ISO registrations, such as Environment (14001), Health and Safety (45001).

• Manage Operations & Maintenance : Plan and control repairs and maintenance to ensure high availability of site infrastructure. You will also implement Lifecycle Asset Management and define KPIs to measure success.

• ​ Engage Stakeholders : Drive close communication and collaboration with all site stakeholders, following a "customer first" principle. You'll advocate for Roche's position within external industry and government entities.

• Oversee Security & Safety: Develop, implement, and maintain security measures related to physical, personnel, and information security.

Who are you

We are looking for a leader who is passionate about sustainability, safety, and creating exceptional workplaces. Your profile should include:

• Leadership & Behavioral Qualities : You must be a strategic thinker with proven experience leading a diverse team and driving a culture of accountability. You should be an active listener who fosters collaborative problem-solving, trusting and empowering your team to take ownership. We need a leader who is objective-driven, adaptable, and has strong communication, conflict resolution, and decision-making skills. We are looking for a leader who is a true Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach (VACC).

• Technical Skills : A solid grasp of the technical aspects of facilities management, including building systems, HVAC, electrical, and plumbing is also critical. Experience in energy management, project management, vendor management, and budget management is required.

• Qualifications & Experience : A degree or equivalent, relevant & established experience. Advanced IWFM qualification or comparable certification preferred. You should have a proven track record of leading large projects in facilities and SHE, managing budgets, and driving innovation.

titleByLocale.it: Tirocinio nel settore del controllo qualità (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, um Einblicke in die pharmazeutische Industrie zu bekommen? Bei uns erhältst Du die spannende Möglichkeit dazu.
In Deinem Praktikum lernst Du den Bereich der Qualitätskontrolle umfassend kennen. Es erwartet Dich eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit im Bereich der Analytik von immunologischen Einsatzstoffen. Du erhältst ebenfalls die Möglichkeit, Einblicke in andere Bereiche wie z.B. Biotech Produktion oder Qualitätssicherung zu gewinnen. Während des gesamten Praktikums steht Dir ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du unterstützt die proteinchemische Analytik und Freigabeanalytik von immunologischen Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld

• Du bearbeitest eigenständig kleinere Projekte zur Optimierung der Qualitätskontrolle, beispielsweise durch Datenrecherche bei Abweichungen oder die Zentralisierung von Analysemethoden

• Du wirkst aktiv an Compliance-Themen mit, indem Du beispielsweise bei der Erstellung und Anpassung von Dokumenten nach internen Vorschriften und geltenden Standards unterstützt

• Du erhältst Einblicke in angrenzende Bereiche wie die Vorbereitung von Audits und Inspektionen sowie in den gesamten Lebenszyklus diagnostischer Tests (Neuentwicklung, Produktion und Verpackung)

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (z.B. B.Sc . / M.Sc . Chemie, Biochemie, Biotechnologie, Biologie, etc.) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year

• Du bringst eine hohe Motivation und Neugierde für die Arbeit in der Qualitätskontrolle mit.

• Idealerweise verfügst Du über Vorkenntnisse in der proteinchemischen Analytik.

• Solide Deutsch-Kenntnisse sind erforderlich

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade nur Deinen Lebenslauf online hoch.

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum: ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity,

jobs.title: Senior Sales Representative DIA (Temuno-Araucanía)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

• Gestionar y expandir la operación comercial de las cuentas asignadas, asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos de ventas y rentabilidad, alineados con el código de conducta Roche, normativas locales y lineamientos corporativos.

• Liderar negociaciones estratégicas e implementar soluciones integrales adaptadas a las necesidades de los clientes, desarrollando propuestas de valor basadas en un entendimiento profundo de sus operaciones y desafíos.

• Construir y fortalecer relaciones de largo plazo con clientes y stakeholders clave, brindando una experiencia superior de servicio, realizando visitas estratégicas y participando activamente en actividades externas como congresos, talleres y jornadas.

• Identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y contribuir al desarrollo de cuentas estratégicas, apoyando procesos de licitación, análisis de mercado, actualización de CRM y colaboración interdisciplinaria enfocada en el paciente y el cliente.

• Impulsar una cultura de trabajo colaborativa y de crecimiento continuo, participando en iniciativas internas, fortaleciendo habilidades comerciales y contribuyendo al desarrollo y capacitación de nuevos integrantes del equipo.

Tu Perfil:

• Profesional del área de la salud, idealmente Tecnólogo Médico o Bioquímico, con residencia en Temuco y disponibilidad para viajar dentro de la zona asignada.

• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en el área comercial de soluciones diagnósticas para laboratorio clínico, idealmente en entornos de diagnóstico clínico, equipos médicos o industrias relacionadas.

• Deseable formación en ventas profesionales, manejo de herramientas CRM como Salesforce, y conocimientos comerciales orientados a negociación estratégica y desarrollo de cuentas.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio o avanzado, junto con capacidad de trabajo en equipo, mirada corporativa y pensamiento estratégico orientado a equipos de alto desempeño.

#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Consultant en solutions ERP - SAP EWM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM

We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer with MFS experience to join our team and take ownership of a highly complex, validated warehouse management solution. This warehouse is one of the biggest ones of the Roche Pharma division with a high degree of automation. You guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level.

The Opportunity

• Design & Implementation : Develop and implement complex enhancements to our SAP EWM solution, including MFS and WebDynpro user interfaces

• Independent Problem-Solving : Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions; troubleshoot issues at the code level without requiring constant guidance

• Technical Deep-Dive : Investigate complex technical challenges, debug code, and optimize system performance

• Stakeholder Collaboration : Work closely with business teams to understand requirements, manage expectations, and communicate technical constraints and timelines

• Validated Environment Management : Execute changes in compliance with our regulated environment, including documentation, test cases, and validation requirements

• Knowledge Transfer : Document solutions and share expertise with team members to build organizational capability

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement

Required Qualifications

• Extensive SAP EWM Experience : Minimum 5+ years working with SAP EWM in production environments, including complex configurations and customizations

• MFS Expertise : Proven hands-on experience implementing and maintaining SAP MFS

• ABAP Development Skills : Solid programming background with ability to debug, and optimize ABAP code

• Validated Environment Experience : Demonstrated familiarity with regulated environments, change management processes, and compliance documentation

• SAFe Framework Knowledge : Working understanding of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles and practices

• Fluent English : Strong verbal and written communication skills (essential)

• German Language (Preferred) : Fluency in German is a significant plus

Who you are:

• Salary range 14,175 - 26,325 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 15%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

• ABAP Development Skills: Solid background di programmazione con capacità di debug e ottimizzare il codice ABAP
• Esperienza ambientale convalidata: familiarità dimostrata con ambienti regolamentati, processi di gestione dei cambiamenti e documentazione di conformità
• Conoscenza quadro SAFe: comprensione di lavoro dei principi e delle pratiche di Agile Framework (SAFe)
• Inglese fluente: Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta (essenziale)
• Lingua tedesca (preferita) : La fluenza in tedesco è un vantaggio significativo Chi sei:

• Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 15%).
• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).
• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).
• Prendere il programma di tempo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Near Patient Care , we create the tools that help people with diabetes think less about their daily routine and more about their lives. Our Indianapolis site is a global hub for blood glucose strip manufacturing and the future home of our next-generation continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) sensors.

The Opportunity
As a Controls Engineer , you are the technical backbone of our automated production lines. You won’t just be sitting at a desk; you’ll be hands-on with high-speed equipment, ensuring our manufacturing processes are stable, validated, and constantly improving.

What You’ll Do

• Optimize & Innovate: Lead the evolution of our automation and electromechanical processes. You’ll use data and operator feedback to make our lines faster, smarter, and more reliable.

• Launch New Tech: Partner with R&D and Process Development to bridge the gap between design and high-volume manufacturing for new product launches.

• Own the Controls: Program, modify, and troubleshoot the "brains" of our machines, ensuring every sensor, motor, and PLC is performing at peak efficiency.

• Manage Quality & Validation: Lead equipment qualifications (IQ/OQ/PQ) and ensure all process changes meet strict regulatory standards without sacrificing production speed.

• Strategic Leadership: Manage multiple project lifecycles, mentor junior staff, and provide expert on-call support to keep our 24/7 operations running smoothly.

• On-Site: Engineers are dedicated to the Indianapolis site. Travel typically < 10%.

What You’ll Bring

• PLC & HMI Proficiency: Deep experience with Allen Bradley (RSLogix/Studio 5000) and FactoryTalk View. You are comfortable modifying code to drive continuous improvement.

• The "Troubleshooter" Mindset: Strong knowledge of electromechanical systems, motion controls (Servos/VFDs), Distributed I/O, sensors, and Cognex/Keyence Vision Systems.

• Validation Expertise: Proven ability to develop and execute equipment qualification protocols and write clear, technical documentation.

• Vendor Management: Experience collaborating with external partners to source specialized solutions or navigate component obsolescence.

• Analytical Drive: A highly logical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to run simulations and use test data to make informed decisions.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or closely related discipline with a minimum of 2 years of related experience; advanced degree may substitute for previous experience or equivalent experience

• Related experience must include troubleshooting, modifying, and/or developing industrial equipment controls systems (PLCs, HMIs, Motion Control, etc.)

Preferred:

• Familiar with GMP in a regulated environment (Medical Device or Pharmaceutical).

• Strong electro-mechanical skills that can look at the machine from all engineering aspects: mechanical, electrical, and controls.

• Previous experience troubleshooting controls systems of high volume/speed manufacturing equipment.

• Previous training or experience in Process Improvement Methodologies (e.g. LSS, PDCA, etc.).

• Demonstrates excellent interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills.

• Strong ability to teach and educate key stakeholders and other colleagues.

• Deep commitment to cross-functional collaboration and breaking down silos to achieve the best results for the organization.

This is an onsite role in Indianapolis. Relocation benefits are not available.

The expected salary range for the Manufacturing

jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow.

Our Verification and Validation team, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is responsible for ensuring a software product meets its specified requirements and performs as intended by rigorously testing and analyzing the software throughout its development lifecycle.

As a Principal Software Developer in Test, you will be responsible for test design, development, automation, deployment, execution, and reporting. Specifically, you will develop an integrated hardware-software framework for end-to-end test automation that leverages a third-party Hardware-in-the-Loop solution. In this role, you will represent quality engineering and verification on behalf of your team in all events and activities related to this effort, working closely with software and hardware engineers across multiple global locations.

The Opportunity

• You develop solutions for Hardware-in-the-Loop testing for end-to-end testing of embedded instrument software

• You author and confirm correctness of requirements-driven tests, covering aspects including:

• Testing approaches (exploratory, white box, black box, etc.)

• Testing level (end-to-end, system, integration, unit, etc.)

• Testing types (functional, performance, scalability, etc.)

• You automate and execute front-end and back-end tests, covering for:

• Instrument software

• Web applications

• You automate deployment and testing pipelines across branches and stages

• You report quality metrics and enhancing quality dashboards

• You perform root cause analysis of defects and discoveries

• You develop automation frameworks and validate automation toolchains

• You ensure regulatory compliance of quality engineering deliverables

• You partner with Test Architects, Test Leads, and Verification & Validation Leads on practices

• You collaborate with designers, architects, developers, system engineers and testers on product development

• You participate in all development events, and activities and guide junior testing team members as needed

• Technologies which may be utilized : C++, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Gherkin, Playwright, Windows, Cypress/JDI/Selenium/WebDriver/TestNG, Typescript/Javascript, Angular, Docker, Jenkins, Groovy, Bash, Jira, Github, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux, MS SQL, Vector HIL Solutions

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related. Advanced degree preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered, with three years of experience for each year of missing education

• You have 10+ years related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience with Jav

jobs.title: Enterprise Identity Management Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a Enterprise Identity Management Engineer to serve as a senior primary architect of our Enterprise Identity Management (IGA) future. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will design, build, and deliver next-generation identity solutions operating at global scale. Positioned at the intersection of security engineering and business enablement, you'll create resilient frameworks that protect critical systems while enabling seamless, automated access. As a technical visionary, you'll tackle the most complex identity challenges within our large-scale enterprise ecosystem.

The Opportunity

In this pivotal role, you will act as a primary architect driving the evolution of our Enterprise Identity Management strategy. You'll own the complete technical lifecycle, from designing scalable solutions to delivering resilient implementations across our global infrastructure.

Main Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end technical design of EIM solutions aligned with enterprise standards and security policies

• Define and standardize architecture patterns, best practices, and reusable frameworks

• Conduct design reviews and provide technical governance for scalable, high-quality implementations

• Translate security and business requirements into actionable technical solutions

• Architect, build, test, and deploy SailPoint-based IAM solutions from the ground up

• Deliver resilient identity solutions across complex, distributed environments

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation and production rollout

• Own delivery lifecycle end-to-end, including planning, estimation, timelines, and risk management

• Act as Tier 3 escalation point, leading root cause analysis and long-term fixes

• Drive innovation through PoCs and adoption of modern EIM Integrations (APIs, cloud integrations)

Who You Are
Core Expertise & Experience

• Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in Identity Management within large-scale, global environments.

• 3+ years experience working in a multinational work environment (Healthcare Industry experience a plus) as an Engineer/Technical team member

• Strong customer engagement and presentation skills with the ability to communicate across all levels (senior and/or small audiences)

• Deep technical expertise in SailPoint, specifically in design, custom development, troubleshooting, and architecture.

• Ability to work effectively with team members and virtual teams from different locations and different cultural background

• Ability to function independently with little supervision

• Advanced programming proficiency in Java for developing custom connectors, rules, and complex workflows.

• Proven experience implementing Integration solutions with Active Directory and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, and modern architecture (APIs, microservices, cloud)

• Strong understanding of RBAC, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and access governance frameworks.

Education

• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.

• Professional Information Security certifications (e.g., CISSP) is a plus.

If you're an experienced identity architect with deep SailPoint expertise, a passion for solving complex security challenges, and the drive to own end-to-end technical delivery in a multinational environment, we want to hear from you.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posti

jobs.title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a skilled Identity & Access Management Engineer to join our growing IAM team. This role offers a unique opportunity for a Java Developer to expand their expertise into the Identity and Access Management space, with a focus on SailPoint technologies and application integration. You will work on solving complex business problems through practical application of your development skills, contributing to the design, implementation, and evolution of enterprise-scale identity solutions. In this position, you will take on meaningful responsibility for technical design decisions, build resilient IAM infrastructure, and play an active role in shaping how our organization manages identity and access across the enterprise.

The Opportunity
This role positions you at the intersection of software development and information security, where you'll apply your Java expertise to solve complex identity and access management challenges within a large global enterprise.

Your Responsibilities

• Contribute to the end-to-end design of IAM infrastructure solutions and create and maintain related component standards

• Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation for designs, design patterns, and component standards

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters related to organizational priorities

• Strengthen the Information Security community by building bridges and collaborating with peers and stakeholders

• Contribute to determining success criteria and evaluating promising solutions and technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies

• Design, build, test, and implement integrated, resilient, and reliable IAM solutions

• Advise, influence, and collaborate with various IT partners and line-of-business stakeholders, integrating their feedback

• Ensure designs and solutions align with organizational policies, standards, and strategic directions

• Contribute to estimating engineering resources and timelines for successful project delivery

• Write and contribute to position papers, white papers, technical recommendations, and best practices documentation for the IAM solution space

• Remain proactive in identifying operational challenges and opportunities, working with support teams to ensure solutions meet quality and regulatory standards

• Collaborate closely with Identity Management Support and Operations teams on incident management, problem management, and continuous service improvement

• Embrace our Infrastructure as Code tool chain and adhere to coding best practices

Who You Are

Technology Skills & Experience

• Deep expertise in Java development with proven ability to apply it within enterprise security contexts

• Hands-on experience with Identity Management technologies; SailPoint experience is highly desired

• Demonstrated experience following CI/CD and DevOps practices

• Knowledge of microservices architectures, API design, and REST APIs

• Understanding of distributed architectures and the challenges they present

• Experience working in an Agile environment

• Proficiency in Python and scripting languages (Perl, JavaScript, PowerShell, etc.) is desired

• Background in Identity and Access Management, Directory Services, or Cyber Security is a plus

Core Competencies & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

• 5+ years of overall experience in relevant technology areas

• 2+ years working in a multinational environment as an Engineer or Te

• Assisting in project execution: Working closely with RSS Business Analytics teams to deliver analytics solutions to real-world business problems.

• Building Expertise: Gaining hands-on experience with programming languages , querying tools and data management platforms.

• Data, Analytics, Data Science and AI / ML Exposure: Gaining knowledge of statistical methodologies and supporting various Data Science initiatives across the global network.

• Stakeholder Communication: Preparing and presenting analytical findings to stakeholders in a structured and effective manner.

Who you are

• Academic Profile: You are a student currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, IT, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Biotechnology, or a related quantitative field

• Analytical Thinker: You have a strong quantitative aptitude and the logical thinking ability required to derive insights from complex data.

• Basic Tech-Foundation: You have a fundamental working knowledge of Python, SQL, and Excel (this is a significant advantage).

• Effective Communicator: You possess strong verbal and written communication skills in English .

• Proactive Learner: You are a quick learner, self-motivated, and quality-focused, with an innovative mind and the ability to transition between multiple tasks.

• Team Player: You enjoy working in a virtual, diverse, and collaborative team environment.

• Continuous Growth: Unlock your potential through an extensive ecosystem of learning resources. We offer hands-on training with cutting-edge industry tools, empowering you to architect your own unique career path within the health-tech landscape.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
