jobs.title: Network Analyst - Global Supply Chain Planning

titleByLocale.it: Network Analista - Global Supply Chain Planning
titleByLocale.en: Network Analyst - Global Supply Chain Planning
titleByLocale.fr: Network Analyste - Global Chaîne d'approvisionnement Planning

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Diagnostics, our mission is clear: we deliver answers to patients. We ensure our complex portfolio of life-saving diagnostic products is delivered to customers efficiently, on time, and complete. Achieving this requires a world-class, resilient global supply chain.

As a Network Analyst , you won't just maintain a system—you will be the architect of its optimization. This is a unique, high-impact fixed-term opportunity running through December 2028 , designed for a forward-thinking supply chain professional looking to lead massive digital transformations on a global stage.

The Opportunity
Operating within our global 3-hub matrix network, you will drive the continuous evolution of a flexible and resilient end-to-end supply chain. You will wear two critical hats: serving as the Technical Expert managing complex, cloud-based network optimizers, and acting as the Agile Product Owner for a cross-functional data product team.
If you want to spend the next few years working with absolute state-of-the-art technology to build a resume-defining portfolio, this is your sandbox.

Your Impact

• Network Optimization: Drive the end-to-end configuration of our multi-hub global network. You’ll manage and fine-tune complex, parameter-heavy cloud solvers (OMP) to make data-driven decisions on shipping routes, transport modes, replenishment quantities, and global safety stocks.

• Agile Product Ownership: Lead a global, cross-functional data product team as Product Owner. Utilizing agile methodologies and Data Mesh principles, you will design and deliver complex analytics solutions that provide real value to the business.

• Data Automation & Governance: Build an unshakeable master data foundation. You will pioneer automation solutions across systems, driving data quality and implementing robust data governance frameworks.

• Technological Innovation: Stay at the absolute cutting edge. You will integrate mathematical and heuristic optimization logics, advanced solvers, and modern data tech into our daily operations.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as a core consultant and Subject Matter Expert (SME). You will bridge the gap between technical data teams and senior leadership, leading global initiatives that align with Roche’s strategic priorities.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Operations Research, or a related field.

• You bring 3+ years of experience in supply chain planning, network optimization, or data analytics with a distinct international focus.

• You possess strong, data-driven decision-making capabilities and thrive when turning complex, chaotic data into elegant supply chain solutions.

Preferred Technical Toolkit

• Planning Suites: Deep proficiency with integrated planning suites like OMP (including its data and optimization modules) and a strong working knowledge of SAP ERP.

• Data Quality & Automation: Experience with master data automation tools (e.g., OMP Data Genie, ADM rules) and data quality platforms like Ataccama.

• Analytics & ETL: Solid know-how in data preparation, ETL, and visualization using platforms like Snowflake, Alteryx, and Tableau, alongside SAP analytics environments (SAC, BoA, BW).

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis, IN is $78,900 - $146,500. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location,

If you want to spend the next few years working with absolute state-of-the-art technology to build a resume-defining portfolio, this is your sandbox. Your Impact
• Network Optimization: Drive the end-to-end configuration of our multi-hub global network. You’ll manage and fine-tune complex, parameter-heavy cloud solvers (OMP) to make data-driven decisions on shipping routes, transport modes, replenishment quantities, and global safety stocks.
• Agile Product Ownership: Lead a global, cross-functional data product team as Product Owner. Utilizing agile methodologies and Data Mesh principles, you will design and deliver complex analytics solutions that provide real value to the business.
• Data Automation & Governance: Build an unshakeable master data foundation. You will pioneer automation solutions across systems, driving data quality and implementing robust data governance frameworks.
• Technological Innovation: Stay at the absolute cutting edge. You will integrate mathematical and heuristic optimization logics, advanced solvers, and modern data tech into our daily operations.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as a core consultant and Subject Matter Expert (SME). You will bridge the gap between technical data teams and senior leadership, leading global initiatives that align with Roche’s strategic priorities. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Operations Research, or a related field.
• You bring 3+ years of experience in supply chain planning, network optimization, or data analytics with a distinct international focus.
• You possess strong, data-driven decision-making capabilities and thrive when turning complex, chaotic data into elegant supply chain solutions. Preferred Technical Toolkit
• Planning Suites: Deep proficiency with integrated planning suites like OMP (including its data and optimization modules) and a strong working knowledge of SAP ERP.
• Data Quality & Automation: Experience with master data automation tools (e.g., OMP Data Genie, ADM rules) and data quality platforms like Ataccama.
• Analytics & ETL: Solid know-how in data preparation, ETL, and visualization using platforms like Snowflake, Alteryx, and Tableau, alongside SAP analytics environments (SAC, BoA, BW). Relocation benefits are not available for this posting The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis, IN is $78,900 - $146,500. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location,

jobs.title: Intern - Support to SHE Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
The SHE Intern will support the Safety, Health, Environment, and Security team in the continuous improvement of the SHE management system. This role provides hands-on SHE documentation, contributing to a strong safety culture across the organization.
Key Responsibilities

• Support with critical thinking the identification of occupational health and safety risks.

• Assist in the development, review, and documentation of Critical Tasks procedures, safe work instructions and chemical management

• Collaborate in the development of SHE related documentation.

• Assist in chemical documentation processes, including inventories, labeling SGA, safety data sheets (SDS), and storage compliance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote SHE awareness and best practices.

Requirements

• Currently enrolled student in Occupational Safety Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field.

• Ability to critically identify, analyze, and anticipate occupational safety hazards and risks.

• Understanding of critical tasks, safe work procedures and chemical management.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work collaboratively.

• Intermediate level of Google Workspace tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive).

Preferred Skills

• Basic knowledge of SHE standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 45001, ISO 14001, NFPA).

• Experience with documentation control or process mapping

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Learning Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Learning Services teams focus on executing system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. Global Learning Services provides customer service and advisory support to the Learning Community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.

The Opportunity
As a Learning Specialist you are part of a global, international team and contribute to customer experience directly. Your key responsibilities are performing complete, stringent and timely Training & Learning related administrative and organizational tasks in area and understanding its linkage to Personnel Administration and Organizational Management.

• Providing insight, Tier 2 support and explanation on Learning system (Cornerstone), administering and updating Learning Catalog

• Managing course enrollments for learners, managing invitations, registrations, reminders and follow-up on courses and attendance

• Preparing and providing various Training-related reports and status updates for HR professionals and Training Owners

• Functionality testing of new learning management system and a dvising and supporting business with system / testing / Learning processes

• Providing customer service on Training related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting

• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way and building relationships with other colleagues within the GLS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

What can you bring to our team:

• Ideally 1-3 years of experience in the fields of HR personnel administrative or service delivery or customer service with a college/university degree

• Accuracy in record keeping, focus and accountability

• The capability to multitask and handle complex cases

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment and fluent in written and spoken English .

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice, and its conditions can be tailored for employees according to needs (2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share y

The Position
Who We Are

Global Product Strategy (GPS) drives Roche’s strategy and portfolio of products - from research and development through to patients. As a member of GPS, you will be part of a truly international group that collaborates with functions and affiliates worldwide, across the Roche enterprise, to shape the future of medicine.
As the Global Therapeutic Area Head (TAH), Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases, you will lead large-scale, multidisciplinary teams, composed of direct and indirect reports, with considerable influence on the company’s overall strategic, financial and operational performance. You will directly lead a team of senior leaders who are accountable for coordinating and managing the early pipeline and the lifecycle of late-stage and on-market products; providing global, cross-functional leadership for all development, technical, and commercial activities for all molecules/products across Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases.
You will be a standing member of the GPS Leadership Team and make significant contributions to the long-range vision, strategy and plans for GPS and Roche Pharma overall. You will be a co-chair for relevant Therapeutic Area (TA) governance boards (business and development boards / TAH meetings) and a standing member of various global decision-making committees, such as the Late-Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC).

Who You Are

We're looking for a leader with VACC attributes (Visionaire, Architect, Coach, Catalyst) who is committed to our new ways of working. You're authentic and self-aware, passionate about the big picture, cutting-edge science and achieving results while creating a diverse and inclusive environment that brings out the best in the people.

Key Responsibilities

In this position, you will be primarily accountable for effectively:

• Defining, setting, aligning and overseeing implementation/adoption of the long-range vision and global strategy for the diverse therapeutic areas of Neurology and Immunology.

• Leading development and execution of a robust, integrated and cohesive vision and Therapeutic Area Strategic Plan, which includes individual global pipeline, disease area and lifecycle strategies and plans (including integrated solutions, if appropriate), for all assets/indications/disease areas across Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases.

• Optimizing resource allocation to ensure strategic portfolio and financial outcomes are achieved, both within Neurology and Immunology and across GPS.

• Ensuring rigorous commercial assessments of Phase I – III results and provision of expert insights, strategic options and recommendations to executives and Strategic Portfolio Committees regarding therapeutic area assets and their market potential.

• Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCTs), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DATs), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLTs), and Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, to coordinate activities across Roche to assure global and affiliate alignment.

• Ensuring Neurology and Immunology teams provide asset leadership guidance, relevant commercial insights and rigorous analytical support for licensing and other business development activities.

• Accountable for partnering with the Immunology Pharma Portfolio Team (IPPT) and Neurology Pharma Portfolio Team (NPPT) leaders to ensure the realisation of our TA and DA strategies including supporting strategic portfolio considerations, opportunity assessments, and trade-offs, while fostering end-to-end TA collaboration and community.

• Co-chair Business and Development Boards and TAH meetings to ensure robust and rigorous asset and program level decision making. As a co-chair across the Development and Business Boards, the TAH plays a vital role in steering assets through their end-to-end lifecycle by bridging technical execution with commercial strategy. At the development board, you ensure programs meet the "Bar" criteria. A

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione Chi siamo Global Product Strategy (GPS) guida la strategia di Roche e il portafoglio di prodotti - dalla ricerca e sviluppo fino ai pazienti. Come membro del GPS, sarete parte di un gruppo veramente internazionale che collabora con funzioni e affiliati in tutto il mondo, attraverso l'impresa Roche, per plasmare il futuro della medicina. In qualità di Responsabile Area Terapeutica Globale (TAH), Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive, guiderai team multidisciplinari su larga scala, composti da rapporti diretti e indiretti, con notevole influenza sulle prestazioni strategiche, finanziarie e operative dell’azienda. Potrai dirigere direttamente un team di leader senior che sono responsabili per il coordinamento e la gestione della pipeline precoce e del ciclo di vita dei prodotti in fase avanzata e sul mercato; fornire leadership globale, interfunzionale per tutte le attività di sviluppo, tecnico e commerciale per tutte le molecole / prodotti in Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive. Sarete un membro in piedi del GPS Leadership Team e dare contributi significativi alla visione a lungo raggio, strategia e piani per GPS e Roche Pharma generale. Sarete una co-presidente per i comitati di governance dell'Area Terapeutica (TA) pertinenti (commissioni di business e sviluppo / riunioni TAH) e un membro in piedi di vari comitati decisionali globali, come il Comitato Portfolio di Late-Stage (LSPC). Chi sei
• Stiamo cercando un leader con attributi VACC (Visionaire, Architetto, Coach, Catalyst) che si impegna per i nostri nuovi modi di lavorare. Sei autentico e consapevole di te stesso, appassionato del grande quadro, della scienza all'avanguardia e del raggiungimento dei risultati, creando un ambiente diversificato e inclusivo che esalta il meglio della gente. Principali responsabilità In questa posizione, sarai principalmente responsabile per in modo efficace: - Definire, impostare, allineare e supervisionare l'implementazione/adozione della visione a lungo raggio e della strategia globale per le diverse aree terapeutiche della neurologia e dell'immunologia. - Sviluppo e realizzazione di una visione robusta, integrata e coesa e Piano Strategico Area terapeutica, che comprende singole strategie globali di pipeline, area malattia e ciclo di vita (comprese le soluzioni integrate, se del caso), per tutte le aree di attività/indicazioni/disease in Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive. - Ottimizzazione dell'allocazione delle risorse per garantire il portafoglio strategico e i risultati finanziari sono raggiunti, sia all'interno di Neurologia e Immunologia che attraverso GPS. - Garantire rigorose valutazioni commerciali dei risultati della Fase I – III e fornire approfondimenti di esperti, opzioni strategiche e raccomandazioni ai comitati executive e Portfolio Strategici relativi alle attività terapeutiche e al loro potenziale di mercato. - Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCT), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DAT), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLT), e Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, per coordinare le attività attraverso Roche per assicurare l'allineamento globale e affiliato. - Assicurare che i team di Neurologia e Immunologia forniscano una guida di asset leadership, approfondimenti commerciali rilevanti e un rigoroso supporto analitico per le licenze e altre attività di sviluppo aziendale. - Contabile per collaborare con i leader del team Portfolio di Immunology Pharma (IPPT) e del team di neurologia Pharma (NPPT) per garantire la realizzazione delle nostre strategie TA e DA, tra cui sostenere considerazioni strategiche di portafoglio, valutazioni di opportunità e trade-off, promuovendo la collaborazione e la comunità TA end-to-end. - Co-chair Business and Development Boards e TAH meeting per garantire un asset e un processo decisionale a livello di programma robusto e rigoroso. In qualità di co-presidente attraverso i Bordi di Sviluppo e Business, il TAH svolge un ruolo vitale nel sterzare le attività attraverso il loro ciclo di vita end-to-end attraverso il collegamento di esecuzione tecnica con la strategia commerciale. Nella scheda di sviluppo, si assicura che i programmi soddisfino i criteri "Bar". A

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Position Wer wir sind Die globale Produktstrategie (GPS) treibt die Strategie und das Produktportfolio von Roche – von Forschung und Entwicklung bis hin zu Patienten. Als Mitglied von GPS, Sie werden Teil einer wirklich internationalen Gruppe, die mit Funktionen und Tochtergesellschaften weltweit, über das Roche-Unternehmen zusammenarbeiten, um die Zukunft der Medizin zu gestalten. Als Global Therapeutic Area Head (TAH), Neurologie, Immunologie und Infektionskrankheiten führen Sie groß angelegte, multidisziplinäre Teams, die aus direkten und indirekten Berichten bestehen, mit erheblichem Einfluss auf die allgemeine strategische, finanzielle und operative Leistung des Unternehmens. Sie leiten direkt ein Team von führenden Führungskräften, die für die Koordination und Verwaltung der frühen Pipeline und den Lebenszyklus von latenten und auf dem Markt verantwortlich sind; bieten globale, funktionsübergreifende Führung für alle Entwicklung, technische und kommerzielle Aktivitäten für alle Moleküle/Produkte in der Neurologie, Immunologie und Infektionskrankheiten. Sie werden ein stehendes Mitglied des GPS Leadership Teams sein und maßgebliche Beiträge zur Weitsicht, Strategie und Pläne für GPS und Roche Pharma insgesamt leisten. Sie sind Co-Vorsitzender für relevante Therapeutic Area (TA) Governance Boards (Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsboards / TAH-Meetings) und ein ständiges Mitglied verschiedener globaler Entscheidungsgremien wie dem Late-Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC). Wer bist du? Wir suchen einen Führer mit VACC-Attributen (Visionaire, Architekt, Coach, Catalyst), die sich unserer neuen Arbeitsweise verpflichtet. Sie sind authentisch und selbstbewusst, leidenschaftlich über das große Bild, innovative Wissenschaft und Ergebnisse zu erzielen, während eine vielfältige und integrative Umgebung zu schaffen, die das Beste in den Menschen bringt. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten In dieser Position sind Sie in erster Linie für effektiv verantwortlich: - Definieren, Einstellen, Ausrichten und Übersehen der Umsetzung/Annahme der langfristigen Vision und der globalen Strategie für die vielfältigen therapeutischen Bereiche der Neurologie und Immunologie. - Führende Entwicklung und Durchführung einer robusten, integrierten und zusammenhängenden Vision und Therapeutic Area Strategic Plan, die individuelle globale Pipeline-, Krankheits- und Lebenszyklusstrategien und -pläne (einschließlich integrierter Lösungen, gegebenenfalls) für alle Assets/Indications/Disease-Bereiche in der Neurologie, Immunologie und Infektionskrankheiten umfasst. - Optimierung der Ressourcenzuweisung, um ein strategisches Portfolio und finanzielle Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten, sowohl innerhalb der Neurologie als auch im Bereich der Immunologie und des GPS. - Sicherstellung strenger kommerzieller Bewertungen der Phase I – III Ergebnisse und Bereitstellung von fachkundigen Erkenntnissen, strategischen Optionen und Empfehlungen an Führungskräfte und Strategische Portfolio-Komitees in Bezug auf therapeutische Flächenaktiva und ihr Marktpotenzial. - Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCTs), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DATs), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLTs) und Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, um Aktivitäten über Roche zu koordinieren, um eine globale und assoziierte Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten. - Die Teams für Neurologie und Immunologie sorgen für Asset-Führung, relevante kommerzielle Erkenntnisse und strenge analytische Unterstützung für Lizenzierung und andere Geschäftsentwicklungsaktivitäten. - Verantwortlich für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Immunology Pharma Portfolio Team (IPPT) und dem Neurology Pharma Portfolio Team (NPPT) Führungskräften, um die Umsetzung unserer TA- und DA-Strategien zu gewährleisten, einschließlich der Unterstützung strategischer Portfoliobetrachtungen, Gelegenheitsbeurteilungen und Trade-offs, und gleichzeitig die Förderung einer end-to-end TA-Kollaboration und -Community. - Co-Vorsitzende Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsräte und TAH-Meetings, um eine robuste und strenge Entscheidungsfindung im Bereich Asset und Programmebene zu gewährleisten. Als Co-Vorsitzender in den Entwicklungs- und Wirtschaftsräten spielt die TAH eine wichtige Rolle bei der Steuerung von Vermögenswerten durch ihren End-to-End-Lebenszyklus, indem sie technische Ausführung mit kommerzieller Strategie überbrücken. Im Entwicklungsboard stellen Sie sicher, dass Programme die Kriterien "Bar" erfüllen. A
descriptionByLocale.fr: La position Qui nous sommes La stratégie mondiale des produits (GPS) stimule la stratégie Roches et son portefeuille de produits - de la recherche et du développement jusqu'aux patients. En tant que membre du GPS, vous ferez partie d'un groupe véritablement international qui collabore avec des fonctions et des affiliés dans le monde entier, à travers l'entreprise Roche, pour façonner l'avenir de la médecine. En tant que Responsable du Secteur Thérapeutique Mondial (TAH), Neurologie, Immunologie et Maladies Infectieuses, vous dirigerez des équipes multidisciplinaires à grande échelle, composées de rapports directs et indirects, avec une influence considérable sur la performance globale stratégique, financière et opérationnelle de l'entreprise. Vous dirigerez directement une équipe de cadres supérieurs responsables de la coordination et de la gestion du pipeline précoce et du cycle de vie des produits en retard et sur le marché; fournirez un leadership mondial et interfonctionnel pour toutes les activités de développement, techniques et commerciales de toutes les molécules/produits de la neurologie, de l'immunologie et des maladies infectieuses. Vous serez un membre permanent de l'équipe de leadership du GPS et apporterez une contribution importante à la vision, à la stratégie et aux plans à long terme du GPS et de Roche Pharma. Vous serez coprésident des conseils de gouvernance des domaines thérapeutiques pertinents (conseils d'affaires et de développement/réunions des TAH) et membre permanent de divers comités décisionnels mondiaux, comme le Comité du portefeuille en fin d'étape. Qui vous êtes Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader avec des attributs VACC (Visionaire, Architecte, Coach, Catalyst) qui est engagé dans nos nouvelles façons de travailler. Vous êtes authentique et conscient de vous-même, passionné par la vision d'ensemble, la science de pointe et l'obtention de résultats tout en créant un environnement diversifié et inclusif qui fait ressortir le meilleur des gens. Principales responsabilités Dans ce poste, vous serez principalement responsable : - Définir, mettre en place, aligner et superviser la mise en œuvre/l'adoption de la vision à long terme et de la stratégie globale dans les divers domaines thérapeutiques de la neurologie et de l'immunologie. - Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre d'une vision solide, intégrée et cohérente et d'un plan stratégique sur les domaines thérapeutiques, qui comprend des stratégies et des plans globaux individuels sur les domaines de la maladie et du cycle de vie (y compris des solutions intégrées, s'il y a lieu) pour tous les biens, les indicateurs et les maladies de la neurologie, de l'immunologie et des maladies infectieuses. - Optimiser l'allocation des ressources pour s'assurer que le portefeuille stratégique et les résultats financiers sont atteints, tant au sein de la neurologie et de l'immunologie que dans l'ensemble du GPS. - Assurer des évaluations commerciales rigoureuses des résultats de la Phase I – III et fournir aux cadres supérieurs et aux comités du portefeuille stratégique des connaissances spécialisées, des options stratégiques et des recommandations concernant les actifs thérapeutiques et leur potentiel commercial. - Catalyser les équipes de cycle de vie (ELD), les équipes de stratégie des régions de maladies (EAD), les équipes de leadership en commercialisation (ELD) et les équipes de planification intégrée du développement et de la commercialisation (PDIC) afin de coordonner les activités dans l'ensemble de Roche afin d'assurer l'alignement des activités à l'échelle mondiale et des filiales. - Veiller à ce que les équipes de neurologie et d'immunologie fournissent des conseils sur le leadership des actifs, des renseignements commerciaux pertinents et un soutien analytique rigoureux pour les licences et autres activités de développement des entreprises. - Responsable du partenariat avec l'équipe de portefeuille d'Immunology Pharma (IPPT) et les chefs de file de l'équipe de portefeuille de Neurology Pharma (NPPT) pour assurer la réalisation de nos stratégies d'AT et d'AD, y compris l'appui à des considérations stratégiques de portefeuille, des évaluations des possibilités et des compromis, tout en favorisant la collaboration et la communauté d'AT de bout en bout. - Coprésider les conseils d'affaires et de développement et les réunions du TAH pour assurer une prise de décision solide et rigoureuse au niveau des biens et des programmes. En tant que coprésident des Conseils de développement et d'affaires, le TAH joue un rôle essentiel dans la direction des actifs tout au long de leur cycle de vie en reliant l'exécution technique à la stratégie commerciale. Au conseil de développement, vous assurez que les programmes répondent aux critères « Bar ». A

jobs.title: Nurse Liaison Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein Team
Als Nurse Liaison Manager:in (NLM) wirst Du Teil unserer Disease Area Neuroimmunologie. In Deiner Rolle als Expert:in im Außendienst gestaltest Du die Zusammenarbeit mit der Nurses-Community sowie unseren Teams in Vertrieb, Medical und Marketing aktiv mit. Wir verstehen uns als verlässliche Partner für Behandelnde, um gemeinsam die bestmögliche Versorgung von Patient:innen mit Multipler Sklerose zu fördern.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Beratung & Schulung: Du informierst und schulst Nurses und Ärzte zur Anwendung von B-Zell- und IL6-Therapien, inkl. Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Komplikationsmanagement.

• Organisationsberatung: Du berätst Praxen und Kliniken bei der Optimierung von Ablauforganisationen rund um unsere Neuroimmunologie-Produkte.

• Digitale Lösungen: Du begleitest die Implementierung unserer CE-zertifizierten Medizinprodukte (z.B. Brisa) zur Therapieunterstützung.

• Eventmanagement: Du planst und gestaltest aktiv lokale Anwendertreffen, Best-Practice-Sharing-Konzepte und moderierst Workshops.

• Netzwerkarbeit: Du identifizierst Kundenbedürfnisse vor Ort und bringst Deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in das Disease Area Squad ein.

• Crossfunktionale Kooperation: Du arbeitest eng mit allen Vertretern der Customer Pacing Functions, Medical, Marketing und Patient Partnership Bereichen zusammen und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Account Plänen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger:in, Medizinische Fachangestellte oder vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 4 Jahre), idealerweise in der Neurologie.

• Erfahrung in der Therapie der Multiplen Sklerose (MS),insbesondere im Umgang mit MS-Patienten und Erfahrung im Management von Praxisabläufen und der Anleitung von Pflegekräften (Praxisanleiter:in)

• Medizinische Praxis: Sicherer Umgang mit Venenverweilkanülen, Durchführung von Infusionstherapien und Komplikationsmanagement.

• Zusatzqualifikation: Kenntnisse im Qualitätsmanagement (QSM) und Ausbildung zum Medizinprodukteberater sind von Vorteil.

• Hohe Sozialkompetenz, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist.

• Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace/MS Office sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente: Aktueller Lebenslauf. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Product Information Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Product Information/Labels Specialist you are responsible for projects within Global Labeling Near Patient Care.

The Opportunity:

• Responsible for generating, tracking, coordinating, evaluation, reporting metrics, scheduling, and managing project documentation according to policies and procedures.

• Reviews and maintains project related data ensuring that it is valid, accurate, and timely.

• Contributes independently or with a team towards project and departmental goals.

• Interfaces with internal customers and cross functional areas.

• Demonstrates strong communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills.

• Has the ability to multi-task and adjust rapidly to new priorities.

• Displays excellent organizational and analytical skills.

• Demonstrates competency in taking initiative.

• Work is varied and assists project managers.

Additional responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Opening of labeling jobs

• Distributing Labeling to appropriate systems.

• Writing and distribution of change orders

• Distribution of status reports

• Following up on project priorities

• Participating in team status meetings

• Supporting documentation preparation and processing

Who you are:

• University degree.

• Experience in a Regulatory Environment

• Attention to Detail

• Ability to work in a dynamic flexible work environment

• Building strong relationships with business partners

• Excellent Communication Skills-Written and Verbal

• Team oriented

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Indianapolis, is 55,40 0.00 - 102,800.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. jobs.title: Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Analyst
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai or Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

As an Senior Analyst, you will collaborate closely with the Strategic Analytics & Insights team based in the US, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads, and the broader GATE team. Your primary responsibility will be to deliver advanced analytics and actionable insights that support strategic priorities, ultimately aiming for the greatest impact with customers and patients.

Your Opportunity

• Lead complex projects and initiatives in pharma commercial operations, focusing on Brand Performance tracking, Disease Market Overview, Patient Journeys (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Forecasting, Product launch support and assessment, Patient adherence, Physician / Account Targeting, Payer Mix, Marketing Impact and ROIs

• Collaborate with Therapy area managers, Ecosystem insights leads and other business stakeholders to understand market dynamics and customer behaviors, leveraging this knowledge to support data-driven strategies

• Comprehend stakeholder requirements, prioritize tasks, and effectively manage day-to-day responsibilities, including liaising and coordinating with the GATE internal team for delivery

• Lead the team and stakeholder discussions, act as thought partner and provide them with high quality analytics solutions and recommendations

• Create impactful presentations to convey crucial insights and recommendations to stakeholders effectively

• Attend meetings with teams across different time zones to ensure smooth delivery of analytical & operations related requests for the business partners

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with broader organization, focus on outcomes that provide most business and patient value

• Be flexible to attend meeting during IST/PST overlapping working hours

• Provide mentorship and training to junior team members and interns on analytics principles and the Pharma domain, fostering the development of skill sets and capabilities

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor degree in Technology or a relevant discipline, with a preference for Computer Science, Software, Statistics, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and related fields and 4-8 years of analytics / consulting experience, with 2-5 years specifically in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics projects. Preferably, Master’s Degree or any certifications on analytics or data science would be an added advantage.

• Must demonstrate expertise in US Pharma Commercial Operations and possess a strong background in Sales analytics, Claims analytics, Product analysis, Patients analytics, forecasting and ROI analysis

• Experience with a range of secondary data sets, including IQVIA Sales data, 867 data, LAAD Claims, affiliations, field interactions, Veeva, medical data, and more, is a significant advantage

• Exposure to therapeutic areas like oncology, neurology, immunology, etc., along with a working knowledge of Salesforce or Veeva, is a valuable additional qualification

• Str

As a Senior Analyst – Medical Analytics, you will collaborate closely with Field analytics & Insights - Medical, U.S. Medical Affairs (USMA) teams. You will play a key role in enabling data-driven medical strategy and enhancing patient outcomes through advanced analytics.

Your Opportunity

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate scientific and business questions into analytical solutions and deliver high-quality outputs

• Create clear and impactful presentations to communicate complex clinical and scientific insights to stakeholders

• Act as a thought partner by delivering high-quality, scientifically grounded analytics solutions and recommendations

• Manage end-to-end project delivery, ensuring quality, timeliness, and stakeholder alignment

• Work across global teams and time zones to support business needs

• Mentor junior team members and contribute to capability building within the team

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in Technology, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine, Biostatistics, or a related discipline, with 4–8 years of analytics/consulting experience, including 2–5 years in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics. A Master’s degree is an added advantage

• Strong experience in Medical Analytics, real-world data analysis, clinical analytics, or outcomes research

• Hands-on experience working with healthcare datasets such as claims, EHR/EMR, clinical trials, and field medical interaction data

• Good understanding of U.S. Medical Affairs ecosystem, including Field Medical, Medical Networks, and Scientific Operations

• Proficiency in SQL and Excel, along with strong programming skills in Python, R, or SAS

• Experience in building data pipelines, automation workflows, and scalable analytical solutions

• Strong understanding of statistical techniques, data modelling, and analytical problem-solving

Sie werden eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Bereitstellung datengesteuerter medizinischer Strategie und der Verbesserung der Patientenergebnisse durch fortgeschrittene Analytik spielen. Ihre Chance
• Führen Sie komplexe Analytik-Initiativen, die medizinische Angelegenheiten in allen Bereichen wie Echtzeit-Datenanalyse, Patientenergebnisse, Behandlungswege, Pre & Post Launch Tracking, Kundenliste Generation und Krankheitsverlauf unterstützen
• Partner mit Teams von Field Medical und Medical Networks, um Erkenntnisse aus HCP/KOL-Verlobungsdaten zu generieren, die eine Optimierung von medizinischen Strategien und Feldeffektivität ermöglichen
• Entwicklung und Implementierung skalierbarer Datenpipelines, Automatisierungslösungen und analytischer Rahmenbedingungen zur Verarbeitung und Analyse großer Datenmengen im Gesundheitswesen
• Arbeiten an Analytik Nutzung von Fällen über HEOR, medizinische Folgenabschätzung, Patienten-Reiseanalyse und Gesundheitsequenzforschung
• Verwalten Sie verschiedene Datensätze wie Ansprüche, EHR/EMR, klinische Studiendaten und Interaktionsdaten (MSL/HCP-Eingriffe) zur Ableitung von handlungsfähigen Erkenntnissen
• Mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, um wissenschaftliche und geschäftliche Fragen in analytische Lösungen umzusetzen und qualitativ hochwertige Outputs zu liefern
• Erstellen Sie klare und effektvolle Präsentationen, um komplexe klinische und wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse an die Interessengruppen zu vermitteln
• Aktivieren Sie als Gedankenpartner durch Bereitstellung hochwertiger, wissenschaftlich fundierter Analyselösungen und Empfehlungen
• Verwalten Sie End-to-End-Projekt-Lieferung, Gewährleistung von Qualität, Aktualität und Stakeholder-Ausrichtung
• Arbeiten Sie über globale Teams und Zeitzonen, um die Geschäftsanforderungen zu unterstützen
• Mentor Junior-Team-Mitglieder und Beitrag zum Leistungsbau im Team Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Technologie, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medizin, Biostatistik oder eine verwandten Disziplin, mit 4–8 Jahren Analytik/Beratung Erfahrung, einschließlich 2–5 Jahre in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare-Analyse. Ein Master-Abschluss ist ein zusätzlicher Vorteil
• Starke Erfahrung in der Medizinanalytik, Echtzeit-Datenanalyse, klinische Analytik oder Ergebnisforschung
• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Gesundheitsdatensätzen wie Patentansprüchen, EHR/EMR, klinische Studien und Feldmedizinische Interaktionsdaten
• Gutes Verständnis des Ökosystems der US-Arzneimittel, einschließlich Field Medical, Medical Networks und Scientific Operations
• Vorteile in SQL und Excel, zusammen mit starken Programmierkenntnissen in Python, R oder SAS
• Erfahrung im Aufbau von Datenpipelines, Automatisierungs-Workflows und skalierbaren Analyselösungen
• Starkes Verständnis von statistischen Techniken, Datenmodellierung und analytischer Problemlösung
• Exposition gegenüber therapeutischen Bereichen wie Onkologie, Immunologie, Neurologie usw. wird bevorzugt
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und Präsentation Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist - Cincinnati, OH
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Location: Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana and West Virginia (Ideal candidate to live south west of Cincinnati around the 71/75 corridor)
Travel: 100% in assigned territory.

This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative
diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success, and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity
The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies. Product Responsibility: Clinical chemistry, Immunoassay and lab automation.

• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.

• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.

• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.

• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.

• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.

• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.

• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a field based role.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Ba

jobs.title: Global Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As part of the Project Management Chapter, the Global Project Manager (GPM) plays a key role in optimized product delivery and is accountable for all project management aspects of various projects from simple to complex in nature. Drives the project/product from the original concept through completion by developing and directing detailed work plans, schedules, project estimates, spending, resource plans, and status reports. As a trusted advisor, the Global Project Manager translates and drives projects into products and enables the organization to use energy and time effectively and efficiently while quickly responding to changing business needs across the portfolio.

The Opportunity:

• You will own project/program/product structures for Companion Diagnostics (CDx) product development & product care activities including communication management, timelines, resource and budget plans, progress and cost control, and risk management.

• You will create, coordinate, and maintain integrated project plans including dependencies, resources and budgets, allowing the teams to work efficiently and effectively. You are accountable for quality implementation in projects in the following areas: Project risk management; Critical path analysis; Scenario creation and analysis; Budget; Robust planning.

• You will proactively own and drive integrated project plans including dependencies, resources and budgets allowing the teams to work efficiently and effectively.

• You will execute project management processes including guiding and managing preparation for milestone reviews, capacity reviews (cQCR, SCR & fQCR), etc., as applicable & may lead improvement initiatives. You will follow best practices in project/product teams and foster continuous improvement by sharing best practices and knowledge among peers.

• You will select project methodology and apply agile methods as appropriate, including coaching and guiding teams in project methodology, including agile practices (with Project/Program Leads or PMC management if appropriate). You have expertise in working in a hybrid Agile role, combining Agile methods (usually within the project/product team) with non-Agile techniques (usually needed with partners and some functions).

• You will establish, measure, and report the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), standard metrics, Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) or Outcome Based Planning (OBPs) key results for projects enabling teams and functions to measure and improve quality, efficiency and effectiveness.

• You will act as a trusted advisor with a 360° view on all levels to advise and support the project/product teams as well as the broader organization in the holistic planning; project risk management; scenario creation as well as critical path analysis with the aim to ensure an optimized value delivery. You will serve as a single point of contact & control for project and program data collected from the functions.

• You will lead project team meetings and foster knowledge sharing between project/product teams and sub-chapters to enhance project effectiveness and optimized delivery.

• You will identify project risks and describe potential implications for budget, timeline and scope. You will identify ga

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Support Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role leads the design and implementation of the supply chain and ordering strategy for some of our most strategic accounts. It operates at the intersection of the customers’ supply chain priorities, internal operational excellence, and technological innovation. You will serve as the bridge between complex technical solutions and our clients' operational realities, transforming customer requirements into proactive, market-leading supply chain solutions.

The Opportunity
Coordinates, monitors and maintains oversight of material supply for strategic large customer accounts. Defines and recommends initiatives for continuous improvement and best practice implementation focused on creating value added solutions through collaboration with key internal business areas and internal/external program stakeholders.
Coordinates and applies the fundamental concepts, practices and procedures of the particular field of specialization. Represents the large customer supply team through external, customer facing opportunities. Does not typically supervise people but may have significant responsibility for process and oversight of day to-day operations. Requires in depth knowledge of various processes and functions. Generally, requires an advanced education or training, plus experience with a minimum of 2 supply chain functions such as supply planning, demand planning, order management, warehousing or transportation. Direct customer facing experience preferred.

• Balances the voice of the customer with supply chain objectives to deliver a market leading customer experience.

• Coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to develop and execute strategies which create value added solutions.

• Builds strong internal and external partnerships to deliver on supply chain objectives, strategy and measures.

• Direct order-to-invoice support including the ability to partner with strategic customers to facilitate solutions that deliver operational excellence from order placement to delivery.

• Leads/Participates in process improvement initiatives including optimizing the customer journey touchpoints. Develops or assists in the creation of departmental protocols. May assist in training and mentoring support staff.

• Ability to translate business processes into strategic value stream opportunities that directly impact the customer experience.

• Executes and manages support functions and databases (Customer by Demand Report, Open Orders, SAP, and others as needed).

• Executes reporting. Supports requests for information regarding customer performance, volume, inventory and other inquiries.

This position is based out of the Indianapolis Roche site and onsite presence needed.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of two (2) years of relevant business experience.

• Experience with supply chain functions (e.g., supply planning, demand planning, order management, warehousing, or transportation).

• Direct customer-facing experience in a consulting, advisory, or strategic support role is preferred.

• Hands-on experience or working knowledge of AI, automation, and continuous improvement consulting is highly preferred.

Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal Strategic Customer Support Consultant

• Strong computer and analytical skills with competence in both Microsoft and Google Suites, SAP applications, and Smartsheet.

• Strong communication skills (oral and written), including presentation skills, collaborative problem solving, and analytical

jobs.title: Environmental Health and Safety Technician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As an EHS Technician, you support the Manufacturing and R&D functions of GenMark Diagnostics across all Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) matters. Under general supervision, you perform technical duties including hazardous waste disposal, office ergonomics, and the maintenance of site SHE documentation. You serve as a key resource, providing safety expertise and guidance to site leadership

The Opportunity

• Assisting in maintaining corporate safety standards and policies, adapting to changes, and ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations by creating and maintaining safety records, data, and files.

• Supporting the safety supervisor in implementing policies, procedures, and training, including ergonomic assessments, industrial hygiene surveys, evacuation drills, facility inspections, and handling and disposal of hazardous chemicals and medical waste.

• Coordinating, conducting, and participating in regular safety meetings, such as Emergency Response Team meetings, while managing and maintaining required documentation.

• Utilizing and updating company-specific SHE Data Management Software, Work Order systems, and Preventive Maintenance software to support safety operations efficiently.

• Assisting with incident investigations, follow-up on corrective actions, and thorough documentation of safety/environmental/equipment-related incidents.

• Developing metrics, creating data summaries, and preparing communications for leadership reporting to facilitate informed decision-making.

• Performing additional tasks as assigned, contributing to a wide range of safety and environmental health responsibilities essential to the position.

Who You Are

• You bring a minimum of 1 year of experience in an EHS-specific role.

• If you have two years of college courses completed in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or another technical degree, that's preferred

• CPR, AED and First Aid Instructor Certification are preferred

Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Knowledge of Emergency Action and Emergency Response Plans, including recurring training and drills

• Self-directed and demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple projects and prioritize. You are a trusted partner and can influence within a complex and collaborative organization.

• You bring technical skills with the ability to explain complex issues and requirements verbally and in writing in an easily understood manner. Proficient in computer skills.

• Interpersonal and cross-cultural skills; willingness to work flexible hours

Relocation Benefits are not offered for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position, based on California is 40,200.00.- 74,600.00 USD annually. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
GenMark is now a proud member of the Roche Group, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. As a global leader in healthcare, Roche Diagnostics offers a broad portfolio of products, tools and services that help in the prevention, diagnosis and management of diseases like HPV, HIV, hepatitis and diabetes as well as other medical conditions, such as fertility and blood coagulation.

A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

The Head of Service and Support manages the day-to-day operations of the service team to effectively execute after-sales support strategies and objectives to deliver customer experience beyond expectations.

Key 
• Responsibilities include

a) Leads and manages the service team’s overall activities by implementing effective strategies and detailed plans aligned with company objectives.
b) Ensures all initiatives are properly executed in accordance with the strategies set by the GCS.
c) Align the strategy to operational process, and people resulting in a great customer experience
d) Provides technical information to Sales and Marketing for Roche projects across all stages of the buying cycle.
e) Implement Regional and Global initiatives as relevant
f) Serves as a core member of the DLT in an advisor capacity to the team and helps to set the direction of the Customer Services team with a special emphasis on how and what to implement to achieve current and future direction.
g) Responsible for planning the budget of the service team.
h) Oversees management and maintains inventory of relevant spare parts at an acceptable level
i) Ensure all service activities of the service team are promptly encoded into customer relationship management (CRM)

Organizational Relationship
a) Liaises with other affiliates in APAC/Global for technical initiatives and support requirements of the team.
b) Drive the culture of collaboration across the stakeholders
c) Maintain key partners, companies, distribution partners, etc.
d) Develop and implement strategies to build a customer-centric culture in the team.

Team Management
a) Coaches and motivates the team to perform all duties and responsibilities to resolve key internal and external challenges.
b) Ensure skills enhancement of the service team (direct and distributor teams) regarding required technical capabilities.
c) Long-term strategic planning of excellent customer experience, cost reduction, and team efficiency.

SHE 
• Responsibilities:
● Promote awareness and participation to Security, Safety, Health and Environmental Protection policies and programs at site to create a safe work environment to all employees.

Quality / Regulatory 
• Responsibilities:
● Ensure full compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and perform activities following global Roche quality standards and local SOPs.

Liaises with
● External customer, distributors, and suppliers
● Relevant internal team members, including Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and other Departments /areas as required
● External Relevant Company, Distribution Partner, etc.
● APAC and Global team for service support, updates, and inquiries relevant to the team

● Bachelor's Degree in Science or Engineering with substantial multinational companies' experience in Diagnostics industry preferred
● A manager's manager with minimum 5 years of experience in leading and managing a large service team in a similar industry
● Computer Skills (Microsoft Office Application and or Google Productivity Tools)
● Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English (spoken and written)
● Strong leadership skills and a team player
● Analytical, precise, pragmatic, enthusiastic, result-oriented, and

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe that delivering innovative healthcare solutions starts with reliable and high-quality customer support. As a Field Service Engineer, you will play an important role in ensuring healthcare professionals and laboratories can operate with confidence, helping support better outcomes for patients across Indonesia.

Your Opportunity
As a Field Service Engineer based in Malang, you will be responsible for delivering technical service and engineering support across Roche Diagnostics’ laboratory network. You will support instrument installation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and after-sales service activities to ensure optimal system performance and customer satisfaction.
In this role, you will:

• Perform installation, troubleshooting, corrective maintenance, and preventive maintenance for Roche Diagnostics analytical systems within the assigned territory

• Conduct pre-installation inspections and ensure all installations are completed according to Roche quality and compliance standards

• Deliver responsive and high-quality technical support to minimize instrument downtime and customer complaints

• Manage and maintain accurate service documentation, including CRM updates, service reports, territory reports, and expense documentation

• Handle customer inquiries and technical complaints in accordance with Roche procedures and applicable SOPs

• Ensure proper spare parts management and inventory accuracy to support operational excellence

• Collaborate closely with internal teams and customers to maintain strong service relationships and support continuous improvement initiatives

Who you are
You are a proactive and customer-focused technical professional who enjoys solving problems and working in a dynamic field-based environment. You are able to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with internal stakeholders and customers.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Electromedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related technical fields. Candidates with an Associate Degree (D3/D4) in Teknik Elektromedik or related technical fields are also encouraged to apply, particularly those with strong hands-on technical experience in the diagnostics, medical device, or healthcare industry

• Minimum 2 years of experience in technical service, field service engineering, or equipment maintenance, preferably within the medical diagnostics, healthcare, or medical device industry

• Strong troubleshooting capability and hands-on technical experience in supporting laboratory or medical equipment

• Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and basic English proficiency, both written and verbal

• Computer literacy and familiarity with computer networking concepts

• Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and adapt in a fast-paced customer-focused environment

• Willingness to be based in Malang and travel within the assigned territory as required

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambi

jobs.title: (Sr.) Specialist, LS & ASAT, Biologics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is hiring for a greenfield facility in Shanghai and we are looking for Lab Support & ASAT SME, for who takes responsibility for equipment/systems qualification and validation, sample and testing material management and other lab supporting processes. Also provides support during the project, operation readiness and start-up phase and liaises across the design, construction, qualification of the QC area, ensuring they meet the intended standard and regulation requirements.
Strong skill and experience are required to cover two areas: Greenfield project and Routine Operation management.

• The role supports on the equipment/system qualification and validation, sample/material management and QC operation readiness and start up.

• Work independently and with a level of autonomy and authority in efficient execution to ensure on-going compliance against approved global/local procedure documents, current Good Manufacturing Practices, and CN/EU Annex-1 during the product lifecycle.

• Enable and self-motivate, and demonstrate leadership behavior and mindset

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the qualification, validation, calibration and maintenance activities for relevant equipment with Roche’s QMS and regulatory guidelines.

• Set up master data according to business requirements and ensure data integrity.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Lab Support to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.

• Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to internal investigations and regulatory inspectors. Accomplish sample and testing materials management(eg account management, DI assessment), to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time. Report the abnormal status, deviations to supervisors with initiative.

• By identifying abnormal status and unexpected results during routine operation by detailed data, support to alert supervisors to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Equipment qualification and validation: Support and execute the equipment qualification and validation for the aseptic product.

• Sample and material management: Execute GMP sample management; Execute material inventory management.

• Digital system deployment: Support and ensure on time delivery for QC digital system(eg.LIMS).

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies

• 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred

• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and physical and chemical testing.

• Experienced in QC new system startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Fluent communications skills in English

• Project management skills are preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future dri

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称：（高级）治疗领域专员

您是谁：
（高级）治疗领域专员是公司与相应疾病领域医生的主要接触点,发掘和管理内外部资源,通过各种学术活动、推广或非推广活动把罗氏的专业知识、科学和技术、产品关键信息带入生态系统,准确及时的传达给客户,并与客户和合作伙伴共同发现潜在的合作机会,以改善对患者旅程的影响,实现患者最终获益。

您的机会：
客户管理
1. 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士(HCP)观念、学术需求
2. 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

学科建设
1. 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程
2. 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

计划管理
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2.了解医生观念、需求、会议安排;制定会议及覆盖计划;执行会议计划;回访收集反馈

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
1. 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变,实现规范化诊疗
2. 和患者解决方案经理协同合作,关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
1. 成为产品和疾病领域的专家
2. 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

我们期待这样的您加入：
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
•3 年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
