jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) unifies Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) efforts to leverage data and AI for innovative medicines.

Within CoE, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) modernizes computational and data ecosystems. The Engineering - AI Enablement group, within DDC, drives AI adoption, builds and deploys AI solutions to optimize workflows, scales model training and inference, and creates applications to accelerate drug discovery. They aim to make AI/ML an everyday utility for tasks from data analysis to documentation.

The pRED-MLOps team within the AI Enablement group enables large-scale, reliable AI/ML solutions across the early development pipeline, providing a state-of-the-art platform for developing, deploying, and monitoring high-impact models to accelerate drug discovery. The team is cross-functional, impact driven, independent, and constantly evolving to meet the scientific needs.

The Opportunity

• VibeOps Research and Prototyping: Research best practices, tools, and methodologies for applying VibeOps workflows in MLOps environments, with a focus on productivity, efficient cross-functional collaboration, and secure self-service, as well as an emphasis on understanding risks, limitations, and trade-offs

• Prototype small-scale solutions, focusing on VibeOps concepts and best practices, tools, and methodologies, within realistic MLOps contexts. The goal is experimentation, not production deployment. Additionally, develop benchmarks to validate the correctness of these prototypes.

• Propose actionable steps for integrating "VibeOps" principles into our MLOps practices and tooling as future directions, to support secure, scalable self-service adoption over time.

• ML Platform Development: Assist in developing and documenting tools, pipelines, and frameworks that enhance the MLOps lifecycle (e.g., inference store integration, automated monitoring hooks, drift detection mechanisms) with an emphasis on self-service enablement for ML Engineers and Data Scientists.

• AI Infrastructure Modernization: Contribute to the design, implementation, and optimization of modern infrastructure components (e.g., containerization, orchestration, distributed computing) to improve model training/inference speed, deployment reliability, and resource efficiency, specifically through a self-service lens.

• Collaboration: Work closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and IT infrastructure specialists, translating cutting-edge research into practical, scalable self-service solutions

Who You are

• You are an enrolled Master student or you have graduated as a Bachelor- or Master student within 12 months in Computer Science, Biotechnology or related field

• Experience in Python and experience with scripting/automation (e.g. Bash).

• Basic understanding of LLMs and Generative AI concepts, including prompts, context, limitations, and failure modes.

• Strong interest in Machine Learning Operations, DevOps principles.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, self-motivated approach to tackling complex challenges.

• Some experience with MLOps platforms/tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker).

• Some familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub, Jenkins).

• Interest or exposure to Agentic AI concepts, such as tool calling, agent orchestration, or interoperability patterns (e.g., MCP).

• Some foundational knowledge of cloud

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta della droga. Il nuovo Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) unifica Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) gli sforzi per sfruttare i dati e l'IA per i farmaci innovativi. All'interno di CoE, il Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) modernizza gli ecosistemi computazionali e dati. Il gruppo Engineering - AI Enablement, all'interno del DDC, guida l'adozione di AI, costruisce e distribuisce soluzioni AI per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro, scala la formazione e l'inferenza del modello e crea applicazioni per accelerare la scoperta della droga. Essi mirano a rendere AI/ML un'utilità quotidiana per le attività dall'analisi dei dati alla documentazione. Il team di pRED-MLOps all'interno del gruppo AI Enablement consente soluzioni AI/ML affidabili su larga scala in tutto il processo di sviluppo precoce, fornendo una piattaforma all'avanguardia per lo sviluppo, la distribuzione e il monitoraggio di modelli ad alto impatto per accelerare la scoperta della droga. Il team è interfunzionale, guidato da impatto, indipendente e in continua evoluzione per soddisfare le esigenze scientifiche. L'opportunità
• VibeOps Research and Prototyping: Migliori pratiche di ricerca, strumenti e metodologie per l'applicazione dei flussi di lavoro di VibeOps in ambienti MLOps, con un focus sulla produttività, una collaborazione interfunzionale efficiente e un self-service sicuro, nonché un'enfasi sulla comprensione dei rischi, limitazioni e compromessi
• Prototipo di soluzioni su piccola scala, concentrandosi sui concetti di VibeOps e sulle migliori pratiche, strumenti e metodologie, all'interno di contesti MLOps realistici. L'obiettivo è la sperimentazione, non la distribuzione della produzione. Inoltre, sviluppare benchmark per convalidare la correttezza di questi prototipi.
• Proporre misure attuabili per integrare i principi "VibeOps" nelle nostre pratiche MLOps e strumenti come direzioni future, per supportare l'adozione di self-service sicuro e scalabile nel tempo.
• Sviluppo della piattaforma ML: Assistere nello sviluppo e nella documentazione di strumenti, tubazioni e framework che migliorano il ciclo di vita MLOps (ad esempio, integrazione del negozio di inferenza, ganci di monitoraggio automatizzati, meccanismi di rilevamento della deriva) con l'accento sulla abilitazione self-service per gli ingegneri ML e gli scienziati dati.

• Collaborazione: lavorare a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri ML, gli scienziati dei dati e gli specialisti delle infrastrutture IT, traducendo la ricerca all'avanguardia in soluzioni pratiche e scalabili di self-service Chi sei
• Sei uno studente di Master iscritto o ti sei laureato come studente di Bachelor o Master entro 12 mesi in Informatica, Biotecnologia o campo relativo
• Esperienza in Python e esperienza con scripting/automazione (ad esempio Bash).
• Comprensione di base dei concetti LLM e AI Generativi, inclusi i suggerimenti, il contesto, le limitazioni e le modalità di fallimento.
• Forte interesse per le operazioni di apprendimento automatico, i principi DevOps.
• Forte capacità di problem solving e un approccio proattivo e automotivato per affrontare sfide complesse.
• Una certa esperienza con piattaforme/tool MLOps (ad esempio, MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker).
• Una certa familiarità con i gasdotti CI/CD (ad esempio, GitLab CI, GitHub, Jenkins).
• Interessi o esposizione ai concetti di AI Agentic, come la chiamata degli strumenti, l'orchestrazione dell'agente o i modelli di interoperabilità (ad esempio, MCP).

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) unifies Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) efforts to leverage data and AI for innovative medicines. Within CoE, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) modernizes computational and data ecosystems. The Engineering - AI Enablement group, within DDC, drives AI adoption, builds and deploys AI solutions to optimize workflows, scales model training and inference, and creates applications to accelerate drug discovery. They aim to make AI/ML an everyday utility for tasks from data analysis to documentation. The pRED-MLOps team within the AI Enablement group enables large-scale, reliable AI/ML solutions across the early development pipeline, providing a state-of-the-art platform for developing, deploying, and monitoring high-impact models to accelerate drug discovery. The team is cross-functional, impact driven, independent, and constantly evolving to meet the scientific needs. The Opportunity
• VibeOps Research and Prototyping: Research best practices, tools, and methodologies for applying VibeOps workflows in MLOps environments, with a focus on productivity, efficient cross-functional collaboration, and secure self-service, as well as an emphasis on understanding risks, limitations, and trade-offs
• Prototype small-scale solutions, focusing on VibeOps concepts and best practices, tools, and methodologies, within realistic MLOps contexts. The goal is experimentation, not production deployment. Additionally, develop benchmarks to validate the correctness of these prototypes.
• Propose actionable steps for integrating "VibeOps" principles into our MLOps practices and tooling as future directions, to support secure, scalable self-service adoption over time.
• ML Platform Development: Assist in developing and documenting tools, pipelines, and frameworks that enhance the MLOps lifecycle (e.g., inference store integration, automated monitoring hooks, drift detection mechanisms) with an emphasis on self-service enablement for ML Engineers and Data Scientists.
• AI Infrastructure Modernization: Contribute to the design, implementation, and optimization of modern infrastructure components (e.g., containerization, orchestration, distributed computing) to improve model training/inference speed, deployment reliability, and resource efficiency, specifically through a self-service lens.
• Collaboration: Work closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and IT infrastructure specialists, translating cutting-edge research into practical, scalable self-service solutions Who You are
• You are an enrolled Master student or you have graduated as a Bachelor- or Master student within 12 months in Computer Science, Biotechnology or related field
• Experience in Python and experience with scripting/automation (e.g. Bash).
• Basic understanding of LLMs and Generative AI concepts, including prompts, context, limitations, and failure modes.
• Strong interest in Machine Learning Operations, DevOps principles.
• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, self-motivated approach to tackling complex challenges.
• Some experience with MLOps platforms/tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker).
• Some familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub, Jenkins).
• Interest or exposure to Agentic AI concepts, such as tool calling, agent orchestration, or interoperability patterns (e.g., MCP).
• Some foundational knowledge of cloud

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Les progrès dans l'IA, les données et les sciences informatiques transforment la découverte de médicaments. Le nouveau Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CoE) unifie les efforts de Genentech (gred) et de Pharma (PRED) pour exploiter les données et l'IA pour les médicaments innovants. Au sein du Conseil de l'Europe, le catalyseur numérique (DDC) modernise les écosystèmes informatiques et de données. Le groupe Engineering - AI Enablement, au sein de DDC, stimule l'adoption de l'IA, construit et déploie des solutions d'IA pour optimiser les flux de travail, évaluer la formation et l'inférence des modèles, et crée des applications pour accélérer la découverte de médicaments. Ils visent à faire de l'IA/ML une utilité quotidienne pour les tâches, de l'analyse des données à la documentation. L'équipe pRED-MLOps au sein du groupe AI Enablement permet de trouver des solutions d'IA/ML fiables à grande échelle dans les premiers stades de développement, fournissant une plate-forme de pointe pour développer, déployer et surveiller des modèles à fort impact afin d'accélérer la découverte de médicaments. L'équipe est interfonctionnelle, axée sur l'impact, indépendante et en constante évolution pour répondre aux besoins scientifiques. L'occasion
• Recherche et prototypage VibeOps : recherche sur les meilleures pratiques, outils et méthodologies pour appliquer les workflows VibeOps dans les environnements MLOps, en mettant l'accent sur la productivité, la collaboration interfonctionnelle efficace et le libre-service sécurisé, ainsi que sur la compréhension des risques, des limites et des compromis
• Prototype de solutions à petite échelle, en mettant l'accent sur les concepts et les meilleures pratiques, outils et méthodologies VibeOps, dans des contextes MLOps réalistes. L'objectif est l'expérimentation, et non le déploiement de la production. De plus, élaborer des repères pour valider l'exactitude de ces prototypes.
• Proposer des mesures concrètes pour intégrer les principes "VibeOps" dans nos pratiques MLOps et l'outillage comme orientations futures, pour soutenir l'adoption en libre-service sécurisée et évolutive au fil du temps.
• Développement de plates-formes ML : aider à développer et documenter des outils, des pipelines et des cadres qui améliorent le cycle de vie des MLOps (par exemple, intégration de stockage d'inférence, crochets de surveillance automatisés, mécanismes de détection de dérive) en mettant l'accent sur l'habilitation en libre-service pour les ingénieurs ML et les data Scientists.
• Modernisation de l'infrastructure de l'IA : contribuer à la conception, à la mise en œuvre et à l'optimisation des composantes modernes de l'infrastructure (par exemple, conteneurisation, orchestration, calcul distribué) afin d'améliorer la vitesse de formation et d'inférence des modèles, la fiabilité du déploiement et l'efficacité des ressources, en particulier grâce à une lentille en libre-service.
• Collaboration: Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs de ML, des data scientists et des spécialistes de l'infrastructure informatique, traduisant la recherche de pointe en solutions en libre-service pratiques et évolutives Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un étudiant de Master inscrit ou vous avez obtenu votre diplôme de Bachelor- ou Master étudiant dans les 12 mois en Informatique, Biotechnologie ou domaine connexe
• Expérience en Python et expérience avec scripting/automation (par exemple Bash).
• Compréhension de base des LLM et des concepts d'IA Generative, y compris les invites, le contexte, les limitations et les modes d'échec.
• Intérêt pour les opérations d'apprentissage automatique, principes DevOps.
• Des compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et une approche proactive et automotivée pour relever les défis complexes.
• Une certaine expérience avec les plateformes/outils MLOps (par exemple MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker).
• Connaissance des pipelines CI/CD (p. ex. GitLab CI, GitHub, Jenkins).
• Intérêt ou exposition aux concepts d'IA Agentique, tels que l'appel d'outils, l'orchestration d'agents ou les modèles d'interopérabilité (p. ex. MCP).
• Une connaissance fondamentale du nuage

jobs.title: Customer Account Manager (North Region)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Customer Account Manager for our Managed Service Contracts in the North region, you will act as the vital link between Roche and our healthcare partners. You will ensure our customers receive a superior experience while bringing their voice directly into our organization to shape the future of diagnostics.

• Build meaningful partnerships: Develop and maintain long-term commercial relationships across all levels of your assigned customer base.

• Drive strategic value: Connect customer business goals with Roche’s product and service suite to support their success during periods of healthcare transformation.

• Lead service delivery: Co-create Strategic account plans and coordinate cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Technical Services) to ensure seamless execution.

• Manage the lifecycle: Oversee the full customer experience for our Optimall branded Managed Services, serving as the primary point of escalation for Roche and third-party partners.

• Foster a culture of excellence: Champion the "voice of the customer" internally to ensure we continue to "do now what patients need next."

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker and a passionate customer advocate who thrives on delivering value and building resilient commercial relationships.

• Experienced Account Manager: You bring a proven track record in contract management and commercial engagement within the healthcare sector.

• Strategic & Analytical: You possess the ability to interrogate large datasets to draw meaningful insights (Advanced Excel) and understand complex business workflows.

• Collaborative Leader: You are skilled at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously while working alongside experts in technical support, finance, and marketing.

• Effective Communicator: You are a strong listener who can identify pain points and develop clear solutions, maintaining a professional demeanor under pressure.

• Education: You are educated to degree level or equivalent in a relevant field.

Together, we’ll create a healthier, brighter future for all.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of Roche Products Ltd. At Roche Products we believe diversity drives innovation and we are committed to building a diverse and flexible working environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion or belief, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, disability or age. We recognise the importance of flexible working and will review all applicants’ requests with care. At Ro

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Diagnostics, we are redefining how we connect with customers globally. We are seeking a Solution Architect - Content Supply Chain & Web Experience to lead the technical evolution of our next-generation ecosystem. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in shaping modular, cloud-native, and AI-enabled customer engagement capabilities across global and local markets. You will work within a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment alongside product leads, engineers, and strategic partners to translate business capabilities into future-state architecture.

Your Responsibilities

• Shape Architecture Strategy: Define and maintain the target architecture, integration patterns, and technical guardrails for our Content Supply Chain and Web Experience capabilities.

• Design Scalable Solutions: Create reusable, secure, and compliant end-to-end architectures spanning content planning, creation, storage, activation, and real-time personalization.

• Lead Ecosystem Integration: Direct technical architecture across premiere platforms, including Adobe Experience Cloud (Sites, Assets, Workfront, GenStudio), Veeva Vault PromoMats, and advanced Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).

• Govern Technical Quality: Drive robust non-functional requirements including scalability, performance, security, and global compliance standards (such as GDPR).

• Collaborate and Guide: Partner closely with Technical Product Owners and engineering teams to validate technical designs, manage architectural dependencies, and ensure sustainable deliveries.

• Foster Innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies, championing proof-of-concepts in AI-enabled content operations, dynamic content assembly, and enterprise content intelligence.

Who You Are

• You are a forward-thinking technical leader who thrives on turning complex digital ecosystem challenges into simplified, high-performing platform realities.

• You excel at bridging the gap between business vision and deep technical engineering, utilizing your exceptional stakeholder management skills to influence distributed global teams.

• Extensive Architecture Experience: 8+ years of proven success in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or complex digital platform engineering.

• Ecosystem Mastery: Demonstrated experience designing, integrating, and scaling enterprise web content management, digital asset management (DAM), and dynamic personalization technologies.

• Modern Engineering Mindset: Strong, practical understanding of cloud-native architectures, API-first delivery, integration patterns, and composable platform ecosystems.

• Technical Governance & Compliance: Robust knowledge of navigating non-functional requirements like web security, accessibility, performance optimization, and international data privacy regulations.

• Academic Foundation: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

Mit seinen 1400 Mitarbeitenden stellt das Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst (PTM) die ununterbrochene Patientenversorgung mit qualitativ hochwertigen Medikamenten sicher. • Sicherstellung des Kommunikationsflusses (Schichtübergabe, Huddles, Teammeetings)

• Koordination von geplanten und ungeplanten Instandhaltungstätigkeiten inkl. Sicherstellung der korrekten Durchführung und Dokumentation

• Reduktion geplanter und ungeplanter technischer Downtimes

• Sicherstellung des qualifizierten und validierten Anlagenstatus bei der Durchführung von geplanten und ungeplanten Instandhaltungstätigkeiten

• Eigenverantwortliches Setzen von Prioritäten und treffen von Entscheidungen insbesondere zu Randzeiten

Wer du bist
Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du hast ein offenes Ohr für die täglichen Herausforderungen deiner Teammitglieder und bietest ihnen sowohl personelle als auch persönliche Hilfestellungen an. Als leidenschaftlicher und authentischer Coach förderst du gezielt die Stärken deiner Mitarbeitenden und stärkst das Vertrauen innerhalb des Teams durch Transparenz, Übergabe von Verantwortlichkeiten sowie eine offene Speak-Up- und Fehlerkultur.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Avec ses 1400 employés, le centre de production Kaiseraugst (PTM) assure des soins continus aux patients avec des médicaments de haute qualité. PTM représente les plus hauts standards de production pharmaceutique, le plus grand centre d'emballages, le plus innovant de Roche et l'approvisionnement de plus de 120 pays. Dans ce rôle, vous êtes un leader positif, intègre et auto-réfléchissant avec de solides compétences de communication. Vous avez une oreille ouverte pour les défis quotidiens de votre équipe, les soutenir à la fois professionnellement et personnellement et agir comme un entraîneur passionné. • Assurer une qualification complète de vos employés, y compris la création de plans approfondis et le perfectionnement professionnel continu
• Assurer le flux de communication (transfert de poste, rassemblements, réunions d'équipes)

• Réduction des temps d'arrêt techniques prévus et non prévus

• L'établissement des priorités et la prise de décisions, en particulier aux heures de pointe
• Traitement des changements techniques en tant que propriétaire de changement
• Préparation, suivi et remise à neuf de votre région lors des audits, inspections et visites du gouvernement Vous êtes une personnalité positive, intégrée et auto-réfléchissante avec de solides compétences communicatives. Vous avez une oreille ouverte pour les défis quotidiens des membres de votre équipe et leur offrir une aide personnelle et personnelle. En tant qu'entraîneur passionné et authentique, vous faites la promotion des forces de vos employés et renforcez la confiance au sein de l'équipe grâce à la transparence, au transfert des responsabilités ainsi qu'à une culture ouverte de Speak-Up et d'erreur. Vous apportez une forte passion pour le perfectionnement des employés et l'amélioration continue et créez un environnement dans lequel l'équipe peut traiter les commandes et prendre la responsabilité de ses processus. titleByLocale.it: Senior Procurement Manager - Clinical Ricerca Organizations (CROs)
titleByLocale.en: Senior Procurement Manager - Clinical Research Organizations (CROs)
titleByLocale.de: Senior Procurement Manager - Clinical Forschung Organizations (CROs)
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Procurement Manager - Clinical Recherche Organizations (CROs)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. .

As a Senior Procurement Manager in Clinical Research Organizations (CROs), you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in a specific category or spend areas and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category strategy owner in charge of driving, coordinating and signing the category strategy.

You will collaborate with internal procurement (such as Customer Excellence, Insights, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive category sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives.

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter expert in Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements and maximize the value for Roche.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and project management skills, and/or supporting team members by coaching them and enhancing their skills and knowledge.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing strategy into content and automated buying channels guidelines, best practices and communication materials that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a scientific related discipline.

• You have 7+ years of procurement experience in strategic sourcing, global category management, complex procurement contracting, and operational category efficiency projects, preferably in the Pharmaceutical industry.

• You have 10+ years of procurement experience in sourcing, simple contracting, category management, and operational efficiency projects or relevant related category experience.

• You possess strong and deep knowledge and have experience in the CRO Category, and other Research & Development categories such as Clinical Technologies, Laboratories, and other R&D commodity areas, strong knowledge of CRO and Research & Development adjacent commodities and overall understanding of other commodities.

• You also have deep knowledge and experience in supplier management, contract negotiations, cost optimization, market r

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Customer Logistics Managment Team for Direct Markets is part of the Global Supply Chain Operations & Logistics, a unit of Roche Pharma and thus a key partner for all 3rd party customers worldwide. We contribute to the timely delivery of safe, effective and high-quality medicine to external customers and patients while ensuring compliance with global quality and regulatory requirements.

Who You are

• Enrolled at a university, preferably in the field of supply chain management, business administration, life sciences (chemistry, biology, pharmacy), IT / computer science or another degree, or you completed your studies within the last 12 months prior to the start date.

• Interested in ERP and supply chain systems landscape

• Excited about supporting patients worldwide to get the medicine they need

• Capable to manage standard analysis and presentation software (Excel, PowerPoint, gSuite, lucid chart and smart sheet) with ability to organize and visualize data

• Open-minded and curious to learn new things

• You demonstrate the ability to build up a network or international relationship

• You have a high degree of self-management

• English language skills are mandatory and German language skills are a great plus

Moreover, You are:

• Excited about working in SAP and OMP (order entry, delivery creation, invoicing)

• Capable of working with Google tools and lucid chart for creating process flows

• Managing the internship cycle: Supporting the hiring process of new interns, Onboarding/Training and handover the tasks to the new internship

Technical Details:

Please upload your curriculum vitae and your motivation letter specific to this position.

Due to regulations, Non-Swiss/EU/EFTA citizens (m/f/n) must enclose a confirmation from the university with the application documents that a compulsory internship is part of the internship.

Start: 1st July/ August 2026 or according to agreement, ideally for 12 months in Kaiseraugst (CH).

This position is suitable for students looking for a full-time internship, however working in part-time (at least 32 hours a week) is also possible.

Preparing your final thesis during this internship could also be supported.

If you are proud of contributing and feel you have the dedication to teamwork and innovation that we are seeking, then Roche is the organization for you. Every role at Roche plays a part in making a difference to patients’ lives. If you want to work in a passionate team, make your mark & improve lives, apply now!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità Il Customer Logistics Managment Team for Direct Markets fa parte del Global Supply Chain Operations & Logistics, un'unità di Roche Pharma e quindi un partner chiave per tutti i clienti di terze parti in tutto il mondo. Contribuiamo alla consegna tempestiva di farmaci sicuri, efficaci e di alta qualità a clienti e pazienti esterni, garantendo al contempo il rispetto della qualità globale e dei requisiti normativi. Chi sei
• Iscritti in un'università, preferibilmente nel campo della gestione della supply chain, dell'amministrazione aziendale, delle scienze della vita (chimica, biologia, farmacia), IT / informatica o un altro grado, o hai completato i tuoi studi negli ultimi 12 mesi prima della data di inizio.
• Interessato a ERP e sistemi di supply chain paesaggio
• Eccitato sul supporto dei pazienti in tutto il mondo per ottenere il farmaco di cui hanno bisogno
• Capacità di gestire l'analisi standard e il software di presentazione (Excel, PowerPoint, gSuite, grafico lucido e foglio intelligente) con la capacità di organizzare e visualizzare i dati
• Di mentalità aperta e curioso di imparare cose nuove
• Lei dimostra la capacità di costruire una rete o una relazione internazionale
• Hai un alto grado di autogestione
• Le competenze linguistiche in inglese sono obbligatorie e le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono un grande vantaggio Inoltre, Lei è:
• Eccitato sul lavoro in SAP e OMP (entrata d'ordine, creazione di consegne, fatturazione)
• Capacità di lavorare con strumenti Google e grafico lucido per la creazione di flussi di processo
• Gestione del ciclo di tirocinio: Sostenere il processo di assunzione di nuovi stagisti, Onboarding/Training e consegnare i compiti al nuovo stage Dettagli tecnici: Carica il tuo curriculum vitae e la tua lettera di motivazione specifica per questa posizione. A causa di regolamenti, i cittadini non svizzeri/UE/EFTA (m/f/n) devono chiudere una conferma dall'università con i documenti di domanda che uno stage obbligatorio fa parte dello stage. Inizio: 1° luglio/agosto 2026 o secondo accordo, idealmente per 12 mesi a Kaiseraugst (CH). Questa posizione è adatta per gli studenti alla ricerca di uno stage a tempo pieno, tuttavia è possibile lavorare in part-time (almeno 32 ore a settimana). Preparare la tesi finale durante questo stage potrebbe anche essere supportato. Se siete orgogliosi di contribuire e sentire avete la dedizione al lavoro di squadra e l'innovazione che stiamo cercando, allora Roche è l'organizzazione per voi. Ogni ruolo di Roche gioca una parte nel fare la differenza per la vita dei pazienti. Se vuoi lavorare in un team appassionato, fai il tuo segno e migliora le vite, applica subito! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.title: Drug Product (DP) Fleet Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As an integral part of Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) plays a key role in seamlessly leading global Capex projects from planning through execution by providing strong project management, technical expertise and project performance on time and on budget. Proactive maintenance, facility fitness and equipment support for the manufacturing network are adding to the mandate of PTT being PT`s powerhouse for technical product health.
The Drug Product (DP) Fleet Lead is a critical leadership role responsible for the end-to-end development, implementation, and operational management of standardized manufacturing systems across the Drug Product network. Reporting to the Global Fleet Program Owner, this role owns the development of the Drug Product Fleet concept, ensuring the "design one, build many" philosophy is executed to drive cross-site equivalency and unparalleled efficiencies.

The Opportunity
You serve as the enterprise-wide single point of ownership for the Drug Product aspect of the Global Manufacturing Standardization Strategy, accountable for its success across the network, and you own and drive the development of the Drug Product Fleet concept, establishing the specific standards for DP manufacturing systems to be deployed across the global network. Your main responsibilities are

• Define, own, and drive the multi-year global strategy and roadmap for the Drug Product Fleet concept and systems together with gMSAT Drug Product and the DP manufacturing sites and serve as the primary point of accountability for all DP-specific fleet systems, ensuring they meet the defined global standards for the production network. Hold ultimate accountability for ensuring and maintaining the equivalency of DP fleet equipment & systems throughout their entire lifecycle.

• Present the global operating budget (CAPEX and OPEX) and resource allocation for DP fleet system deployment and maintenance across the network.

• Lead and act as the primary point of contact (POC) for all outward-facing health authority interactions and inquiries (including leading Pre-Approval Inspections (PAIs) and major regulatory filings) that specifically concern Drug Product fleet systems.

• Ensure DP fleet equipment adheres strictly to global documents, including User Requirements Specifications (URS) and functional specifications. Own and maintain DP-specific lifecycle deliverables, including the Master Fleet Validation Master Plan (FVMP), Fleet SOPs, and URS and lead the analysis of proposed changes on DP fleet equivalency, ensuring consistent implementation across all affected DP sites.

• Conduct and oversee side-by-side comparative analyses of GMP-critical and process-critical aspects for DP equipment. Oversee the continuous monitoring of DP fleet performance, tracking critical process parameters (CPPs) and critical quality attributes (CQAs).

• Ensure that unplanned events or discrepancies impacting DP equipment are assessed for network-wide impact in collaboration with key stakeholders.

Who you are
You have a strong track record of leading change management processes in a highly regulated environment with a focus on cross-site impact and you bring the following qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Bioengineering), Life Sciences, or a related technical field; PhD is strongly preferred.

• A minimum of 15 years of experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, with a strong emphasis on D

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come parte integrante di Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) svolge un ruolo chiave nei progetti di Capex globali senza soluzione di continuità dalla pianificazione attraverso l'esecuzione, fornendo una forte gestione del progetto, competenze tecniche e prestazioni del progetto sul tempo e sul budget. Manutenzione attiva, idoneità impiantistica e supporto attrezzature per la rete di produzione stanno aggiungendo al mandato di PTT essendo la centrale elettrica PT per la salute dei prodotti tecnici. The Drug Product (DP) Fleet Lead è un ruolo di leadership fondamentale responsabile per lo sviluppo, l'implementazione e la gestione operativa dei sistemi di produzione standardizzati nella rete Drug Product. Segnalando al Global Fleet Program Owner, questo ruolo possiede lo sviluppo del concetto di Drug Product Fleet Fleet, assicurando che la filosofia "design one, costruire molti" sia eseguita per guidare l'equivalenza del sito e le efficienze senza precedenti. L'opportunità Lei funge da unico punto di proprietà aziendale per l'aspetto del prodotto Droga della strategia di standardizzazione globale di fabbricazione, responsabile per il suo successo in tutta la rete, e possiede e guida lo sviluppo del concetto di Drug Product Fleet, stabilendo gli standard specifici per i sistemi di produzione DP da implementare in tutta la rete globale. Le tue responsabilità principali sono
• Definire, possedere e guidare la strategia globale pluriennale e la roadmap per il concetto e i sistemi di Drug Product Fleet insieme a gMSAT Drug Product e ai siti di produzione DP e servire come punto primario di responsabilitÃ per tutti i sistemi di flotta specifici DP, garantendo di soddisfare gli standard globali definiti per la rete di produzione. Tenere la massima responsabilità per garantire e mantenere l'equivalenza delle attrezzature e dei sistemi della flotta DP durante tutto il loro ciclo di vita.
• Presentare il bilancio operativo globale (CAPEX e OPEX) e l'allocazione delle risorse per l'implementazione e la manutenzione del sistema DP in tutta la rete.
• Guidare e agire come punto primario di contatto (POC) per tutte le interazioni e le indagini dell'autorità sanitaria all'esterno (comprese le principali ispezioni pre-approvali (PAIs) e i principali dispositivi normativi) che riguardano specificamente i sistemi della flotta di prodotti farmaceutici.
• Assicurare che le attrezzature della flotta DP aderiscano strettamente ai documenti globali, comprese le specifiche dei requisiti degli utenti (URS) e le specifiche funzionali. Proprie e mantengono il ciclo di vita specifico DP, tra cui il Master Fleet Validation Master Plan (FVMP), Fleet SOPs e URS e condurre l'analisi delle modifiche proposte sull'equivalenza della flotta DP, garantendo una coerente implementazione in tutti i siti DP interessati.
• Condurre e supervisionare analisi comparative a lato degli aspetti critici e critici del processo GMP per le apparecchiature DP. Superare il monitoraggio continuo delle prestazioni della flotta DP, tracciare parametri critici di processo (CPP) e attributi di qualità critici (CQAs).
• Assicurarsi che gli eventi non pianificati o le discrepanze che influenzano le apparecchiature DP siano valutati per l'impatto su tutta la rete in collaborazione con i principali stakeholder. Chi sei Hai un forte track record dei principali processi di gestione dei cambiamenti in un ambiente altamente regolamentato con un focus sull'impatto cross-site e porti le seguenti qualifiche:
• Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria (Chemical, Meccanica, Bioingegneria), Scienze della Vita, o un campo tecnico correlato; PhD è fortemente preferito.
• Un minimo di 15 anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica/biotecnica, con una forte enfasi sulla D

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Die Position Als integraler Bestandteil von Pharma Technical Operations (PT) spielt die PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) eine Schlüsselrolle bei nahtlos führenden globalen Capex-Projekten von der Planung bis zur Ausführung, indem sie ein starkes Projektmanagement, technisches Know-how und Projektleistung im Zeit- und Budgetbereich bietet. Diese Rolle gehört der Entwicklung des Drug Product Fleet-Konzepts und stellt sicher, dass die "design one, build many"-Philosophie zum Antrieb von Cross-Site-Äquivalenz und unvergleichlichen Effizienzen ausgeführt wird. Die Chance Sie dienen als unternehmensweit einheitlicher Bezugspunkt für den Drug Product Aspekt der Global Manufacturing Standardization Strategy, der für seinen Erfolg im gesamten Netzwerk verantwortlich ist und Sie besitzen und die Entwicklung des Drug Product Fleet Konzepts vorantreiben, indem Sie die spezifischen Standards für DP-Produktionssysteme festlegen, die über das globale Netzwerk eingesetzt werden sollen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben sind
• Definieren, besitzen und fahren Sie die mehrjährige globale Strategie und Roadmap für das Drug Product Fleet-Konzept und -Systeme zusammen mit gMSAT Drug Product und den DP-Produktionsstandorten und dienen als primärer Bezugspunkt für alle DP-spezifischen Flottensysteme, um sicherzustellen, dass sie den definierten globalen Standards für das Produktionsnetzwerk gerecht werden. Halten Sie ultimative Rechenschaftspflicht für die Sicherstellung und Aufrechterhaltung der Gleichwertigkeit von DP-Flottenanlagen und -Systemen während ihres gesamten Lebenszyklus.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass DP-Flottenausrüstung streng auf globale Dokumente, einschließlich Benutzeranforderungen Spezifikationen (URS) und funktionale Spezifikationen haftet. • Nebenbei vergleichende Analysen von GMP-kritischen und prozesskritischen Aspekten für DP-Geräte durchführen und überwachen. Überwachen Sie die kontinuierliche Überwachung der DP-Flottenleistung, Verfolgung kritischer Prozessparameter (CPPs) und kritischer Qualitätsattribute (CQAs).

• Master-Abschluss in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Bioengineering), Life Sciences oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich; PhD ist stark bevorzugt.
• Mindestens 15 Jahre Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen/biotechnologischen Industrie, mit einem starken Schwerpunkt auf D

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que partie intégrante de Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) joue un rôle clé dans la direction transparente des projets globaux Capex, de la planification à l'exécution en fournissant une solide gestion de projet, une expertise technique et une performance de projet à temps et sur le budget. L'entretien proactif, la condition physique des installations et le soutien de l'équipement pour le réseau de fabrication ajoutent au mandat de PTT étant la centrale de PT pour la santé technique des produits. Le chef de la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques (PD) est un chef de file essentiel responsable de l'élaboration, de la mise en oeuvre et de la gestion opérationnelle des systèmes de fabrication normalisés dans l'ensemble du réseau de produits pharmaceutiques. Sous l'autorité du propriétaire du programme Global Fleet, ce rôle est responsable de l'élaboration du concept de la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques, en veillant à ce que la philosophie de la « conception, de construire beaucoup » soit mise en oeuvre pour favoriser l'équivalence entre les sites et l'efficacité inégalée. L'opportunité Vous servez de point de propriété unique à l'échelle de l'entreprise pour l'aspect Produit pharmaceutique de la Stratégie mondiale de normalisation de la fabrication, responsable de son succès dans l'ensemble du réseau, et vous possédez et dirigez le développement du concept de la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques, établissant les normes spécifiques pour les systèmes de fabrication PDD à déployer dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial. Vos principales responsabilités sont :
• Définir, posséder et piloter la stratégie et la feuille de route mondiales pluriannuelles pour le concept et les systèmes de la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques, en collaboration avec le produit pharmaceutique gMSAT et les sites de fabrication DP, et servir de point de responsabilisation principal pour tous les systèmes de flotte spécifiques à la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques, en veillant à ce qu'ils répondent aux normes mondiales définies pour le réseau de production. Tenir la responsabilité ultime d'assurer et de maintenir l'équivalence des équipements et systèmes de la flotte de PDD tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Présenter le budget global d'exploitation (CAPEX et OPEX) et l'allocation des ressources pour le déploiement et la maintenance du système PDD dans l'ensemble du réseau.
• Diriger et agir en tant que point de contact principal (POC) pour toutes les interactions et les demandes de renseignements des autorités sanitaires externes (y compris les inspections préalables à l'approbation (IPA) et les principaux dossiers réglementaires) qui concernent spécifiquement les systèmes de flotte de produits pharmaceutiques.
• Veiller à ce que les équipements de la flotte PDD respectent strictement les documents mondiaux, y compris les spécifications relatives aux exigences de l'utilisateur (URS) et les spécifications fonctionnelles. Posséder et maintenir des produits livrables propres au cycle de vie du PDD, y compris le plan directeur de validation de la flotte principale, les SOP de la flotte et l'URS, et diriger l'analyse des changements proposés sur l'équivalence du PDD, en assurant une mise en oeuvre uniforme dans tous les sites du PDD touchés.
• Mener et superviser des analyses comparatives côte à côte des aspects critiques des BPF et des processus pour les équipements PDD. Surveiller la surveillance continue du rendement du parc de PDD, le suivi des paramètres critiques du processus (PPC) et des attributs critiques de qualité (AQC).
• Veiller à ce que les événements imprévus ou les écarts ayant une incidence sur l'équipement du PDD soient évalués en fonction de l'impact à l'échelle du réseau, en collaboration avec les principales parties prenantes. Qui vous êtes Vous avez une solide expérience des processus de gestion du changement dans un environnement hautement réglementé, en mettant l'accent sur l'impact intersite et vous apportez les qualifications suivantes:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Finance Business Partner for Roche Diagnostics (internally known as Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP)), you'll play a pivotal role in driving the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) journey. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the financial health of our business while delivering market-leading customer experiences. You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to identify profitable commercial opportunities, improve contract performance, and ensure sustainable business outcomes.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the financial strategy, contract management, and performance insights within the network. You will collaborate across teams to ensure the success of our commercial pipeline and contribute to the development and execution of the annual business plan. By leveraging your expertise, you’ll ensure that our contracts are financially sustainable, competitive, and aligned with Roche Diagnostics' long-term goals.

The Opportunity:

• Lead the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) processes for a portfolio of contracts, ensuring financial sustainability. This includes modelling new tenders, extensions and amendments.

• Monitor and improve contract financial health in collaboration with customers

• Lead negotiations regarding complex contracts and dispute resolution.

• Contribute to the business planning process and actively participate in the regional network governance, aligning targets with the annual cycle.

• Support the commercial pipeline by balancing growth with profitability and timely cash generation, while driving sustainable commercial deals that consider risks, competitor assumptions, and pricing.

• Develop and partner key stakeholders, providing coaching and support, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and building trusted cross-functional partnerships to achieve shared objectives and co-lead critical affiliate business plan initiatives.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree (Upper Second Class or equivalent), a Master’s or MBA is preferred but not required.

• Strong, proven commercial finance experience, professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, ACA, or international equivalent) is preferred

• Excellent excel skills and experience with financial modelling

• You're a customer-centric professional, adept at delivering solutions that meet both client and business objectives.

• Experience in navigating complex Customer Relationships and Negotiations

• You excel at navigating complex, matrix organizations, fostering strong collaborative networks, and translating complex financial ideas into easily understandable insights.

• You embrace change as an opportunity, thrive in both independent and team environments, and are driven by results and continuous improvement.

• Fluent in English, you're passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences that drive business success.

This role is based onsite at our Burgess Hill office in West Sussex, United Kingdom.

Please upload only your current compelling CV and / or Cover Letter.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, en

titleByLocale.it: Gestione della filiale di sicurezza EMEA-LATAM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role:

The Security Affiliate Manager EMEA-LATAM will support affiliates with their product security needs by designing, coordinating, and governing a security network across our affiliates.

We are looking for someone with expertise in product security and direct experience working with customers in that field.

Your Responsibilities:

• Be an ambassador and evangelist for Roche Diagnostics product security to affiliates.

• Develop strong working relationships with key stakeholders within the regions and around the global organization.

• Design, coordinate, and govern a product security network across our affiliates consisting of colleagues who interface with customers on product security topics.

• Gather intake from affiliates on customer needs and expectations (e.g. data localization, support topics, etc.) to drive global product security & privacy strategy improvements.

• Support affiliates with their product security needs, e.g. hosting training sessions, Q&A’s and other materials to meet customer needs, join affiliates for customer meetings, etc.

• Make relevant product security information on products, services and ecosystem accessible to affiliates.

• Build the bridge between affiliate and global teams, e.g. by facilitating knowledge sharing between those (within PSPO, product teams, etc.), leading cross-functional projects to establish processes, drive implementation of product security changes, etc.

• Create and maintain a knowledge base of the most common product security questions to allow affiliates to respond faster to tenders/questionnaires.

• Gather product security-related metrics and provide report-outs to affiliates and management.

• Strong collaboration within the chapter and other PSPO chapters to ensure affiliate needs are tracked and served. Is considered as a reference for stakeholders and actively shares ideas and expertise and leads/moderates discussions.

• Enable affiliate leaders and customer-facing roles including commercial and service to achieve greater promotion on topics of security with customers.

Your Experience & Skills:

• BA/BS in Information Systems, Computer Science, or relevant area of study, required.

• Expertise in working directly with customers in the product security field is required.

• Commercial mindset.

• Fluent in English on a business level with excellent verbal and written skills; other languages welcome, but not required.

• Demonstrated proficiency in communicating security and privacy strategy, products, and ecosystems.

• Exceptional demonstration, presentation, and interpersonal communication (written and verbal) skills are essential.

• Highly influential relationship builder.

• Experience with compliance standards and regulatory mandates, security and privacy laws, regulations and standards.

• Goal-oriented individual, with proven positive leading in the matrix ability, strong business acumen, strong focus motivating and developing teams.

• EU residence/citizenship preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are Medical Affairs. We are transforming Medical practice together. We are accountable for the medical outside-in perspective at Roche and for ensuring that the science behind our products is communicated and understood amongst relevant HCPs at global scale, for whom we are a trusted partner. We collaborate across and strive in an integrated work environment with the affiliates, global development and global strategy. We help in driving the development, introduction, uptake and informed use of our innovative medicines and services in clinical practice and patient care worldwide. We create and evolve competencies, capabilities, and opportunities for our global Medical Network. We think ahead and leverage digital whenever possible.

The Opportunity

• You provide medical expertise to Breast Cancer and contribute to medical strategy components such as evidence generation, dissemination and medical insights as part of an integrated strategy.

• You contribute to or lead the planning and execution of evidence generation strategies relevant in the Breast Cancer area, based on medical and market access gaps, including clinical studies, Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS), real-world data, and scientific research collaborations by building purposeful networks with healthcare stakeholders across multiple cultures and countries.

• You generate integrated medical insights to inform strategies and plans and you provide medical and functional expertise to market access strategies and related operational plans.

• You lead the collaboration with key academic and clinical specialists worldwide to secure scientific and strategic input to our clinical development programs and to spar with them on the interpretation of our clinical trial results so that these can potentially create value for HCPs and benefit patients.

Who You Are
You hold an MD degree which is a highly preferred or advanced life-science degree (e.g. PhD or PharmD). A specialization degree or industry experience in Breast Cancer is a must. In addition, you have robust medical affairs and/or pharmaceutical medicine experience. Further, you bring:

• High Ethical Standards: You demonstrate integrity and compliance in all professional activities.

• Strategic Agility: You have the ability to make informed, strategic decisions effectively.

• Patient-Centric Approach: You prioritize patients in clinical development and medical practice activities.

• Launch Experience: Your experience with the launch of medical products or indications will drive successful product introduction.

Your expertise in Breast Cancer can drive change. Take the next step and help us deliver innovative medicines to patients worldwide. Apply now.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Inoltre, si dispone di robusti affari medici e / o medicina farmaceutica esperienza. Più lontano, si porta:
• High Ethical Standards: Lei dimostra l'integrità e la conformità in tutte le attività professionali.
• Agility strategica: Hai la capacità di prendere decisioni consapevoli e strategiche in modo efficace.
• Approccio paziente-critico: priorità ai pazienti nelle attività di sviluppo clinico e di pratica medica.
• Esperienza di lancio: la tua esperienza con il lancio di prodotti medici o indicazioni guiderà l'introduzione di prodotti di successo. La vostra esperienza nel cancro al seno può guidare il cambiamento. Fai il passo successivo e aiutaci a fornire farmaci innovativi ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Applichi subito. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir sind Ärztin. Wir verwandeln die medizinische Praxis zusammen. Wir sind verantwortlich für die medizinische Außenanschauung bei Roche und dafür, dass die Wissenschaft hinter unseren Produkten weltweit unter relevanten HCPs kommuniziert und verstanden wird, für die wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner sind. Wir arbeiten zusammen und streben in einem integrierten Arbeitsumfeld mit den Affiliate, der globalen Entwicklung und der globalen Strategie an. Wir helfen bei der Entwicklung, Einführung, Aufnahme und informierten Nutzung unserer innovativen Medikamente und Dienstleistungen in der klinischen Praxis und Patientenversorgung weltweit. Wir schaffen und entwickeln Kompetenzen, Fähigkeiten und Chancen für unser globales Medical Network. Wir denken voraus und nutzen digital, wann immer möglich. Die Chance
• Sie bieten medizinisches Know-how für Brustkrebs und tragen als Teil einer integrierten Strategie zu Komponenten der medizinischen Strategie wie Beweiserzeugung, Verbreitung und medizinische Erkenntnisse bei.
• Sie leisten einen Beitrag zur Planung und Durchführung von im Bereich Brustkrebs relevanten Strategien der Beweiserzeugung, die auf medizinischen und Marktzugangslücken basieren, einschließlich klinischer Studien, Untersuchungs-Initiierten Studien (IIS), Daten der realen Welt und wissenschaftliche Forschungskooperationen, indem Sie gezielte Netzwerke mit Interessengruppen im Gesundheitswesen in verschiedenen Kulturen und Ländern aufbauen.
• Sie generieren integrierte medizinische Erkenntnisse, um Strategien und Pläne zu informieren und bieten medizinische und funktionale Expertise für Marktzugangsstrategien und damit verbundene Betriebspläne.
• Sie führen die Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen akademischen und klinischen Spezialisten weltweit, um wissenschaftliche und strategische Inputs für unsere klinischen Entwicklungsprogramme zu sichern und mit ihnen über die Interpretation unserer klinischen Studienergebnisse zu spären, so dass diese potenziell einen Mehrwert für HCPs schaffen und Patienten profitieren können. Wer bist du? Sie halten einen MD-Abschluss, der ein sehr bevorzugtes oder fortgeschrittenes Life-Science-Abschluss ist (z.B. PhD oder PharmD). Ein Spezialisierungsgrad oder Branchenerfahrung in Brustkrebs ist ein Muss. Darüber hinaus verfügen Sie über eine robuste medizinische und/oder pharmazeutische Medizin. Weiter bringt ihr:
• Hohe Ethische Standards: Sie zeigen Integrität und Compliance in allen professionellen Aktivitäten.
• Strategische Agilität: Sie haben die Fähigkeit, fundierte, strategische Entscheidungen effektiv zu treffen.
• Patient-Centric Approach: Sie priorisieren Patienten in der klinischen Entwicklung und in der medizinischen Praxis.
• Launch Experience: Ihre Erfahrung mit der Einführung von Medizinprodukten oder Indikationen wird die erfolgreiche Produkteinführung vorantreiben. Ihr Know-how im Brustkrebs kann sich ändern. Nehmen Sie den nächsten Schritt und helfen Sie uns, innovative Medikamente an Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Bewerben Sie sich. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes des affaires médicales. Nous transformons la pratique médicale ensemble. Nous sommes responsables de la perspective médicale externe à Roche et de veiller à ce que la science derrière nos produits soit communiquée et comprise parmi les HCP pertinents à l'échelle mondiale, pour lesquels nous sommes un partenaire de confiance. Nous collaborons dans un environnement de travail intégré avec les affiliés, le développement mondial et la stratégie mondiale. Nous contribuons au développement, à l'introduction, à l'adoption et à l'utilisation éclairée de nos médicaments et services innovants dans la pratique clinique et les soins aux patients dans le monde entier. Nous créons et développons des compétences, des capacités et des opportunités pour notre réseau médical mondial. Nous pensons à l'avenir et puisons dans le numérique chaque fois que possible. L'opportunité
• Vous fournissez une expertise médicale au cancer du sein et contribuez à des composantes de la stratégie médicale telles que la production de preuves, la diffusion et les connaissances médicales dans le cadre d'une stratégie intégrée.
• Vous contribuez ou dirigez la planification et l'exécution de stratégies de production de données pertinentes dans le domaine du cancer du sein, basées sur des lacunes médicales et d'accès au marché, y compris des études cliniques, des études entreprises par des chercheurs (SII), des données réelles et des collaborations de recherche scientifique en créant des réseaux ciblés avec les intervenants des soins de santé dans plusieurs cultures et pays.
• Vous produisez des informations médicales intégrées pour éclairer les stratégies et les plans et vous fournissez une expertise médicale et fonctionnelle aux stratégies d'accès au marché et aux plans opérationnels connexes.
• Vous dirigez la collaboration avec des spécialistes universitaires et cliniques clés du monde entier afin d'obtenir une contribution scientifique et stratégique à nos programmes de développement clinique et de les analyser avec eux sur l'interprétation de nos résultats d'essais cliniques afin que ceux-ci puissent potentiellement créer de la valeur pour les HCP et bénéficier aux patients. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme MD qui est un diplôme hautement préféré ou avancé en sciences de la vie (p. ex. doctorat ou pharmD). Un diplôme de spécialisation ou une expérience de l'industrie dans le cancer du sein est un must. De plus, vous avez une solide expérience médicale et/ou pharmaceutique. En outre, vous apportez:
• Hautes normes éthiques: Vous démontrez l'intégrité et la conformité dans toutes les activités professionnelles.
• Agilité stratégique : Vous avez la capacité de prendre des décisions stratégiques éclairées et efficaces.
• Approche patient-chercheur : Vous priorisez les patients dans les activités de développement clinique et de pratique médicale.
• Expérience de lancement: Votre expérience avec le lancement de produits médicaux ou d'indications conduira à une introduction réussie du produit. Votre expertise en cancer du sein peut conduire au changement. Prenez la prochaine étape et aidez-nous à fournir des médicaments innovants aux patients du monde entier. Demande maintenant. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

La position Dans le cadre de l'écosystème de la Fondation Médecine (FMI), notre équipe offre un impact clinique immédiat pour les patients aujourd'hui tout en façonnant activement l'avenir des soins de santé. Nous travaillons dans un environnement hautement collaboratif et innovant pour transformer les diagnostics moléculaires en une plateforme d'oncologie de précision évolutive intégrée dans les systèmes de santé du monde entier. Nous cherchons un chef commercial (CBL) pour Data & Digital afin de rejoindre l'équipe d'affaires internationale (IBT). Dans ce rôle hautement stratégique, vous façonnerez l'avenir de la médecine de précision adaptée à l'IA à l'échelle mondiale, accélérerez l'adoption de solutions d'oncologie intégrées numériquement sur les marchés internationaux et servirez de pont stratégique entre les fonctions mondiales et l'exécution régionale et locale. • Stratégie et modèles d'exploitation: Identifier et hiérarchiser les possibilités commerciales numériques et axées sur les données pour stimuler la conception et l'exécution de la stratégie commerciale internationale du FMI, des modèles d'exploitation et des plans d'affaires (y compris la gestion des risques liés à la P&L et au marché).

• Support haut de gamme & Affiliate: Diriger l'entreprise et soutenir les affiliés avec des besoins variés, y compris la conduite de l'implémentation de données/numériques et fournir des ressources centrales ou un soutien direct pour les réunions de clients au niveau C, les appels d'offres et les négociations contractuelles.
• Gestion et intégration des parties prenantes: favoriser une intégration forte et transversale dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème (IBT, affiliés, iKAM, Régions, Pharma) afin d'accélérer les synergies interfonctionnelles et de diriger la gestion du changement organisationnel.
• Gestion financière et gestion des risques : S'associer avec d'autres chefs d'entreprise commerciaux et d'autres bailleurs de fonds pour préparer, suivre et ajuster le budget et la planification des activités du commerce international tout en élaborant des mesures d'atténuation des risques stratégiques. • Leader commercial expérimenté: Vous apportez un minimum de 7 ans d'expérience dans les DIV ou les secteurs connexes, avec une expérience commerciale significative dans le diagnostic, les dispositifs médicaux, ou les solutions de santé adaptées à l'IA. L'expérience d'un rôle de client ou de terrain est privilégiée.
