• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Gesundheitspolitik oder öffentlichen Angelegenheiten im Bereich der Lebenswissenschaften oder der Regierung, mit einer tiefen Beherrschung und Kenntnisse der Krankheitsgebietspolitik, des Gesundheitssystems und der Zugangsumgebungen.
• Ein anerkannter Führer mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte und Politiker zu beeinflussen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position External Affairs International (EAi), qui fait partie du bureau du PDG de Roche Pharma, veille à ce que l'entreprise puisse façonner les politiques, les décisions de financement et les conditions du marché qui déterminent la valeur et la récompense de l'innovation en matière de soins de santé. Nous influons à l'échelle mondiale là où les priorités stratégiques sont définies et nous permettons à l'échelle locale d'avoir un impact sur les entreprises. Grâce à un plaidoyer ciblé et à un réseau mondial connecté, EAi établit des relations de confiance avec les gouvernements, les institutions multilatérales et les partenaires mondiaux, développe des défenseurs tiers et forge des alliances qui protègent et développent les affaires de Roches tout en améliorant l'accès des patients à l'innovation. L'opportunité Le responsable de la politique mondiale, Politique sur les zones de maladies, est un expert stratégique à fort impact chargé de concevoir et d'orienter les stratégies stratégiques de Roche dans les zones thérapeutiques prioritaires. Rendre compte au responsable de l'équipe de la politique mondiale sur les maladies, vous êtes l'expert en politiques définitives, vous assurant que l'environnement politique externe et les systèmes de soins de santé offrent un accès rapide et durable à l'innovation. Ce rôle exige un mélange unique de maîtrise des politiques techniques, de sens commercial et de diplomatie stratégique afin de naviguer dans des environnements supranationaux complexes, d'influencer les principaux intervenants et d'orchestrer l'alignement des politiques mondiales sur les zones de maladies locales sans avoir besoin d'une autorité hiérarchique directe. Principales responsabilités
• Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre du portefeuille de stratégies politiques mondiales et des indicateurs de performance dans les AT prioritaires, en assurant une alignement complet avec les fonctions mondiales, régionales et affiliées.
• Définir la vision politique, la stratégie, les objectifs et l'élaboration de projets politiques sophistiqués, de données probantes, d'outils et de positionnement qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des professionnels de la santé et des entreprises.
• Agir en tant que principal catalyseur de la mise en place d'un environnement politique en élaborant des cadres d'engagement et de plaidoyer extérieurs pour un large éventail d'acteurs de la politique et du système de santé, tout en identifiant et en atténuant les obstacles à l'accès entre les gouvernements et les ONG.
• Servir de principal point de contact mondial pour la politique en matière de maladies, fournissant une orientation opportune et experte aux entreprises
• Établir des partenariats stratégiques dans les régions de Roche et les filiales afin d'assurer une application cohérente de l'expertise en matière de politique de santé, de permettre la mise en œuvre locale des stratégies de lutte contre la maladie et de conduire la mission Affaires extérieures à travers l'organisation.
• Diriger l'élaboration de contenus à l'échelle du portefeuille, d'outils d'analyse et de stratégies politiques dans le domaine des maladies qui traduisent des politiques extérieures complexes et des défis en matière de soins de santé en idées et tactiques opérationnelles réalisables.
• Gérer les initiatives stratégiques mondiales à haut impact et les axes de travail des projets, en assurant la transparence des ressources et en formulant des recommandations fondées sur des données factuelles pour permettre une prise de décisions de haut niveau.
• Soutenir la croissance organisationnelle en partageant l'expertise mondiale en matière de politique de santé et en éduquant les pairs interfonctionnels pour favoriser une culture d'excellence fonctionnelle et d'innovation. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master, d'un MBA ou d'un équivalent en sciences politiques, politiques publiques, santé publique, gestion des soins de santé ou un domaine connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en matière de politique de santé ou d'affaires publiques dans le secteur des sciences de la vie ou au sein du gouvernement, avec une maîtrise et une connaissance approfondies de la politique en matière de maladies, du système de santé et des environnements d'accès.
• Un dirigeant reconnu ayant une capacité démontrée d'influencer les cadres supérieurs et les décideurs

jobs.title: IT Workplace Services Professional
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Be part of our inclusive team at Roche Informatics, where we're driven by a shared passion for technological novelties and optimal IT solutions. As an IT Workplace Services Professional you continuously evaluate and improve the employee experience through subject matter expertise in the digital workplace, focusing on efficiency, employee satisfaction, and ensuring business continuity. This is a varied role and can give you a springboard into other careers in Informatics and beyond.

The Opportunity

• You will act as a digital enabler for our business colleagues & functions

• You act as the owner of the digital employee experience for the respective site

• You drive employee productivity through consultancy, provide intimacy and site proximity at the sites, and ensure a personalized Roche employee experience.

• You leverage available data (e.g.: Nexthink, SNOW) for proactive support

• You support and manage the Incident/ Request management processes to ensure SLAs are met and drive continuous improvement through trend analysis.

• You manage IT hardware lifecycle management & deskside support processes/managed services for the site

• You provide support & guidance for onsite services (e.g. events and meetings) by leveraging from internal and external providers. Drive the user experience and promote best practices.

• You drive and enable standard workplace infrastructure, global/local projects, and deployments in collaboration with product teams.

• You proactively address and follow through on process-improvement ideas

• You support & drive budgeting process related to the respective site

• You support local audit, inspection and certification requirements

• You support local Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery planning activities

Who you are:

• Exhibits a Lean-Agile Mindset

• Manages risks progressively and in a way that leads to opportunity

• Enterprise mindset that can break down silos. Focus on delivery through collaboration, and bringing people together to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries.

• Exhibits intellectual curiosity and integrity and has a strong passion for innovation

• Understanding of Roche-supported operating systems, devices and applications, including the Google Suite of Applications, MS Office, etc.

• Experience with ticketing systems and troubleshooting hardware, software and mobile devices.

• Excellent working knowledge of the ITIL v3 processes in an IT service delivery

• Solid written and oral communication skills in German and English.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sr. specialist, Lab Support
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
● Ensure that the following works are effectively executed to support LS and QC related business
确保如下工作被有效执行，以支持QC相关业务
⮚ Roche Global digital system aspect, including but not limit to
罗氏全球数字化系统相关，包括但不限于
● Responsible for the deployment of the end-to-end process for BIOVIA (Electronic Lab Notebook). Drive the implementation of QC electronic analytical records and system integration in a project management approach, including formula development, formula testing, formula validation, formula optimization and integration, as well as system interaction testing and application.
负责BIOVIA (Electronic Lab Notebook) 端到端流程的部署。以项目管理的方式逐步推进QC电子分析记录和系统交互建立，包括配方开发，配方测试，配方确认，配方优化和融合，系统交互测试和应用等
● Utilize QbD thinking to ensure end-to-end compliance of Roche's global digital systems. This includes eliminating GMP and Data Integrity risks, simplifying and optimizing processes, and improving Right-First-Time performance.
运用QbD思维，确保罗氏全球数字化系统端到端流程全面合规。包括消除GMP和Data Integrity风险，简化&优化流程，提高Right-First-Time。
● Roche global digital systems directly associated with testing such as BIOVIA, SingleLIMS，Labx, Empower, SAP. Including creation of user processes, using and maintenance; Creation of Master Data/Method and it's processes, using and maintenance etc.
其他罗氏全球数字化系统，如LIMS，Labx，Empower，SAP等的使用和维护等

⮚ Laboratory testing and related work, including but not limited to:
实验室检测及相关工作，包括但不限于
● Inspect and examine samples from processes such as packaging, excipients, finished product manufacturing, in-process control, environmental monitoring, change control, and customer complaints, providing timely and accurate analytical results and reports, as well as supporting trend analysis.
对包装，辅料，成品生产制造、制程控制，环境监测、变更控制和客户投诉等过程中的样品进行检验和检查，提供及时、准确的分析结果和报告以及支持趋势分析。
● Execute and support laboratory investigations of OOS, OOT, OOE, and other production-related issues, ensuring all analytical processes remain in a controlled state.
执行和支持实验室对OOS, OOT, OOE 及其它生产相关问题的调查，确保所有分析过程处于受控状态。
● Assist the laboratory manager in daily sample management, reference standard management, and stability sample management.
协助实验室经理处理日常样品管理、标准品管理、稳定性样品管理。
● Assist in laboratory GMP self-inspections, audits, and related inspection activities. Track the implementation of improvement plans to ensure the laboratory remains compliant with the latest GMP and DI regulations and Roche requirements.
协助实验室GMP 自查、审计等相关检查活动。跟踪改进实施计划，确保维护实验室满足最新GMP和DI法规和Roche要求。

⮚ Local instrument/equipment aspect, including but not limit to
本地仪器/设备相关，包括但不限于
● Management of the lifecycle process for instrument/equipment and execution of related business operations, including verification/validation of instrument/equipment, periodic review, backup/archive/recovery, internal and external calibration and testing, decommissioning, maintenance and repair, contracts and orders, etc.
仪器/设备生命周期流程的管理和相关业务的执行，如仪器/设备的确认和验证，周期性回顾，备份/归档/恢复，内外部的校准和测试，退役，维护和维修，合同和订单等。

● Complete the other tasks assigned by the leader.
完成上级领导布置的其他任务

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书

jobs.title: Learning Intern - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Learning Intern , you will join our Global Learning Services (GLS) team within the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization in Roche. In this role, you will assist with executing routine administrative and system data maintenance activities in our Learning Management System ( Cornerstone ). You will gain hands-on learning experience in a shared service environment, supporting learning processes and ensuring high-quality, customer-focused support for our global learning community.

Your Key Responsibilities

• System Administration : Execute routine data maintenance and system administrative tasks within Cornerstone and other relevant learning systems in a timely and accurate manner.

• Process Support : Assist with the administrative coordination of various training events, including new employee orientation, leadership training, professional training, and other training requests.

• Customer Support : Help provide customer service and troubleshooting support regarding training records, learning processes, and system inquiries to internal HR experts and business partners.

• Documentation : Assist in keeping team knowledge up to date by contributing to and updating Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Continuous Improvement : Actively participate in team meetings, workshops, and work-related events to help identify process improvements and support new ways of learning.

• Compliance & Integrity : Perform daily duties with high integrity, adhering to global and local guidelines, including strict data privacy rules and safety, security, and environmental (SHE) regulations.

Who You Are
We are looking for an analytical, proactive and collaborative university students who bring the following skills and competencies:

• Education : Currently enrolled in a university program with active/passive full-time student status in Hungary (studies in HR, Business, or Social Sciences are preferred).

• Able to work 25-30 hrs/week .

• Languages: Fluent English (C1) is required. German (B2-C1) also required.

• System & IT Skills : Experience with standard IT applications (Google Suite or Microsoft) and an eagerness to learn cloud-based learning management software (like Cornerstone).

• Growth Mindset : An agile learner who is open to seeking and giving feedback, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and capable of navigating complex data.

• Customer Centricity : Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on delivering reliable support and managing customer expectations.

• Collaboration : A supportive team player who enjoys working in a multicultural, cross-border matrix environment.

What We Offer

• Hands-on experience operating Cornerstone and various other tools.

• Deep exposure to a global Shared Service Center environment.

• Competitive salary.

• A collaborative and supportive team environment that values your development and continuous learning.

• Flexible working hours according to your studies.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changi

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Learning Intern , you will join our Global Learning Services (GLS) team within the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization in Roche. In this role, you will assist with executing routine administrative and system data maintenance activities in our Learning Management System ( Cornerstone ). You will gain hands-on learning experience in a shared service environment, supporting learning processes and ensuring high-quality, customer-focused support for our global learning community. Your Key Responsibilities
• System Administration : Execute routine data maintenance and system administrative tasks within Cornerstone and other relevant learning systems in a timely and accurate manner.
• Process Support : Assist with the administrative coordination of various training events, including new employee orientation, leadership training, professional training, and other training requests.
• Customer Support : Help provide customer service and troubleshooting support regarding training records, learning processes, and system inquiries to internal HR experts and business partners.
• Documentation : Assist in keeping team knowledge up to date by contributing to and updating Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Continuous Improvement : Actively participate in team meetings, workshops, and work-related events to help identify process improvements and support new ways of learning.
• Compliance & Integrity : Perform daily duties with high integrity, adhering to global and local guidelines, including strict data privacy rules and safety, security, and environmental (SHE) regulations. Who You Are We are looking for an analytical, proactive and collaborative university students who bring the following skills and competencies:
• Education : Currently enrolled in a university program with active/passive full-time student status in Hungary (studies in HR, Business, or Social Sciences are preferred).
• Able to work 25-30 hrs/week .
• Languages: Fluent English (C1) is required. German (B2-C1) also required.
• System & IT Skills : Experience with standard IT applications (Google Suite or Microsoft) and an eagerness to learn cloud-based learning management software (like Cornerstone).
• Growth Mindset : An agile learner who is open to seeking and giving feedback, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and capable of navigating complex data.
• Customer Centricity : Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on delivering reliable support and managing customer expectations.
• Collaboration : A supportive team player who enjoys working in a multicultural, cross-border matrix environment. What We Offer
• Hands-on experience operating Cornerstone and various other tools.
• Deep exposure to a global Shared Service Center environment.
• Competitive salary.
• A collaborative and supportive team environment that values your development and continuous learning.
• Flexible working hours according to your studies. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Senior Specialist Directory Services
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Cybersecurity Senior Specialist Directory Services

Throughout our 125-year history, Roche has grown into one of the world’s largest biotech companies and a global supplier of transformative innovative solutions across major disease areas.
At Roche, we believe every employee makes a difference. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are confident in both decision and action, we believe that good business means a better world.

We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology .
In Roche Digital Technology we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives.

You will be responsible for the Design of solutions and tier 2-3 operational support, performance, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies. You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives.

Your team:

As a Cybersecurity Senior Specialist Directory Services you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks.

Your key responsibilities:

• Lead (as Solution Architect) small to medium sized technical teams and contribute to the end to end design of infrastructure solutions producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.

• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and support and implement the Directory Services Infrastructure on premise and in cloud Entra ID , its associated compliments and applications.

• Proactively monitor systems and platforms for performance, availability and capacity management and ensure that the solution and component escalations are minimized.

• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implement changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction

• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management

• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve

• Provide 24x7 on-call support (approx 1 week per month). Flexibility regarding working hours

• Occasional international travel is required

Required skills and experience:

• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.

• 6+ years experience administering and advance troubleshooting in Active Directory and Entra ID

• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry

• Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures

• Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and Entra ID with key focus on Governance and Administration of Identity Security Cloud Services and the synchronization of hybrid environments (Cloud/On-Premise).

• Power

• Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and Entra ID with key focus on Governance and Administration of Identity Security Cloud Services and the synchronization of hybrid environments (Cloud/On-Premise).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
On en Roche

Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one?
Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale.

What is it?

• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.

• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.

• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.

• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning.

Why join?

• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges

• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale

• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations

• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams

• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback

• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche

The Opportunity

Optimize real-world operations by improving efficiency, scalability, and digital transformation in industrial environments.

Rotations may include:

• Site Operations

• Warehouse operations & material flow

• Customer Fulfillment & Service Operations

• Direct Procurement

The Position

• Support site capacity planning and growth readiness

• Improve warehouse layout, material flow, and productivity

• Analyze operational flows to identify improvement opportunities

• Contribute to automation, analytics, and process redesign projects

• Translate operational data into actionable insights

Who you are

We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations - focused profiles , or related fields

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)

• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments

• Full availability for a 24-month program

Timelines & further information

• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)

• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

• Start date: September 2026

• Assessment Center: July 15th

• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
On en Roche

Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one?
Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale.

What is it?

• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.

• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.

• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.

• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning.

Why join?

• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges

• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale

• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations

• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams

• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback

• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche

The Opportunity

Enhance global supply chain performance through analytics, planning, and service optimization. Get familiar with the entire order fulfillment process and how we support our customers on a daily basis.
Rotations may include:

• Demand & Supply Planning

• Transport & 3PL Network Management

• Order management & customer collaboration

The Position

• Monitor and analyze key supply chain KPIs

• Support demand and supply planning activities

• Manage small scale projects within some of the Supply Chain areas, participate in the daily operations to get to know the activities like e.g. in order management & customer collaboration.

• Contribute to inventory optimization and stock management

• Collaborate with logistics partners to ensure reliable delivery

• Support projects for network optimization and process improvement initiatives

• Prepare insights and reports for decision-making

Who you are

We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.
You should have:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain , analytics profiles or related fields

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)

• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments

• Full availability for a 24-month program

Timelines & further information

• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)

• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

• Start date: September 2026

• Assessment Center: July 15th

• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal

jobs.title: Medical Affairs Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications .
Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public.

Role scope:

Key responsibilities

• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies

• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas

• Plan and handle medical budgets

• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions

• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness

• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues

• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions

• Keep up to date on scientific and clinical developments in the therapeutic areas, and provide medical information to internal and external customers

• Review of non-, and promotional materials

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Additional task, duties and responsibilities:

• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)

• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As the Commercial Business Leader (CBL) for Foundation Medicine, you will work within an innovative ecosystem led by Foundation Medicine, a pioneer with over 15 years of leadership in combining scientific and technology advancement with transformative treatment strategies. At Roche, we are committed to transforming healthcare and making a positive impact on patients' lives. Joining our team means contributing to driving healthcare transformation on a global scale within a dynamic environment that fosters collaboration and excellence.
In this high-impact role, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of Precision Medicine on a global scale and ensure that our innovative solutions translate into life-changing benefits for patients across the globe. As a core member of the International Business Team (IBT), you will represent the International Commercial Business Unit, serving as the strategic bridge between global functions and regional/local execution. In this capacity, you will act as the primary Commercial Liaison to the FMI Business Area, bringing the "Voice of the Customer" to the forefront of the organization to inform product requirements and shape portfolio priorities.

The Opportunity

• Commercial Strategy & Execution: Drive the design, execution, and prioritization of commercial strategies, operating models, and key strategic projects (e.g., squads, communities of practice) for International Markets in collaboration with the regions.

• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Act as the Commercial Liaison to the corresponding Business Area, Pharma, and Disease Area Network, representing the customer voice of International Markets to prioritize the product portfolio roadmap.

• Affiliate Support & Market Expansion: Steer the business, support affiliates with diverse business needs, drive the successful implementation of FMI products, identify new market opportunities/trends, and manage market risks as defined in the Business Plan and P&L.

• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support affiliates in high-stakes/C-level customer meetings (e.g., top hospitals, labs, payers), provide central resources for contract negotiations/tenders, and accelerate cross-functional synergies across FMI IBTs, iKAMs, and Pharma.

• Disease Management Integration: Ensure the integration of your focus area into an overall disease management approach where applicable, collaborating closely with Medical & Government Affairs / MAx and the regional strategy and innovation chapter.

• Change & Risk Management: Drive organizational changes, develop regional networking concepts, anticipate risk scenarios, and establish suitable risk management and mitigation strategies.

• Financial Planning: Collaborate with other commercial business leaders and finance to prepare, track, and adjust the International Business budget and business planning in response to internal and external influences.

Who You Are

• Experienced Commercial Leader: Holds a minimum of a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) with at least 7 years of experience in IVD or related sectors, a strong track record of strategic commercial decision-making, and preferred experience in a customer-facing or field-based role.

• Strategic & Business Acumen: Demonstrates proven strategic agility to translate broad conceptual plans into simplified actions, strong business acumen, and a robust understanding of the clinical/prescriber market (e.g., Oncology care) and healthcare systems.

• Project & Change Champion: P

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come Commercial Business Leader (CBL) per Foundation Medicine Institute, lavorerai all'interno di un ecosistema innovativo guidato da Foundation Medicine, un pioniere con oltre 15 anni di leadership nel combinare il progresso scientifico e tecnologico con le strategie di trattamento trasformativo. A Roche, ci impegniamo a trasformare la salute e ad avere un impatto positivo sulla vita dei pazienti. Unire il nostro team significa contribuire a promuovere la trasformazione della salute su scala globale in un ambiente dinamico che favorisce la collaborazione e l'eccellenza. In questo ruolo di alto impatto, avrete l'opportunità unica di plasmare il futuro della Medicina di Precisione su scala globale e garantire che le nostre soluzioni innovative traducono in benefici che cambiano la vita per i pazienti di tutto il mondo. Come membro centrale del International Business Team (IBT), rappresenterai l'International Commercial Business Unit, che fungerà da ponte strategico tra le funzioni globali e l'esecuzione regionale/locale. In questa capacità, si agirà come principale Collegamento Commerciale all'Area Business FMI, portando la "Voce del Cliente" all'avanguardia dell'organizzazione per informare i requisiti del prodotto e modellare le priorità del portafoglio. L'opportunità
• Strategia commerciale e esecuzione: guidare la progettazione, l'esecuzione e la priorità delle strategie commerciali, dei modelli operativi e dei progetti strategici chiave (ad esempio, le squadre, le comunità di pratica) per i mercati internazionali in collaborazione con le regioni.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: agire come collegamento commerciale alla corrispondente Business Area, Pharma e Rete Area Malattia, che rappresenta la voce del cliente dei mercati internazionali per dare priorità alla roadmap del portafoglio prodotti.
• Supporto affiliato & Market Expansion: Steer the business, supporto affiliati con diverse esigenze aziendali, guidare la riuscita implementazione dei prodotti FMI, identificare nuove opportunità di mercato / corsi, e gestire i rischi di mercato come definito nel Business Plan e P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support affiliati in riunioni di clienti di alto livello / C (ad esempio, ospedali di alto livello, laboratori, paganti), fornire risorse centrali per trattative di contratto / clienti, e accelerare sinergie trasversali attraverso FMI IBT, iKAMs e Pharma.
• Integrazione della gestione delle malattie: assicurare l'integrazione della vostra area di attenzione in un approccio globale di gestione delle malattie, ove applicabile, collaborando strettamente con gli Affari medici e governativi / MAx e il capitolo della strategia regionale e innovazione.
• Change & Risk Management: Guidare cambiamenti organizzativi, sviluppare concetti di rete regionale, anticipare scenari di rischio, e stabilire adeguate strategie di gestione del rischio e mitigazione.
• Pianificazione finanziaria: collaborare con altri leader commerciali e finanza per preparare, tracciare e regolare il budget e la pianificazione aziendale internazionale in risposta alle influenze interne ed esterne. Chi sei
• Leader commerciale esperto: possiede un minimo di un diploma di laurea (o equivalente) con almeno 7 anni di esperienza in settori IVD o correlati, un forte record di decisioni commerciali strategiche, e l'esperienza preferita in un ruolo orientato al cliente o sul campo.
• Acume Strategico & Business: Dimostra l'agilità strategica comprovata per tradurre ampi piani concettuali in azioni semplificate, forte acume aziendale, e una solida comprensione del mercato clinico/prescrittivo (ad esempio, cura Oncologia) e sistemi sanitari.
• Progetto e cambiamento C

• Kommerzielle Strategie & Ausführung: Fahren Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit den Regionen mit der Gestaltung, Durchführung und Priorisierung von Handelsstrategien, Betriebsmodellen und strategischen Schlüsselprojekten (z.B. Quads, Praxisgemeinschaften) für den internationalen Markt.

L'opportunité
• Stratégie commerciale et exécution: Diriger la conception, l'exécution et la hiérarchisation des stratégies commerciales, des modèles opérationnels et des projets stratégiques clés (par exemple, les équipes, les communautés de pratique) pour les marchés internationaux en collaboration avec les régions.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Agir comme la liaison commerciale avec le Business Area, Pharma, et le réseau correspondant, représentant la voix des clients des marchés internationaux pour prioriser la feuille de route du portefeuille de produits.
• Soutien aux filiales et expansion du marché : dirigez l'entreprise, soutenez les filiales ayant des besoins d'affaires variés, dirigez la mise en oeuvre réussie des produits de l'IMF, identifiez de nouvelles opportunités/tendances du marché et gérez les risques du marché tels que définis dans le plan d'affaires et P&L.
• Hautes étapes et gestion des parties prenantes: soutenir les filiales dans les réunions de clients de haut niveau/C (p. ex., les hôpitaux de haut niveau, les laboratoires, les payeurs), fournir des ressources centrales pour les négociations contractuelles/appels d'offres, et accélérer les synergies interfonctionnelles entre les IBT de l'IMF, les iKAM et les Pharma.
• Intégration de la gestion des maladies : assurez l'intégration de votre domaine d'intervention dans une approche globale de gestion des maladies, le cas échéant, en collaborant étroitement avec les Affaires médicales et gouvernementales/MAx et le chapitre sur la stratégie régionale et l'innovation.
• Changement et gestion des risques: Diriger les changements organisationnels, élaborer des concepts de réseautage régional, anticiper les scénarios de risque et établir des stratégies appropriées de gestion et d'atténuation des risques.
• Planification financière: Collaborer avec d'autres chefs d'entreprise et de finance pour préparer, suivre et ajuster le budget des affaires internationales et la planification des affaires en réponse aux influences internes et externes. Qui vous êtes
• Leader commercial expérimenté : est titulaire d'un baccalauréat (ou d'un équivalent) d'au moins 7 ans d'expérience en DIV ou dans des secteurs connexes, d'une solide expérience en matière de prise de décisions commerciales stratégiques et d'une expérience privilégiée dans un rôle axé sur le client ou sur le terrain.
• Œuvre stratégique et d'affaires : Démontre une agilité stratégique éprouvée pour traduire des plans conceptuels généraux en actions simplifiées, un Œuvre forte d'affaires et une solide compréhension du marché clinique/prescripteur (par exemple, les soins oncologiques) et des systèmes de santé.

jobs.title: Near Patient Care Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist based in Ireland (ideally Dublin area).

Job Summary

As a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist at Roche Diagnostics Ltd. in Ireland, you are at the forefront of the healthcare revolution, moving diagnostics closer to the patient to enable faster, more clinical decision-making. You will manage a high-value portfolio—including Point-of-Care (POC) and associated digital solutions—across hospitals, HSE clinics, and community care settings.

• Location: Field-based (Ireland).

• Role Type: Permanent

• Company: Roche Diagnostics Ltd.

• Primary Goal: To drive the adoption of "Near Patient Care" technologies, ensuring healthcare providers have the tools to deliver real-time results that improve patient outcomes and hospital efficiencies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Sales & Territory Management

• Drive Revenue: Meet and exceed sales targets for the Near Patient Care portfolio (e.g., blood gas, glucose monitoring, and rapid diagnostic platforms).

• Market Growth: Identify new business opportunities within the HSE, private hospitals, and community health districts.

• Tender Management: Lead and contribute to complex tender submissions for business acquisition and retention within the Irish healthcare landscape.

2. Customer Partnership & Consultation

• Relationship Building: Nurture deep relationships with key stakeholders, including Hospital Managers, Laboratory Directors, Point of Care Coordinators, and HSE procurement.

• Solution Selling: Consult with clinical teams to understand their workflow challenges and develop tailored diagnostic solutions that enhance service delivery.

• Clinical Education: Provide high-quality product demonstrations and in-service training for healthcare professionals to ensure the effective use of Roche technology.

3. Market Intelligence & Analysis

• Competitive Awareness: Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to inform strategic sales planning.

• CRM Management: Maintain accurate records and sales pipelines within Salesforce to support forecasting and territory reporting.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

• Education: Degree level in Life Sciences, Biomedical Science, or a related field.

• Experience: Proven track record in medical device or diagnostic sales with experience in the Irish HSE ecosystem.

• License: Full, clean driving license.

• Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and "respectfully challenge the status quo".

Desirable:

• Point-of-Care Expertise: Specific knowledge of "Near Patient" or Point of Care (POC) diagnostic workflows.

• Agile Mindset: Ability to work in an agile environment and adapt to a rapidly evolving pathology pipeline.

Why Join Roche?

• Impact: Be part of a global leader that aims to "prevent, stop, and cure diseases" by ensuring access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

• Culture: A collaborative environment that encourages "personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections".

• Growth: Extensive opportunities for professional development and career progression within the broader Roche network.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines

titleByLocale.it: Guida del catalizzatore del valore di AI

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
This role serves as a strategic leader driving the scaling and value acceleration of Roche’s AI and digital healthcare solutions from “10 to 100.” You will lead a hybrid team of AI Solution Catalyst Managers and Incubator & Partnership Managers to expand application scenarios, accelerate ecosystem adoption, and strengthen Roche’s leadership positioning in AI & Digital
healthcare through ecosystem collaboration and innovation initiatives. The mandate is anchored in two core pillars:
1. AI Solution Value Amplification & Scaling
Accelerating the adoption, expansion, and measurable value realization of Roche’s established AI and digital solutions across internal and external healthcare ecosystems.
2. Ecosystem Architecture & Policy Shaping
Building strategic partnerships, influencing healthcare innovation dialogue, and shaping policy and ecosystem mechanisms that enable sustainable AI healthcare transformation.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. AI Solution Value Amplification & Scaling
Lead the strategic scaling and value acceleration of Roche AI and digital healthcare solutions by expanding application scenarios, accelerating ecosystem adoption, and establishing scalable value realization models.
➢ Scaling Strategy, Scenario Expansion & Product Generalization:
Drive the “10 to 100” scaling strategy for Roche AI and digital solutions by identifying scalable application scenarios, healthcare customer groups, and ecosystem opportunities, while translating successful pilots into reusable healthcare solution models.
➢ Customer Adoption & Value Realization:
Drive the adoption and integration of Roche AI solutions across hospitals, HCPs, and ecosystem partners through effective deployment strategies, value demonstration frameworks, and measurable clinical and business impact validation.
➢ Strategic Storytelling & Scaling Optimization:
Translate complex AI capabilities into compelling healthcare and business narratives while leveraging real-world insights and ecosystem feedback to continuously optimize solution positioning and scaling strategy.
2. Ecosystem Architecture, Policy Shaping & Healthcare Value Acceleration
Architect and orchestrate a sustainable healthcare innovation ecosystem that accelerates AI solution value release through strategic partnerships, ecosystem collaboration, innovation platforms, and policy engagement.
➢ Healthcare Ecosystem Architecture & Digital Intelligence Incubator Leadership:
Build strategic collaborations with hospitals, academic institutions and other ecosystem stakeholders. Through the Digital Intelligence Incubator, connect healthcare scenarios, validation resources, ecosystem partners to accelerate solution maturation and value realization.
➢ Healthcare Value Model Exploration & Policy Shaping:
Explore innovative healthcare value frameworks, collaboration mechanisms, reimbursement pathways, and policy engagement opportunities that unlock sustainable value creation for patients and healthcare systems.
➢ Innovation Platform, External Engagement & Thought Leadership:
Lead ecosystem collaborations, and strategic engagement initiatives [e.g., WAIC, CIIE…] to strengthen Roche’s leadership positioning in AI & Digital healthcare and identify future ecosystem opportunities.
3. Team Leadership & Capability Development
Manage and mentor a hybrid team composed of AI Solution Catalyst Managers and Incubator & Partnership Managers to accelerate AI solution scaling, ecosystem collabor

jobs.title: LTO Regulatory Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Roche UK

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity

Imagine working for an organization that puts people at the heart of everything they do, where your contributions directly impact patient outcomes. At Roche, our number one priority is our patients, and we believe that every person plays a key role in achieving this mission.
As a Regulatory Partner at Roche UK, you will be a vital part of our UK Regulatory Chapter. You will leverage your regulatory and scientific expertise to shape and drive strategic initiatives. This is your opportunity to make a difference and be part of a company dedicated to improving lives.

UK Regulatory Group Responsibilities
The Regulatory group collaborates with the wider business to translate the constantly evolving requirements of the UK regulatory environment into Roche policies, procedures, solutions, and strategies that ensure compliance and maximize the value for patients.
Our activities encompass:

• Clinical Trial Applications

• National Licensing Applications

• Early Access to Medicines Applications

• National components of medicines authorization via the European Centralized procedure

The team serves as Roche's primary contact with the MHRA, requiring effective cross-functional collaboration at both local and global levels, as well as the capability to negotiate and influence externally. Regulatory Partners need to be adaptable and entrepreneurial to identify opportunities, while maintaining a focused approach on ensuring compliance and playing a key role in retaining Roche UK's License to Operate.

Who You Are
You are a passionate regulatory expert with a clear vision for improving patient outcomes. With broad and comprehensive expertise within the UK regulatory environment, you will lead foundational work and partner with the business to solve complex regulatory issues impacting the chapter and/or wider business. You will contribute to the development of squad/chapter-based strategic plans and goals, and actively participate in the learning and development of other chapter members. You will have the ability to understand scientific and technical information relating to an assigned portfolio of Roche products.

You also bring :

• A Scientific University degree

• Extensive experience in UK Regulatory Affairs

• Proven experience managing UK submissions post-Brexit

• Experience providing strategic and technical advice

• In-depth knowledge and experience of UK and EU regulatory requirements and procedures

• A proven track record of developing, implementing, and communicating regulatory strategies

• Excellent documentation skills to ensure high-quality and timely submissions

• Experience as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in defined subject areas or therapeutic areas

• Experience in mentoring peers, as well as managing stakeholder relationships

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambi

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Cybersecurity Analyst (Incident Response Operations)

The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a CyberSecurity Analyst, you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
En Roche Diagnostica España, estamos comprometidos no sólo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.
En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.

• Atiende a los clientes de acuerdo con responsabilidades previamente atribuidas (predominantemente jefe de laboratorio, jefe de sección, adjunto, técnico de laboratorio).

• Proporciona información científica y técnica a los clientes.

• Coordinación con los técnicos de mantenimiento para garantizar que la instalación se ejecute en el plazo establecido.

• Garantiza un uso óptimo de los instrumentos en el laboratorio del cliente y de las soluciones instaladas.

• Gestionar el cumplimiento de los estándares corporativos y divisionales para instalaciones, formación y entrenamiento a clientes, calidad, desarrollo de aplicaciones y seguimiento a productos de Roche.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are fearless in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

Quality is a competitive advantage for Roche. It allows us to deliver high-quality products to patients, ensures our right to operate, and helps us create value through process excellence and continual improvement efforts. Quality is every patient’s right and every employee’s responsibility.

As a Senior Business Process Manager, you will assume conceptual process ownership and shape the digital future of service business processes at Roche. This senior role focuses on enhancing operational efficiency while maintaining customer satisfaction and ensuring compliance with high industry standards. You will engage closely with global, regional, and local stakeholders to foster a culture of continuous improvement aligned with organizational strategic goals, while collaborating with business product owner teams to ensure processes are effectively implemented into the global Roche IT ecosystem.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Business Process Management

• Lead the capture, analysis, and documentation of end-to-end processes using BPMN 2.0 standards

• Develop and continuously improve harmonized target processes that balance global standards with local requirements

• Build and maintain the central Process Repository (Roche ADONIS) as the Single Source of Truth

• Conduct gap analyses and derive prioritized action plans for process improvements

AI-First – Process Automation & AI Enablement

• Systematically evaluate service business processes for automation potential and AI readiness

• Define use cases for AI-assisted process automation (ticket classification, intelligent routing, automated documentation, predictive diagnostics)

• Ensure newly defined processes are data-driven, measurable, and standardized

• Build AI literacy within the stakeholder network through training and champions programs

Stakeholder Management & Governance

• Build and maintain a global stakeholder network across country SMEs, regional and global service leads, BPOs, and IT

• Facilitate the Global Process Council (GPC) and lead process workshops with international teams

• Manage resistance and competing interests in a consensus-oriented culture

Interface Management & Project Leadership

• Collaborate with Business Product Owners to hand over harmonized process requirements for product development

• Participate in agile product development cycles as process expert

• Lead or participate in mid to large-scale strategic transformation projects with significant organizational impact

• Manage budgets and deliver projects according to timeline, budget, and success KPIs

We@Roche Diagnostics Culture

• Demonstrate We@RD dimensions (passionate about customers, radically simplify, trust & collaborate, all lead, experiment & learn)

• Permanently optimize processes to increase quality and efficiency standards

YOUR BACKGROUND

Education & Experience (Required)

• Completed degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, Engineering, or equivalent (Master's preferred)

• Minimum 7 years professional experience, with at least 3 years in Business Process Management

• Demonstrated experience in process modeling (BPMN 2.0), analysis, and optim

As a Senior Business Process Manager, you will assume conceptual process ownership and shape the digital future of service business processes at Roche. This senior role focuses on enhancing operational efficiency while maintaining customer satisfaction and ensuring compliance with high industry standards. You will engage closely with global, regional, and local stakeholders to foster a culture of continuous improvement aligned with organizational strategic goals, while collaborating with business product owner teams to ensure processes are effectively implemented into the global Roche IT ecosystem. • Lead the capture, analysis, and documentation of end-to-end processes using BPMN 2.0 standards
• Develop and continuously improve harmonized target processes that balance global standards with local requirements
• Build and maintain the central Process Repository (Roche ADONIS) as the Single Source of Truth

• Systematically evaluate service business processes for automation potential and AI readiness
• Define use cases for AI-assisted process automation (ticket classification, intelligent routing, automated documentation, predictive diagnostics)
• Ensure newly defined processes are data-driven, measurable, and standardized
• Build AI literacy within the stakeholder network through training and champions programs Stakeholder Management & Governance
• Build and maintain a global stakeholder network across country SMEs, regional and global service leads, BPOs, and IT

• Manage resistance and competing interests in a consensus-oriented culture Interface Management & Project Leadership
• Collaborate with Business Product Owners to hand over harmonized process requirements for product development
• Participate in agile product development cycles as process expert
• Lead or participate in mid to large-scale strategic transformation projects with significant organizational impact
• Manage budgets and deliver projects according to timeline, budget, and success KPIs We@Roche Diagnostics Culture
• Demonstrate We@RD dimensions (passionate about customers, radically simplify, trust & collaborate, all lead, experiment & learn)
• Permanently optimize processes to increase quality and efficiency standards YOUR BACKGROUND Education & Experience (Required)
• Completed degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, Engineering, or equivalent (Master's preferred)
• Minimum 7 years professional experience, with at least 3 years in Business Process Management
• Demonstrated experience in process modeling (BPMN 2.0), analysis, and optim

jobs.title: Medical Communication Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
This role serves as a hybrid strategic leader, combining the leadership of a composite team (comprising Medical Information & Medical Review and AI Product) with the development of a data- and AI-driven medical communication strategy.
The mandate is anchored in establishing a "data-driven medical communication flywheel": leveraging AI to proactively capture customer perception insights, building personalized content generation platforms, and developing localized digital education platforms to empower strategic business decisions. Furthermore, the role drives the transformation of traditional MI and MR business models through the introduction of Agent technologies, forging a new paradigm of human-machine collaboration in medical inquiries and automated pre-approvals to accelerate internal process efficiencies and support high-quality business growth under strict compliance standards.

Principal Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. AI-Driven Strategy & Flywheel Construction Development and execution of a long-term, data-centric medical communication strategy, ensuring strict alignment with overarching business goals.

• Proactive Insight Generation: Leadership in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Social Listening) to proactively capture and analyze customer behaviors and perceptions, identifying market trends and opportunities to provide data-backed support for business decisions.

• Content Generation Platform & Impact: Establishment of a robust content generation platform to significantly accelerate the production speed of high-quality medical education materials. Leadership in the rapid construction of core scientific messaging and educational content derived from AI-driven insights to effectively influence and transform customer perceptions and clinical behaviors.

• Personalized Platform Development: Oversight of the construction of personalized content generation platforms and localized digital education platforms to ensure the medical value proposition is delivered precisely and efficiently based on targeted user personas.

2. Digital Product & Solution Leadership Lead the development, evolution, and ecosystem cooperation for strategic digital assets, ensuring they deliver measurable value to patients and the healthcare system.

• Portfolio Lifecycle Management: Oversee the roadmap and execution of key AI solutions, specifically, Social Listening, Content Generation, Digital Communication, MI Agent, and MR Agent.

• Agile Iteration: Driving the continuous iteration of cutting-edge technologies, such as Large Language Models (LLMs), within medical communication scenarios to optimize product performance in an evolving market landscape.

3. AI Agent Innovation & Human-Machine Collaboration

• Traditional Business Transformation: Leading the introduction and deployment of MI Agents and MR Agents to fundamentally revolutionize traditional medical information inquiries and compliance review workflows.

• Model Innovation: Establishment of a human-machine collaboration model for medical Q&A (MI Agent) and automated pre-approvals (MR Agent) to achieve a quantum leap in business responsiveness while ensuring 100% adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements.

4. Team Leadership & Capability Development Management and mentorship of a hybrid team of MI/MR and AI Product.

• Team Synergy: Elimination of functional barrier between traditional medical communication operations and technical product management

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir suchen innerhalb der Funktion QC Packaging Material & Devices als Teil der Qualitätskontrolle BS/KAU ein neues Teammitglied für die Unit Packaging Speed Testing. Das Team Packaging Speed Testing überprüft die Qualität der Packmaterialien (z.B. Faltschachteln, Spritzen, Autoinjektoren), bevor diese im Verpackungsbetrieb, Entwicklung, Clinical Supply oder in den Abfüllbetrieben eingesetzt werden können.

Die Möglichkeit

• Durchführung von Packmittel Prüfungen gemäss Prüfvorschriften und Prüfmethoden

• Anwendung physikalischer Prüfmethoden nach Vorgaben in Prüfvorschriften

• Sicherstellung der strikten Einhaltung der guten Herstellungspraxis (cGMP)

• Bedienung einfacher Geräte sowie Initialisierung von Musterzügen

• Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse im SAP. System. Vergleich von Messwerten mit der Spezifikation und Dokumentation der Ergebnisse.

• Durchführen von Chargenreview

• Projektleitung: Verbesserungsprojekte, Selbstorganisation, 5S, Prozessoptimierungen, Innovationen und Investitionen

• Weiterentwicklung der Selbstorganisation beider Circles

• Organisationsentwicklung durch “out of the box” thinking

Wer du bist

• Technische Ausbildung mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung sowie Berufserfahrung im GxP-Bereich

• Interesse, neue technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen

• Kommunikative und entscheidungsfreudige Persönlichkeit mit Überzeugungskraft und Durchsetzungsvermögen, Freude an einer selbständigen und initiativen Tätigkeit

• Gute Kenntnisse in Qualitätssystemen und cGMP

• Deutsch fliessend in Wort und Schrift

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
