jobs.title: Medical Director (MD), Multiple Sclerosis
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche's Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing late-stage development (Phase II–III) clinical strategies that deliver medically differentiated therapies for patients. We are seeking a highly motivated Medical Director (grading commensurate with experience) to join our Neuroimmunology team, specifically focusing on Multiple Sclerosis (MS).

The Opportunity

As a Medical Director, you will participate in or lead the development of Clinical Development (CD) plans, ensuring the effective execution of strategies for assigned molecules and indications. This is a junior to mid-level individual contributor position without people management responsibilities. The Opportunity
To help us deliver life-changing therapies to patients, you will take on a vital role in our Neuroimmunology team and drive the following key responsibilities:

• CDP Strategy and Planning: Lead or contribute to the creation of the Clinical Development Plan (CDP), gathering data to ensure strategic alignment with long-term lifecycle plans.

• Study Design and Execution: Lead the design and execution of Phase II and III clinical studies, collaborating with cross-functional teams on study analytics, data management, and safety profiles.

• Scientific Leadership: Maintain the highest levels of scientific and clinical knowledge within the MS and Neuroimmunology therapeutic areas.

• Regulatory Engagement: Take an active role in Health Authority (HA) interactions and provide clinical expertise for regulatory filings, briefing packages, and labeling.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Build and cultivate relationships with clinical investigators, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and internal partners across research, commercial operations, and legal.

• Medical Monitoring: Act as a medical monitor for assigned studies, ensuring the correct interpretation of medical and scientific data.

Who You Are

We are looking for a resilient, scientifically driven expert who brings a blend of advanced clinical knowledge and collaborative leadership to our team:

• Academic & Clinical Expertise: M.D. required with relevant clinical experience as a Neurologist, including specialized training or a significant background working with Multiple Sclerosis patients.

• Scientific & Industry Experience: Strong scientific background (publishing in peer-reviewed journals, academic, or teaching background is a plus) alongside preferred prior industry experience in MS clinical development (>2 years) or recognition as an MS field expert (e.g., Assistant Professor).

• Clinical Trials & Regulatory Knowledge: Significant experience designing/conducting clinical trials, a strong understanding of Phase II–III drug development, and required knowledge of GCP, ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines (preferred for entry-level candidates).

• Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills to present complex data, paired with the ability to build relationships and influence without authority in a complex, cross-functional environment.

• Strategic Leadership & Mobility: Sound judgment for ethical and business decision-making, strong cross-functional leadership acumen, and the ability to travel globally up to 30%.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

Who we are

• Academic & Clinical Expertise: M.D. richiesto con esperienza clinica rilevante come neurologo, tra cui formazione specializzata o uno sfondo significativo che lavora con pazienti con sclerosi multipla.
• Esperienza scientifica e industriale: forte background scientifico (publishing in peer-reviewed journals, accademico, o background di insegnamento è un plus) accanto all'esperienza del settore precedente preferita in MS sviluppo clinico (>2 anni) o il riconoscimento come esperto di campo MS (ad esempio, Professore Assistente).
• Studi clinici e conoscenza regolamentare: Esperienza significativa di progettazione/conduzione di studi clinici, una forte comprensione dello sviluppo della Fase II-III della droga, e la conoscenza richiesta di linee guida GCP, ICH, FDA e EMA (preferito per i candidati entry-level).
• Abilità comunicative e interpersonali: eccezionali capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali per presentare dati complessi, abbinati alla capacità di costruire relazioni e influenze senza autorità in un ambiente complesso e interfunzionale.
• Leadership strategica e mobilità: giudizio sonoro per il processo decisionale etico e commerciale, forte acume di leadership interfunzionale e la capacità di viaggiare a livello globale fino al 30%. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'organisme de développement clinique de Roche est structuré par domaine thérapeutique et est responsable de l'élaboration et de l'exécution de stratégies cliniques de développement en phase terminale (phase II–III) qui offrent des traitements différenciés sur le plan médical aux patients. Nous cherchons un directeur médical très motivé (en fonction de l'expérience) pour nous joindre à notre équipe de neuroimmunologie, en mettant l'accent sur la sclérose en plaques (SM). L'opportunité En tant que directeur médical, vous participerez ou dirigerez l'élaboration de plans de développement clinique (DC), assurant ainsi l'exécution efficace des stratégies pour les molécules et indications attribuées. Il s'agit d'un poste de cotisant individuel de niveau intermédiaire sans responsabilités de gestion des personnes. L'opportunité Pour nous aider à offrir des thérapies qui changent la vie aux patients, vous assumerez un rôle vital au sein de notre équipe de neuroimmunologie et assumerez les responsabilités clés suivantes :
• Stratégie et planification du PDC : Diriger ou contribuer à la création du Plan de développement clinique (PDC), recueillir des données pour assurer l'alignement stratégique sur les plans du cycle de vie à long terme.
• Conception et exécution de l'étude: Diriger la conception et l'exécution des études cliniques de phase II et III, en collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles sur l'analyse des études, la gestion des données et les profils de sécurité.
• Leadership scientifique : maintenir les niveaux les plus élevés de connaissances scientifiques et cliniques dans les domaines thérapeutiques de la sclérose en plaques et de la neuroimmunologie.
• Engagement en matière de réglementation : jouer un rôle actif dans les interactions entre les autorités sanitaires et fournir une expertise clinique pour les dossiers réglementaires, les trousses d'information et l'étiquetage.
• Collaboration avec les intervenants : établir et cultiver des relations avec les chercheurs cliniques, les leaders d'opinion clés (KOL) et les partenaires internes dans les domaines de la recherche, des opérations commerciales et du droit.
• Surveillance médicale: agir en tant que surveillance médicale pour les études attribuées, en assurant une interprétation correcte des données médicales et scientifiques. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons un expert résilient et scientifique qui apporte un mélange de connaissances cliniques avancées et de leadership collaboratif à notre équipe :
• Expertise académique et clinique: M.D. nécessaire avec une expérience clinique pertinente en tant que neurologue, y compris une formation spécialisée ou une expérience importante de travail avec des patients atteints de sclérose en plaques.
• Expérience scientifique et industrielle : Une solide expérience scientifique (publication dans des revues, des études ou des cours évalués par des pairs) est en plus de l'expérience privilégiée de l'industrie dans le domaine du développement clinique de la SEP (>2 ans) ou de la reconnaissance en tant qu'expert de la SEP (p. ex. professeur adjoint).
• Essais cliniques et connaissances en matière de réglementation : expérience importante en matière de conception et de réalisation d'essais cliniques, bonne compréhension de la phase II–III du développement des médicaments et connaissance requise des lignes directrices du GCP, de l'ICH, de la FDA et de l'EMA (préférés pour les candidats de premier niveau).
• Compétences en communication et interpersonnelles : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite et verbale pour présenter des données complexes, jumelées à la capacité d'établir des relations et une influence sans autorité dans un environnement complexe et interfonctionnel.
• Leadership stratégique et mobilité : un bon jugement pour la prise de décisions éthiques et commerciales, un leadership interfonctionnel fort et la capacité de voyager à l'échelle mondiale jusqu'à 30 %. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

As a Senior Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and Polish

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry

• Gestisce e guida lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di strategie di vendita di attrezzature di capitale per raggiungere obiettivi di vendita assegnati per conti altamente strategici
• Fornisce una leadership professionale nella pianificazione, nell'organizzazione e nel controllo della crescita delle vendite equilibrata, della penetrazione continua del conto e della soddisfazione del cliente.
• Utilizza una forte conoscenza del prodotto/mercato e un'esperienza di vendita per gestire le vendite complesse e risolvere le domande e le preoccupazioni del cliente.
• Mantiene, estende e acquisisce i clienti attraverso un'efficace identificazione delle opportunità e la creazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni.
• Stabilisce e costruisce forti relazioni con i clienti che permettono la crescita, la redditività e la prevedibilità. Comunica con altre funzioni Roche rilevanti per garantire il supporto di vendita necessario e la consegna di programmi / prodotti.
• Pernottamento di viaggio come necessario, tra cui breve preavviso, per coprire in modo più efficace ed efficiente il territorio, massimizzando il tempo di affrontare il cliente.

jobs.title: P&C Business Partner (Advisory) - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What we do:
The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Join us now and be part of our unique transformational journey: we are building a global People & Culture (P&C/HR) Center of Excellence by bringing in talented HR professionals in order to cover complex and challenging HR functions and areas.

The Opportunity:
As a German speaking People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner (Advisory) you partner flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, you provide coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensure effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. You are a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization.
Your day to day responsibilities are:

• Strategic Guidance: Provide on-demand coaching and advisory to global leaders on critical P&C topics, including talent management, succession planning, performance management, and organizational design.

• Transformation Support: Lead and advise on complex organizational changes, transformations, and employee representation topics, ensuring risk-based decision-making and compliance with established policies.

• Global Rollouts: Deliver first-class support and coaching during the implementation of new global processes and projects, such as global grading systems or new system launches.

• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze P&C metrics and business data to recommend innovative solutions and provide insights that support our culture and strategic direction.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global/regional squads and PSS chapters to ensure the seamless execution of P&C initiatives and consistent policy application.

​
Who You Are:

• Experienced HR Professional: You bring 3–7 years of experience in similar roles such as HR Business Partnering, People Relations, or Labor Law.

• Bilingual Expert: You possess an excellent written and spoken command of both English and German, enabling you to support the DACH region and global stakeholders effectively.

• Skilled Coach & Communicator: You have a proven ability to provide difficult feedback, resolve conflicts, and influence leaders at all levels of management.

• Strategic Thinker: You can thoughtfully diagnose business needs, weigh the risks and benefits of various options, and propose fit-for-purpose HR approaches.

• You demonstrate strong knowledge in interpreting employment laws and policies, ensuring all solutions are legally sound and culturally sensitive.

• Agile Mindset: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, demonstrating high customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, and a passion for continuous learning.

• Relationship Builder: You are a natural networker who excels at navigating complex, matrixed reporting relationships across multiple cultures.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position What we do: The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Join us now and be part of our unique transformational journey: we are building a global People & Culture (P&C/HR) Center of Excellence by bringing in talented HR professionals in order to cover complex and challenging HR functions and areas. The Opportunity: As a German speaking People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner (Advisory) you partner flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, you provide coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensure effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. You are a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization. Your day to day responsibilities are:
• Strategic Guidance: Provide on-demand coaching and advisory to global leaders on critical P&C topics, including talent management, succession planning, performance management, and organizational design.
• Transformation Support: Lead and advise on complex organizational changes, transformations, and employee representation topics, ensuring risk-based decision-making and compliance with established policies.
• Global Rollouts: Deliver first-class support and coaching during the implementation of new global processes and projects, such as global grading systems or new system launches.
• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze P&C metrics and business data to recommend innovative solutions and provide insights that support our culture and strategic direction.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global/regional squads and PSS chapters to ensure the seamless execution of P&C initiatives and consistent policy application. ​ Who You Are:
• Experienced HR Professional: You bring 3–7 years of experience in similar roles such as HR Business Partnering, People Relations, or Labor Law.
• Bilingual Expert: You possess an excellent written and spoken command of both English and German, enabling you to support the DACH region and global stakeholders effectively.
• Skilled Coach & Communicator: You have a proven ability to provide difficult feedback, resolve conflicts, and influence leaders at all levels of management.
• Strategic Thinker: You can thoughtfully diagnose business needs, weigh the risks and benefits of various options, and propose fit-for-purpose HR approaches.
• You demonstrate strong knowledge in interpreting employment laws and policies, ensuring all solutions are legally sound and culturally sensitive.
• Agile Mindset: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, demonstrating high customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, and a passion for continuous learning.
• Relationship Builder: You are a natural networker who excels at navigating complex, matrixed reporting relationships across multiple cultures. In Exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities

titleByLocale.it: Rappresentante del servizio di campo (zona Hampshire/Dorset)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Are you seeking an exciting challenge in a critical support role that directly contributes to the vital NHS Pathology services, where your work truly matters and makes a meaningful impact?

Does the prospect of a rewarding career with a progressive, high-tech organisation inspire you?

Key Information

• Supporting Southern Counties Pathology Network (South 6)

• Ideal for experienced field engineers, with strong diagnostic service/support background

• Primary focus support for electro-mechanical hardware, including routine proactive and reactive maintenance.

• Additional responsibilities in applications support, IT support, and customer training

• Must reside in or be willing to relocate to the Hampshire/Dorset area

About the Role

Roche Diagnostics is seeking an experienced Electro-Mechanical Engineer to join our team as a Field Service Representative in the South region (Hampshire/Dorset area) directly supporting customers in NHS pathology laboratories.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide frontline support across various Roche product portfolio at customer sites.

• Troubleshoot and taking ownership of technical faults

• Minimise unplanned downtime of laboratory equipment

• Use of digital tools for proactive preventative measures

• Conduct training for laboratory staff

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Ideally, degree-educated in Life Sciences OR qualified to HNC/HND level in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or with equivalent demonstrable experience - you will bring a current and comprehensive understanding of the IVD industry, paired with strong experience in delivering world-class support

• E xcellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Strong communication and teamwork abilities

• Resilient and tenacious, able to thrive under pressure

• Growth mindset

For this position, the location is in the Hampshire/Dorset area.

You will be expected to collaborate with the wider team and all other areas of Roche to provide best-in-class service to our customers. Amongst other duties, this will involve attending customer review meetings to outline key achievements and objectives attained.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant - Bulgarian speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English and Bulgarian

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support fle

jobs.title: Product Owner Cybersecurity Insights

titleByLocale.it: Informazioni sulla sicurezza del proprietario del prodotto (Cibersecurity Expert)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Product Owner Security Insights is responsible for the architectural design and delivery of security analytics, security risk insights, and data product development. This means you leverage data to understand security trends, ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, and build data-driven tools to enhance the security posture.
The role provides valuable intelligence and technical blueprint to proactively identify and mitigate security risks, demonstrate compliance with industry standards, and develop innovative AI powered solutions to strengthen the overall security posture. Security risk insights are enabling business functions and RDT to make data-informed decisions and stay ahead of evolving cyber threats.
. The Product Owner is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation, planning and architectural definition through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. You will own the roadmap, data modelling, and delivery for how we transform security, privacy, and compliance data into a proactive risk-management engine that protects our global assets and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Strategy & Vision: Accountable for setting the direction for the product and ensuring that it achieves defined outcomes and security objectives. Defines the product roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user and user needs. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.

• Customer-Centricity: Actively collect, understand, and prioritize the needs of internal users. Act as the primary owner of the “customer's” problem and be responsible for defining and delivering a solution that provides tangible value. Define and track key metrics related to user satisfaction, engagement, and value delivery, and use this data to inform product iterations.

• Data Architecture & Engineering Leadership: Serve as the primary Data Architect for the security insights product, designing and owning the end-to-end technical structure within the DataOne ecosystem. You are responsible for designing high-quality Data Products following Data Mesh principles, providing expert guidance to data engineers on the implementation of pipelines (Talend, Snowflake, dbt, Python, DataOps@Roche) and advanced visualizations (Tableau, ThoughtSpot). Your architectural leadership ensures the data foundation is scalable, secure, and optimized for both executive reporting and AI/Machine Learning initiatives.

• Product Lifecycle Mgmt : Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, guide its development, and manage its growth and adoption. Manage the product in compliance with emerging regulations.

• Stakeholder Collaboration : Expand collaboration to a broader set of cross-functional teams and be responsible for aligning these teams around the product roadmap. Clearly communicate the product roadmap, timelines, and potential trade-offs to various stakeholders to manage their expectations effectively.

• Performance & Optimization: Define success metrics, analyse user behavior, and identify opportunities for optimization to achieve business goals. Translate data into actionable insights and regularly communicate product performance to stakeholders and the wider team.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• University degree in a technical or analytical field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or Engineering)

• P

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Solution Architect will design business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions to enable Roche’s omnichannel orchestration capabilities. This role focuses on building and scaling an integrated ecosystem leveraging Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA), ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and governance standards.
You will operate within a complex, multi-solution environment, driving the architecture vision across data, platforms, and activation use cases. The role requires balancing current delivery needs with long-term scalability, while ensuring robust handling of non-functional requirements (NFRs), data privacy, and system performance.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

• Define end-to-end omnichannel architecture aligned with business and enterprise standards

• Establish data models, identity frameworks, and integration patterns

• Manage NFRs (performance, scalability, security, compliance)

Data & Integration

• Integrate CRM, MDM, consent, and web/app event data
Enable unified customer profiles and audience segmentation

• Ensure data quality, governance, and privacy compliance

Platform (Adobe Stack)

• Architect and guide implementation of RT-CDP, AJO, and CJA

• Enable real-time segmentation, journey orchestration, and activation

• Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems

Real-time & Orchestration

• Design event-driven and streaming architectures

• Enable multi-channel activation (email, paid media, others)

• Establish reusable audience and journey frameworks

Strategy & Delivery

• Define architecture roadmap and support delivery across use cases

• Identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities

• Drive adoption of best practices, patterns, and new technologies

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate across business, product, and tech teams

• Communicate complex concepts clearly and drive alignment

Qualifications

Experience

• Proven experience in solution architecture within data and martech ecosystems

• Experience with CDPs and omnichannel platforms (Adobe preferred)

• Experience working in global, cross-functional teams

• Certifications on Adobe stack - (AJO, CJA and RT-CDP)

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of:

• Customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation

• Event-driven / streaming architectures

• Integration with CRM, MDM, consent systems

• Experience with APIs, cloud data platforms, and data governance concepts (GDPR)

What Success Looks Like

• Scalable omnichannel architecture aligned with enterprise standards

• Reliable data foundation enabling unified profiles and segmentation

• Real-time orchestration and activation across channels

• Measurable business impact through improved customer engagement

• Strong stakeholder alignment through clear communication and effective translation of complex concepts into business value

• Ability to influence and drive adoption of architectural decisions across cross-functional teams

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.title: Manager Inventory & Planning (d/f/m)
Especialista en Licitaciones
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Objetivo general del puesto : Preparar y proporcionar información y documentación de los procesos de licitación y concursos gubernamentales y del sector privado con base en los requerimientos de éstos, políticas y procesos locales y globales con la finalidad de facilitar la participación de Roche en el mercado de diagnóstico clínico. Realizar algunas gestiones administrativas internas y externas para la celebración de contratos en los diversos canales de distribución (venta directa, indirecta, POC y/o qPCR/RTD), tanto en el sector privado como en gobierno.

La Oportunidad
1. Actualizar semanalmente la base de datos de licitaciones y/o procesos de compras directas de clientes.
2. Participar en reuniones con los canales de distribución internos y externos.
3. Entregar registros sanitarios, certificados de libre venta y de calidad, cartas de distribución y manuales de operación actualizados a los distribuidores y/o clientes para la participación en licitaciones y concursos dentro del sector público y/o privado.
4. Dar seguimiento a los requerimientos solicitados cuando se trate de concursos de participación directa para asegurar la exitosa participación de Roche en los distintos procesos de compra.

Quién eres
Escolaridad Indispensable: Licenciatura/ Ingeniería (Titulado con cédula profesional)
Experiencia laboral : 3 años en Área de Licitaciones en compañías de productos para la salud
Conocimientos Técnicos:

• Gestión de Licitaciones desde el Área Administrativa

• Experiencia en utilización plataformas de compras gubernamentales (ej: Compras MX)

• Conocimientos legales básicos, interpretación de las distintas leyes y normativas aplicables a los procesos de compras.

• Experiencia técnica y administrativa en el ramo del diagnóstico.

• Tener un mindset ágil, innovador, adaptable y colaborativo, centrado en el cliente.

• Tener elevada motivación para trabajar bajo un esquema de marcos de trabajo Ágiles.

Esta posición no incluye beneficios de relocación

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La Oportunidad 1. Actualizar semanalmente la base de datos de licitaciones y/o procesos de compras directas de clientes. 2. Participar en reuniones con los canales de distribución internos y externos. 3. Entregar registros sanitarios, certificados de libre venta y de calidad, cartas de distribución y manuales de operación actualizados a los distribuidores y/o clientes para la participación en licitaciones y concursos dentro del sector público y/o privado. 4. Dar seguimiento a los requerimientos solicitados cuando se trate de concursos de participación directa para asegurar la exitosa participación de Roche en los distintos procesos de compra. jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
El Especialista en Experiencia del Paciente (Patient Journey Partner -PJP) de Inmunología está en el centro de la nueva organización de Roche, dando un giro al papel que desempeñamos en la sociedad, pasando de ofrecer medicamentos de calidad mundial principalmente a tener un rol de mayor colaboración, innovación y liderazgo en la disrupción creativa. De este modo, el PJP será directamente responsable de obtener mejores resultados para los pacientes, su comunidad, el ecosistema y la organización, con mayor rapidez.
Trabaja de cerca con todos los actores que intervienen directamente en la experiencia del paciente, obteniendo un profundo conocimiento de sus necesidades para conectar las capacidades de Roche en favor de la creación conjunta de soluciones.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Esta posición está ubicada en Jalisco, México. La persona debe vivir en esta ubicación.

Las principales responsabilidades del rol incluyen:

El PJP es una función de relevancia dentro de la afiliada que cuenta con autoridad de toma de decisiones para solicitar recursos a Roche (tanto dentro de la afiliada como de la red más amplia) con el fin de mejorar el impacto en la experiencia del paciente.

• El PJP se enfoca en la importancia de la perspectiva externa, asociándose a otros actores para descubrir todas las oportunidades potenciales para transformar los resultados para los pacientes, más rápido. Además comparte con el ecosistema toda la experiencia, la ciencia y los conocimientos de Roche.

• Actúa como socio de confianza y como punto primario de contacto (aunque no exclusivo) entre los actores del ecosistema y Roche. Comparte las necesidades de la comunidad de pacientes y otros actores, prioriza y asegura los recursos, e impulsa soluciones que ofrecen resultados más rápidamente.

• Se asocia y colabora con otros actores involucrados en la experiencia del paciente para eliminar los obstáculos y aprovechar las oportunidades de agregar valor a los pacientes y a la comunidad.

• Gestiona el ciclo de vida de los productos de Roche y respalda su uso adecuado, lo cual incluye compartir sus ventajas con profesionales de la salud de manera veraz y Equilibrada.

• Al dar seguimiento a la experiencia completa del paciente, el PJP actúa con una mirada sistémica, con la capacidad de identificar un propósito compartido y de aprovecharlo para crear de manera conjunta soluciones con las diferentes partes que componen el Ecosistema.

• Esta función está facultada para atraer experiencia y recursos internos a nivel local y de la red, según sea necesario, inclusive en colaboración con otros PJP.

Tu perfil:

• Grado universitario: Ciencias, Económico – Administrativo/Ciencias de la Salud. Estudios avanzados en Ciencias de la Salud y/o MBA son un diferencial.

• Experiencia en el área de inmunología es un diferencial.

• Conocimiento intermedio- avanzado del idioma Inglés.

• Habilidad para entender y apalancar herramientas digitales.

• Sólido conocimiento y visión del negocio con experiencia en comercialización, asuntos médicos y excelencia en la creación de experiencias para los clientes.

• Excelentes habilidades de relacionamiento con todas las partes interesadas, incluida la asociación con Expertos de Área Terapéutica (TAE) y organizaciones y profundo conocimiento de la experiencia de los pacientes y de los tratamientos relacionados con enfermedades específicas, lo que le permite generar sólidos vínculos a nivel de especialistas

• Conocimiento y experiencia trabajando de cerca con el sector d

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Scientific Liaison (West-Central Region, U.S.)
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
The Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL) is a field-based scientific leader who represents Roche Medical & Scientific Affairs to laboratory and clinical stakeholders across your assigned region.
In this role, you will serve as a trusted partner to laboratory directors, clinicians, and key decision-makers. You will translate complex diagnostic and clinical data into meaningful dialogue that advances patient care and informs regional and national medical strategy.
You will work closely with Sr. Scientific Managers and Sr. Medical Managers to help shape and execute an integrated medical plan grounded in real-world insights from the field. You will bring the voice of the customer to our medical plan and strategy. Your perspective will directly influence how we prioritize educational initiatives, support laboratories, and accelerate access to innovative diagnostics for patients.
This role sits within the Cardiometabolism/Neurology (Core Lab and NPC) team in Medical & Scientific Affairs and requires scientific depth, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to engage peers in high-level clinical and technical discussion.
While you may bring deep expertise in a specific disease area, you must be comfortable expanding into a variety of disease topics and continuously strengthening your scientific foundation and knowledge base. This is a role for someone who thrives in independent field engagement while contributing meaningfully to a collaborative, strategy-driven medical team.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• Strategic Engagement: Serve as the primary scientific partner to regional KOLs, laboratories, and clinical stakeholders.

• Relationship Management: Build and sustain trusted, long-term partnerships to understand evolving customer needs and gaps.

• Insight Generation: Lead high-value scientific exchanges to capture actionable insights that inform medical strategy and portfolio planning.

• KOL Mapping & CRM Excellence: Identify emerging leaders and maintain accurate, timely documentation of interactions and insights in SFDC.

• Scientific Exchange & Education: Deliver impactful, non-promotional education to clinicians and laboratorians (in-person and virtual).

• Tailored Educational Support: Assess needs and provide customized resources (e.g., presentations, pipeline updates, speaker programs, PACE).

• Medical Expertise & Compliance: Maintain deep therapeutic knowledge and respond to unsolicited and off-label inquiries in line with compliance standards.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with medical and cross-functional teams to execute regional plans, support launches, and contribute to advisory boards and congress activities.

• Medical Excellence & Team Contribution: Ensure scientific accuracy, share best practices, support onboarding, and drive continuous improvement across MSA.

Who You Are:

• You are a scientifically credible, field-ready expert who is comfortable engaging laboratory directors, medical directors, clinical specialists, and senior clinical stakeholders as a peer. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Medizinische Wissenschaftliche Liaison (West-Zentrum, USA) Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Die Gelegenheit: Die Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL) ist ein feldbasierter Wissenschaftsführer, der Roche Medical & Scientific Affairs für Labor- und klinische Stakeholder in Ihrer Region vertritt. In dieser Rolle werden Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Labordirektoren, Kliniker und wichtige Entscheidungsträger dienen. Sie werden komplexe diagnostische und klinische Daten in einen sinnvollen Dialog übersetzen, der die Patientenversorgung voranbringt und die regionale und nationale medizinische Strategie informiert. Sie werden eng mit Sr. Scientific Managern und Sr. Medical Managern zusammenarbeiten, um einen integrierten medizinischen Plan zu gestalten und zu implementieren, der in realen Einblicken aus dem Bereich entwickelt wird. Sie bringen die Stimme des Kunden zu unserem medizinischen Plan und unserer Strategie. Ihre Perspektive wird direkt beeinflussen, wie wir Bildungsinitiativen priorisieren, Labore unterstützen und den Zugang zu innovativen Diagnosen für Patienten beschleunigen. Diese Rolle sitzt im Team von Cardiometabolism/Neurology (Core Lab und NPC) in Medical & Scientific Affairs und erfordert wissenschaftliche Tiefe, intellektuelle Neugier und die Fähigkeit, Peers in hochrangigen klinischen und technischen Diskussionen zu beschäftigen. Während Sie in einem bestimmten Krankheitsgebiet eine tiefe Expertise bringen können, müssen Sie sich bequem in eine Vielzahl von Krankheitsthemen ausdehnen und Ihre wissenschaftlichen Grundlagen und Wissensbasis kontinuierlich stärken. Dies ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der in unabhängigem Feldengagement lebt und sinnvoll zu einem kollaborativen, strategiegetriebenen medizinischen Team beiträgt. Schlüsselrollen und Aufgaben:
• Strategisches Engagement: Als primärer wissenschaftlicher Partner für regionale KOLs, Labors und klinische Stakeholder dienen.
• Beziehungsmanagement: Aufbau und Erhaltung vertrauenswürdiger, langfristiger Partnerschaften, um die sich entwickelnden Kundenbedürfnisse und Lücken zu verstehen.
• Insight Generation: Führen Sie hochwertig wissenschaftliche Austausche, um handlungsfähige Erkenntnisse zu erfassen, die die medizinische Strategie und Portfolioplanung informieren.
• KOL Mapping & CRM Excellence: Erkennen Sie aufstrebende Führungskräfte und halten Sie genaue, rechtzeitige Dokumentation von Interaktionen und Erkenntnissen im SFDC.
• Wissenschaftlicher Austausch & Bildung: Verbringen Sie wirkungslose, nicht promotionale Ausbildung an Kliniker und Arbeiter (in-person und virtuell).
• Maßgeschneiderte pädagogische Unterstützung: Assess braucht und bietet kundenspezifische Ressourcen (z.B. Präsentationen, Pipeline-Updates, Lautsprecherprogramme, PACE).
• Medizinische Expertise & Compliance: Erhalten Sie fundiertes therapeutisches Wissen und reagieren Sie auf unaufgeforderte und Off-Label-Anfragen entsprechend den Compliance-Standards.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner mit medizinischen und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zur Durchführung von Regionalplänen, Support-Starts und Beitrag zu Beratungsräten und Kongressaktivitäten.
• Medical Excellence & Team-Beitrag: Stellen Sie die wissenschaftliche Genauigkeit sicher, teilen Sie die besten Praktiken, unterstützen Sie Onboarding und treiben Sie eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung über MSA. Wer sind Sie?
• Sie sind ein wissenschaftlich glaubwürdiger, feldbereiter Experte, der sich mit Labordirektoren, medizinischen Direktoren, klinischen Spezialisten und hochrangigen klinischen Stakeholdern als Peer beschäftigt. Sie arbeiten unabhängig, denken strategisch und übersetzen komplexe diagnostische und klinische Daten in einen sinnvollen Dialog
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Liaison médicale scientifique (région du Centre-Ouest, États-Unis) Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. La possibilité : La Liaison Scientifique Médicale (LSM) est un chef de file scientifique sur le terrain qui représente Roche Affaires Médicales et Scientifiques auprès des intervenants en laboratoire et cliniques de votre région. Dans ce rôle, vous serez un partenaire de confiance pour les directeurs de laboratoire, les cliniciens et les décideurs clés. Vous allez traduire des données diagnostiques et cliniques complexes en un dialogue significatif qui fait progresser les soins aux patients et informe la stratégie médicale régionale et nationale. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec Sr. Scientific Managers et Sr. Medical Managers pour aider à façonner et à exécuter un plan médical intégré basé sur des idées du monde réel provenant du terrain. Vous apporterez la voix du client à notre plan et stratégie médicale. Votre point de vue influencera directement la façon dont nous priorisons les initiatives éducatives, soutenons les laboratoires et accélérons l'accès aux diagnostics innovants pour les patients. Ce rôle fait partie de l'équipe Cardiométabolism/Neurologie (Core Lab et NPC) des Affaires Médicales et Scientifiques et nécessite une profondeur scientifique, une curiosité intellectuelle et la capacité d'engager des pairs dans des discussions cliniques et techniques de haut niveau. Bien que vous puissiez apporter une expertise profonde dans un domaine spécifique de la maladie, vous devez être à l'aise d'étendre à une variété de sujets de la maladie et de renforcer continuellement votre base scientifique et de connaissances. Il s'agit d'un rôle pour quelqu'un qui prospère dans l'engagement indépendant sur le terrain tout en contribuant de façon significative à une équipe médicale collaborative et axée sur la stratégie. Rôles et responsabilités clés :
• Engagement stratégique : servir de partenaire scientifique principal pour les KOL, les laboratoires et les intervenants cliniques régionaux.
• Gestion des relations : établir et maintenir des partenariats fiables à long terme pour comprendre l'évolution des besoins et des lacunes des clients.
• Insight Generation: Diriger des échanges scientifiques de grande valeur afin de recueillir des informations concrètes qui éclairent la stratégie médicale et la planification du portefeuille.
• KOL Mapping & CRM Excellence: Identifier les leaders émergents et maintenir une documentation précise et opportune des interactions et des idées dans la SFDC.
• Échanges scientifiques et éducation : offrir une éducation pertinente et non promotionnelle aux cliniciens et aux travailleurs (en personne et virtuellement).
• Soutien éducatif adapté : évaluer les besoins et fournir des ressources personnalisées (p. ex. présentations, mises à jour des pipelines, programmes de conférenciers, PACE).
• Expertise médicale et conformité : maintenir des connaissances thérapeutiques approfondies et répondre aux demandes non sollicitées et non étiquetées conformément aux normes de conformité.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle: partenariat avec des équipes médicales et interfonctionnelles pour exécuter des plans régionaux, soutenir les lancements et contribuer aux activités des conseils consultatifs et des congrès.
• L'excellence médicale et la contribution de l'équipe : assurer l'exactitude scientifique, partager les meilleures pratiques, le soutien à bord et favoriser l'amélioration continue de la MSA. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes un expert scientifiquement crédible, prêt sur le terrain qui est à l'aise d'engager les directeurs de laboratoire, les directeurs médicaux, les spécialistes cliniques et les principaux intervenants cliniques en tant que pairs. Vous travaillez de façon indépendante, pensez stratégiquement et traduisez des données diagnostiques et cliniques complexes en dialogue significatif

jobs.title: Spécialiste du service client
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Spécialiste du service client
Lieu: Campus Roche Diagnostics (Laval) - Hybride
Durée : contrat d'un an

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. À faire progresser continuellement la science et à garantir à tous l'accès aux soins de santé dont ils ont besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les personnes que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Nous recherchons un(e) spécialiste du service client pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact significatif sur notre organisation. En tant que spécialiste du service client, vous aurez l'occasion de développer des relations de confiance solides avec nos précieux clients, en veillant à une expérience d'approvisionnement positive.

En identifiant proactivement les besoins des clients et en collaborant avec notre équipe, vous contribuerez à améliorer et à adapter l'expérience globale du client. Vos solides compétences en leadership et en influence vous permettront de remettre en question le statu quo et de rechercher l'efficacité, en faisant des recommandations qui garantissent un service fiable et constant. Par-dessus tout, vos compétences exceptionnelles en communication et votre capacité d'écoute active seront la clé de la réussite dans ce rôle.
Rejoignez notre équipe et saisissez cette opportunité passionnante pour une croissance personnelle et professionnelle. Postulez maintenant et laissez votre passion pour des expériences client exceptionnelles briller en tant que spécialiste du service client.

L'opportunité

• Vous gérez les solutions de lots réservés pour tous les clients du Canada, en veillant au respect des politiques et des procédures de Roche. En collaboration étroite avec l'équipe de planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous vous assurez de l'exactitude des données et de la gestion des demandes des clients, des renouvellements et de la maintenance des contrats pour assurer un flux de commandes efficace.

• Vous êtes responsable de l'analyse et de la communication avec les clients concernant les problèmes de lots réservés, ainsi que de la transmission des besoins des clients à l'équipe de planification.

• Vous gérez des comptes spécialisés avec des exceptions logistiques, en maintenant et en gérant des "accords planifiés" pour tous les clients/territoires afin d'assurer des niveaux élevés d'exactitude des données.

• Vous prenez les appels des clients et apportez un soutien à leurs demandes, en collaborant avec les équipes régionales pour offrir une expérience d'approvisionnement exceptionnelle.

• Vous comprenez les plaintes logistiques des clients et vous efforcez de trouver des solutions satisfaisantes. Vous identifiez et proposez des améliorations aux processus manuels et aux tâches de service client sans valeur ajoutée.

• Vous êtes responsable des ajustements de facture (crédits/débits) conformément aux procédures, le cas échéant.

• Vous analysez les rapports quotidiens, élaborez des plans d'action pour traiter les commandes en cours et communiquez tout retard ou changement de délai de livraison et de traitement aux clients à des fins de planification.

Qui vous êtes

• Vous possédez un diplôme collégial ou un diplôme universitaire (administration ou commerce préférable).

• Vous possédez au moins 3 ans d'expérience en service à la clientèle dans le domaine des soins de santé ou des sciences de la vie.

• Vous faites preuve de compétences en leadership et avez une passion pour la collab

En collaboration étroite avec l'équipe de planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous vous assurez de l'exactitude des données et de la gestion des demandes des clients, des renouvellements et de la maintenance des contrats pour assurer un flux de commandes efficace.
• Vous êtes responsable de l'analyse et de la communication avec les clients concernant les problèmes de lots réservés, ainsi que de la transmission des besoins des clients à l'équipe de planification.
• Vous gérez des comptes spécialisés avec des exceptions logistiques, en maintenant et en gérant des "accords planifiés" pour tous les clients/territoires afin d'assurer des niveaux élevés d'exactitude des données.
• Vous prenez les appels des clients et apportez un soutien à leurs demandes, en collaborant avec les équipes régionales pour offrir une expérience d'approvisionnement exceptionnelle.
• Vous comprenez les plaintes logistiques des clients et vous efforcez de trouver des solutions satisfaisantes. Vous identifiez et proposez des améliorations aux processus manuels et aux tâches de service client sans valeur ajoutée.
• Vous êtes responsable des ajustements de facture (crédits/débits) conformément aux procédures, le cas échéant.
• Vous analysez les rapports quotidiens, élaborez des plans d'action pour traiter les commandes en cours et communiquez tout retard ou changement de délai de livraison et de traitement aux clients à des fins de planification. Qui vous êtes
• Vous possédez un diplôme collégial ou un diplôme universitaire (administration ou commerce préférable).
• Vous possédez au moins 3 ans d'expérience en service à la clientèle dans le domaine des soins de santé ou des sciences de la vie.
• Vous faites preuve de compétences en leadership et avez une passion pour la collab

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses.

The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires up to 25% travel. This person will support Hoover, AL.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Hoover, AL is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

jobs.title: Histotechnician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Histotechnician will work in supporting the functions of histology in the performance of routine histotechniques.

The opportunity:

• Histotechniques (Tissue Sectioning and Staining),

• Maintains basic understanding of foundational histotechniques of embedding, microtomy, coverslipping, processing and primary staining.

• Demonstrates experience with special and advanced staining techniques on automated staining platforms.

• Receives detailed directions on all work. Follows standard operating procedures.

• May perform cell block preparation, screening tissue, cryotomy special staining, advanced staining, grossing and tissue processing.

• May assist in preparation work for complex techniques under the direction of more senior histology technicians.

​ Quality and Safety

• Maintains Right to Operate and ensures that all processes are performed in a safe and healthy manner;

• Addresses and escalates any potentially unsafe hazards; Ensures timely reporting of safety hazards, incidents and near misses using safety reporting tools.

• Navigates and understands the quality system and escalates issues.

• Accurately performs tasks in a regulated environment (OSHA, NMPA, FDA, etc.).

• Performs and documents all transactions and production instructions with accuracy related to the proper receipt, quarantine, storage, and disbursement of materials as it relates to FDA, OSHA, QSR, ISO, Good

• Manufacturing Practices and other Roche policies and procedures.

• Assists with non-conformance investigations, reworks, and corrective actions.

• Participates in the review of and provides feedback on document changes, including redlines.

• Adheres to 95% or above internal training compliance.

• Maintains calibrated equipment including automated staining instrument and equipment maintenance.

• Maintains complete and accurate records including daily metrics.

Who you are:

Education and Experience Requirements:

• High School Diploma or GED: Required. Candidates must have at least 5 years of directly related histology experience with a high school diploma or GED.

• Associate's Degree: Preferred. Equivalent to 60 credit hours of college coursework in laboratory science, medical laboratory technology, or a major in histology. Requires 2 years of directly related histology experience for applicants with an Associate's Degree or equivalent coursework.

• Bachelor's Degree: Preferred. Applicants with a Bachelor's Degree require 1 year of directly related histology experience.

Certifications:

• HT (ASCP) Certification: Required for candidates with an Associate's Degree or Bachelor's Degree.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Ability to read, analyze and following Operating Procedures.

• Knowledge of foundational histotechniques embedding, microtomy, staining and coverslipping.

• Knowledge of basic and specialized laboratory techniques.

• Skilled with use of word processing and email use.

• Demonstrated experience with Lean / Continuous Improvement.

• Experience with Google products (gMail, gSheets, gDoc, etc).

• Experience with SAP.

• Ability to read, write and comprehend English.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer

Job description
The Mission: You will be a key member of the SIEM team, contributing to the engineering and strategic evolution of our global Security Log Management and Vulnerability Scanning services. This is an end-to-end ownership role: from defining the roadmap and architectural strategy to hands-on engineering and operational excellence. You will ensure our security infrastructure is not only reliable and scalable but also optimized for the modern era of federated data and AI-driven automation.
Description of the area

Key Responsibilities:

• Service Ownership & Strategy: Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our Security Log Management (Splunk & Cribl) and Security Scanning (Tenable) platforms.

• Service Reliability: Ensure the high availability and performance of our security services globally, acting as an escalation point for complex technical challenges.

• System Interconnectivity: Develop and manage sophisticated API integrations to ensure seamless data flow between the security scanning (Tenable) and logging (Splunk/Cribl) tiers.

• Next-Gen Security Log Architecture: Drive the transition from a traditional "index-all" logging approach to a "data-tiering" mindset. You will focus on cost optimization and performance across all data lifecycle phases: routing, filtering, storing and searching, ensuring security data is accessible and cost-effective.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Orchestrate the evolution of our security infrastructure by managing all configurations via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub, Ansible, and Python), to ensure a fully automated and version-controlled environment.

• AI-Augmented Engineering: Actively integrate AI Agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into daily operations. You will build agentic AI workflows to automate configuration, troubleshooting, and complex interconnectivity, while simultaneously improving service offerings and user experience.

• Mentorship: Act as a technical catalyst for the team, mentoring colleagues in the art of prompt engineering, agentic AI development, and advanced AI ecosystems.

• Technical Leadership: Serve as a technical lead, defining implementation plans and driving continuous process improvements.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Effectively manage relationships across functional teams, acting as a clear communicator and advisor to ensure alignment on security goals and project delivery.

Technical Requirements & Expertise:

• Security Service Depth: Deep conceptual understanding of the SIEM/Log Management lifecycle (Collection, Indexing, Storage, Retention and Searching) and Vulnerability Management.

• Networking Fundamentals: Expert understanding of networking (TCP/IP, Load Balancing, Firewalls) as it relates to high-volume security data transport.

• Coding & API Mastery: Strong experience with Python and interacting with complex REST APIs. Proven ability to interconnect disparate technologies via APIs and custom integrations.

• Modern DevOps: Strong experience with Ansible and GitHub for managing infrastructure.

• Advanced AI/Automation: Proven experience or deep project work building Agentic AI workflows. Practical expertise in MCP (Model Context Protocol) or building custom LLM-based tools to automate technical tasks.

• Tooling (Preferred): Experience with Cribl, Splunk, or Tenable is a plus, but the ability to rapidly upscale and automate these via AI is essential.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 10
