jobs.title: Head of Customer Engagement & Marketing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

• The Head of Customer Engagement & Marketing is a pivotal executive role within the Roche Turkey Leadership Team, entrusted with holistically architecting, leading, and executing the commercial vision and go-to-market strategies for the company's entire pharmaceutical portfolio.

This role functions as the "Chief Commercial Conductor," orchestrating and unifying both the strategic business units (Disease Area Teams) and the central marketing capabilities that serve them (Marketing Leads / Marketing Chapter) under a single, cohesive vision.

This leader directly manages and develops two distinct leadership groups: the Disease Area (DA) Leads and the Marketing Leads. Through the DA Leads, they hold ultimate accountability for the therapeutic area strategies and full P&L outcomes. Concurrently, through the Marketing Leads, they are responsible for embedding marketing excellence, fostering state-of-the-art capabilities, and ensuring the agile, strategic allocation of marketing resources across the entire Organization.

The fundamental purpose of this role is to build a seamless bridge between high-level strategy and flawless execution. By leveraging a deep strategic partnership with the Medical, Access, Regulatory & Government affairs, as well as the Business Excellence Division, this leader will ensure Roche achieves its ambitious market leadership and patient impact goals.

Core Responsibilities and Accountabilities

1. Integrated Commercial, Access, Medical, and Government Affairs strategy & execution:

• Architect and drive the overarching commercial strategy for all Disease Areas, ensuring the creation of integrated, omnichannel marketing and sales plans that are executed with excellence in the field.

• Lead portfolio-level strategic planning, including lifecycle management, competitive readiness, and new asset launch sequencing to maximize the long-term commercial value and patient impact of Roche’s portfolio.

• Assume ultimate ownership of commercial forecasting in partnership with finance, resource allocation, and budget management to ensure financial targets are met, and investments yield maximum ROI.

•
2. Disease Area (DA) P&L and Performance Leadership:

• Provide strategic direction, coaching, and empowerment to the DA Leads, holding full P&L accountability for the entire commercial organization. Drive the achievement of ambitious revenue growth, market share, and profitability targets.

• Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and urgency within the DA teams, ensuring they remain laser-focused on overcoming obstacles and achieving their strategic objectives.

• Ensure DA teams have the necessary resources, capabilities, and cross-functional support to win in their respective markets.

•
3. Marketing Capability & Excellence (Marketing Lead) Leadership:

• Lead and cultivate the central Marketing Leads (Marketing Chapter) team, acting as the chief steward of marketing talent and capability within the organization.

• Take direct responsibility for the professional development, career progression, performance management, and succession planning for the marketing talent pool.

• Implement a dynamic resource allocation model, ensuring marketing expertise is deployed fluidly and effectively to the highest-priority strategic initiatives within the DA teams.

• Champion and embed a culture of marketing excellence across the organization, setting the gold standard for brand planning, digital marketing, data analytics, customer journey mapping,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Chapter Lead, Head of SBX Assays, you will drive the clinical translation of cutting-edge technology into RUO and regulated products the redefine the standard of care in precision oncology and genetics. You will provide strategic and technical leadership to define the next generation of oncology diagnostics - ranging from multi-cancer detection to ultra-sensitive MRD monitoring.

You will lead the end-to-end evolution of novel clinical solutions, bridging the gap between novel workflow tools and high-throughput commercial implementation. Your leadership will ensure that our assays are not just innovative, but are robust, scalable, and clinically validated to meet the most stringent regulatory standards (PMA/IVD).

Key Responsibilities

• Oncology Product Roadmap : Partner with Executive Leadership and Business teams to identify high-value clinical unmet needs and translate them into a multi-year technology roadmap.

• Strategic Execution : Drive end to end development of proprietary oncology assays, including defining performance requirements (LOD, sensitivity, specificity) that exceed current market standards..

• Product Realization & Scale : Oversee the critical transition of assays from R&D into a CLIA/CAP or IVD-regulated environment, ensuring manufacturability and operational scalability.

• Assay Innovation & De-risking : Implement and de-risk emerging technologies for use in clinical applications (e.g., epigenetics, fragmentomics, multi-omics).

• Regulatory : Partner with Regulatory and Quality teams to design analytical validation studies (LoD, LoB, Precision) that meet FDA/PMA standards for Breakthrough Device designations.

• Evidence Generation & KOL Engagement : Help define the clinical evidence strategy required for medical utility based on high-level scientific exchange with top-tier academic centers and biopharma partners.

• Bioinformatics Integration : Architect the interface between wet-lab chemistry and Computational Biology to optimize the "sample-to-variant" pipelines, focusing on digital error suppression and signal-to-noise optimization

• Operational Leadership: Drive 'Best-in-Class' technical standards across the organization, ensuring consistency in assay development methodologies and cross-functional alignment on technical KPIs

• Value Communication: Present scientific and clinical value propositions at webinars, workshops, or customer meetings.

• People & Culture: Foster a "Culture of Rigor" that balances rapid prototyping with the disciplined documentation required for regulated medical products.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a PhD or MD/PhD in Molecular Biology, Oncology, Genetics (or related fields)

• You have 12 or more years in molecular diagnostics

• You have a proven track record of launching one or more NGS-based clinical assays (IVD or high-complexity LDT)

• You have demonstrated experience managing large multidisciplinary scientific teams for 7+ years

You have the following knowledge, skills, and abilities:

• NGS Mastery : Deep expertise in library preparation (e.g., UMI tagging, hybrid capture) and their direct impact on clinical sensitivity and limit of detection (LOD).

• Clinical Vision : Comprehensive understanding of the "Cancer Continuum," including solid tumor profiling, hematological malignancies, and the nuances of liquid biopsy.

• Regulatory Experienc e: Proven track record of navigating the Design Control process (21 CFR 820) and launching at least one NGS-based cl

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. La posizione Come Capo Piombo, Capo di SBX Assays, guiderà la traduzione clinica di tecnologia all'avanguardia in RUO e prodotti regolamentati ridefinire lo standard di cura in oncologia di precisione e genetica. Fornirai leadership strategica e tecnica per definire la prossima generazione di diagnostica oncologica - che vanno dal rilevamento multi-cancro al monitoraggio MRD ultra sensibile. Potrai condurre l'evoluzione end-to-end di nuove soluzioni cliniche, colmare il divario tra nuovi strumenti di flusso di lavoro e l'implementazione commerciale ad alto rendimento. La vostra leadership garantirà che le nostre analisi non sono solo innovative, ma sono robuste, scalabili e convalidate clinicamente per soddisfare i più severi standard normativi (PMA/IVD). Principali responsabilità
• Oncology Product Roadmap: Partner con i team Executive Leadership e Business per identificare le esigenze cliniche di alto valore e tradurle in una roadmap tecnologica pluriennale.
• Esecuzione Strategica: Guidare lo sviluppo end to end delle analisi di oncologia proprietaria, compresa la definizione dei requisiti di prestazione (LOD, sensibilità, specificità) che superano gli standard di mercato attuali.
• Realizzazione e scala del prodotto: supervisionare la transizione critica dei saggi da R&D in un ambiente regolamentato CLIA/CAP o IVD, garantendo la manufacturabilità e la scalabilità operativa.
• Assay Innovation & De-risking: Implement e de-risk tecnologie emergenti da utilizzare in applicazioni cliniche (ad esempio epigenetica, fragmentomica, multi-omica).
• Regolazione: Partner con i team di regolamentazione e qualità per progettare studi di validazione analitica (LoD, LoB, Precision) che soddisfano gli standard FDA/PMA per le designazioni dei dispositivi Breakthrough.
• Evidence Generation & KOL Engagement: Aiuta a definire la strategia di prova clinica necessaria per l'utilità medica basata su uno scambio scientifico di alto livello con centri accademici di alto livello e partner biofarmaci.
• Integrazione bioinformatica: Architetto l'interfaccia tra chimica a lastra bagnata e biologia computazionale per ottimizzare le tubazioni "sample-to-varianti", concentrandosi sulla soppressione degli errori digitali e sull'ottimizzazione del segnale-to-noise
• Leadership operativa: Drive 'Best-in-Class' standard tecnici in tutta l'organizzazione, assicurando coerenza nelle metodologie di sviluppo del test e allineamento interfunzionale sui KPI tecnici
• Comunicazione del valore: Presentare proposte di valore scientifico e clinico presso webinar, workshop o riunioni dei clienti.
• Persone & Cultura: Promuovere una "Cultura di Rigor" che bilancia la prototipazione rapida con la documentazione disciplinata richiesta per i prodotti medici regolamentati. Chi sei? (richiesto)
• Hai un PhD o MD/PhD in Biologia Molecolare, Oncologia, Genetica (o campi correlati)
• Hai 12 o più anni di diagnostica molecolare
• Hai una comprovata traccia di lancio di uno o più test clinici basati su NGS (IVD o LDT ad alta complessità)
• Hai dimostrato esperienza nella gestione di grandi team scientifici multidisciplinari per 7+ anni Hai le seguenti conoscenze, competenze e abilità:
• Mastery NGS: Profonda esperienza nella preparazione della libreria (ad esempio, UMI tagging, cattura ibrida) e il loro impatto diretto sulla sensibilità clinica e il limite di rilevamento (LOD).
• Visione clinica: comprensione completa del "Continuum del cancro", compresa la profilazione del tumore solido, le maligne ematologiche e le sfumature della biopsia liquida.
• Esperienc regolamentare e: Provato record di traccia di navigazione del processo di Design Control (21 CFR 820) e lancio di almeno un CGS

So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. • Sie haben Erfahrungsmanagement von großen multidisziplinären wissenschaftlichen Teams für 7+ Jahre gezeigt Sie haben folgende Kenntnisse, Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten:

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que chef de chapitre, chef de SBX Assays, vous dirigerez la traduction clinique de la technologie de pointe en RUO et des produits réglementés la redéfinition de la norme de soins en oncologie de précision et en génétique. Vous fournirez un leadership stratégique et technique pour définir la prochaine génération de diagnostics oncologiques - allant de la détection multicancer à la surveillance MRD ultra-sensible. Vous dirigerez l'évolution de bout en bout de nouvelles solutions cliniques, comblant l'écart entre les nouveaux outils de workflow et la mise en œuvre commerciale à haut débit. Votre leadership s'assurera que nos tests ne sont pas seulement innovateurs, mais qu'ils sont robustes, évolutifs et cliniquement validés pour répondre aux normes réglementaires les plus strictes (PMA/IVD). Principales responsabilités
• Feuille de route des produits en oncologie : partenariat avec des équipes de direction et d'affaires pour identifier les besoins cliniques non satisfaits de grande valeur et les traduire en feuille de route technologique pluriannuelle.
• Exécution stratégique : Conduire le développement final de tests d'oncologie propriétaires, y compris la définition des exigences de performance (LOD, sensibilité, spécificité) qui dépassent les normes actuelles du marché.
• Réalisation et échelle du produit : Superviser la transition critique des essais de la R-D vers un environnement réglementé par CLIA/CAP ou IVD, en assurant la fabrication et l'évolutivité opérationnelle.
• Assay Innovation & De-risque : Implémenter et dé-risquer des technologies émergentes pour une utilisation clinique (p. ex. épigénétique, fragmentomique, multi-omique).
• Réglementation : S'associer à des équipes de réglementation et de qualité pour concevoir des études de validation analytique (LoD, LoB, Precision) qui répondent aux normes FDA/PMA pour les désignations d'appareils de démonstration.
• Evidence Generation & KOL Engagement : aide à définir la stratégie de preuve clinique nécessaire à l'utilité médicale basée sur des échanges scientifiques de haut niveau avec des centres universitaires de haut niveau et des partenaires biopharmaceutiques.
• Intégration de la bioinformatique : Architecte l'interface entre la chimie du labo humide et la biologie computationnelle pour optimiser les pipelines "sample-to-variant", en se concentrant sur la suppression des erreurs numériques et l'optimisation du signal-to-bruit
• Leadership opérationnel : Diriger les normes techniques « meilleures en classe » dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, assurer la cohérence des méthodes de développement des essais et l'alignement interfonctionnel sur les ICR techniques
• Value Communication: Présentez des propositions de valeur scientifique et clinique lors de webinaires, d'ateliers ou de réunions de clients.
• People & Culture: Favoriser une « culture de la rigueur » qui équilibre le prototypage rapide avec la documentation disciplinée requise pour les produits médicaux réglementés. Qui vous êtes : (Requis)
• Vous avez un doctorat ou un doctorat en biologie moléculaire, oncologie, génétique (ou domaines connexes)
• Vous avez 12 ans ou plus dans le diagnostic moléculaire
• Vous avez prouvé que vous avez lancé un ou plusieurs tests cliniques basés sur les NGS (DIV ou haute complexité LDT)
• Vous avez fait preuve d'expérience dans la gestion de grandes équipes scientifiques multidisciplinaires pendant 7 ans et plus Vous avez les connaissances, les compétences et les capacités suivantes :
• Maîtrise NGS : Une expertise approfondie dans la préparation des bibliothèques (par exemple, marquage UMI, capture hybride) et leur impact direct sur la sensibilité clinique et la limite de détection (LOD).
• Vision clinique : Compréhension complète du « continuum du cancer », incluant le profilage des tumeurs solides, les tumeurs hématologiques et les nuances de la biopsie liquide.
• Expérience en matière de réglementation : expérience éprouvée de la navigation sur le processus de contrôle de conception (21 CFR 820) et lancement d'au moins un cl basé sur les NGS

jobs.title: Head of Healthcare Transformation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• The Head of Healthcare Transformation serves as a cornerstone in advancing Roche Diagnostics' commitment to enhancing patient care. By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.

• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.

• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.

• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.

• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.

• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next."

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.

• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Market Access & Reimbursement: Drive successful NHI (National Health Insurance) listing and optimal pricing strategies for key diagnostic products, utilizing health economics and outcomes research (HEOR).

• Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proactively monitor the healthcare policy landscape. Engage collaboratively with government authorities (e.g., MOHW, NHIA), industry associations, and patient advocacy groups to shape favorable policies for diagnostic innovations.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

• Team Leadership & VACC Culture: Lead, coach, and inspire a cross-functional Medical, Market Access, Policy and Business Development team to unl

jobs.title: Patient Solution Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称：患者解决方案经理

您是谁：
患者解决方案经理是相应疾病领域 HCP(医疗专业人士)的主要接触点,负责制定患者整体解决方案相关的策略和相关项目的支持和执行工作,包含但不限于患者全程管理、创新支付解决方案、疾病认知(患者教育)、准入及安全运营以及上市前后产品的学术平台搭建等,从而提升标准化诊疗水平,提高患者知晓率和可及性,从而实现患者获益。

您的机会：
患者全程管理
1.在生态圈内绘制患者就医流转图,从而更好的推动全程管理在医院内/间的落地。
2.协助生态圈内医院及相关科室推进和打造会诊通道,协助上下层医院间衔接流转,助力绿色转诊通道的建立,最终实现患者获益。
3.管理生态圈内患者全程管理项目的各项落地实施,并确保其合规性。

支付方案
与准入团队合作,协助整合罗氏相关支付方案,传递完整支付解决方案信息。

疾病认知(患者教育)
与第三方机构协作,针对相关疾病领域区域现状及整体策略,协助开展患者教育,提升疾病认知,促进患者获益。

我们期待这样的您加入：
• 成长性思维和快速学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 优秀的沟和资源整合能力
• 5年以上医药行业工作经验,有管理经验者优先
• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

We are seeking an architect-level Principal Software Engineer II to lead the software evolution of Roche’s proprietary sequencing technology, SBX.
In this role, you will bridge the gap between experimental data science and industrial software engineering. While you will still engage with the "science" of DNA sequencing, your primary mandate is to engineer the systems that make that science scalable, reproducible, and fast. You will serve as the Technical Lead for a hybrid squad, driving the transition of experimental AI/models from Jupyter notebooks into robust, version-controlled, and highly optimized production libraries running on high-performance infrastructure.

You will define the software architecture for SBX data analysis. You are not just analyzing data; you are building the engine that processes it. You will ensure that our basecalling and sequencing algorithms are not only accurate but are also performant, maintainable, and deployable at scale.

The Opportunity

• Define and enforce software engineering standards, including clean code practices, comprehensive unit/integration testing, and mandatory code reviews within the data science team.

• Develop modular and extensible software libraries for DNA analysis, separating algorithmic logic from infrastructure code.

• Implement and oversee continuous integration and deployment pipelines to automate testing and streamline research code release cycles.

• Optimize performance of Python/PyTorch codebases, reimplementing critical bottlenecks in C++ and CUDA for GPU cluster efficiency.

• Convert theoretical bioinformatics concepts into highly efficient production-ready code.

• Design and implement solutions for effective memory management and I/O operations, tailored for large-scale genomic datasets.

• Build infrastructure for managing model versioning, registries, and monitoring for streamlined machine learning workflows.

• Design low-latency inference serving architectures for deploying deep learning models in production environments.

• Promote and implement containerization tools like Docker and Singularity for consistent execution environments across research and production.

• Architect distributed computing workflows and pipelines using tools like Nextflow and Airflow, ensuring production-grade performance and reliability in computational workflows.

• Develop dynamic workload managers and submission scripts to optimize resource use on SLURM-managed HPC clusters.

Who you are

• Ph.D. or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, or related technical field.

• 7+ years (with PhD) or 5+ years (with MS) of industrial experience related to productionizing ML models or building scientific software.

• Expert-level proficiency in Python (OOP, design patterns) and strong proficiency in a compiled language C/C++. Deep understanding of data structures and algorithmic complexity.

• Proven experience deploying Deep Learning models (PyTorch/TensorFlow) into production. Familiarity with ONNX, TensorRT, or model quantization is a plus.

• Advanced knowledge of Linux internals, shell scripting, and container orchestration. Experience managing workloads on HPC (SLURM) or Cloud (A

jobs.title: Clinical Operation Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job
Clinical Trial Document Preparation and Archiving
·Be familiar with the content of clinical trial master file and
investigator site file based on the requirements of ICH GCP, China regulation
and Roche SOPs, guidance.
·Support to prepare site file before study start up
·Review the closed clinical trial documents, support archiving
responsible to arrange and archive them according to related SOP requirements.

Business Support to Department
·Understand ICH GCP, China GCP and related regulation on clinical trials.
·Support SSUS to prepare the essential EC submission package according to
required timeline.
·Support SSUS on site budget and contract preparation.
·Maintains and analyzes study data (metrics) on assigned studies. Support
PDG China to identify opportunities for continuous improvement
·Update and maintain the data in CDE platform according to regulatory and
SOP requirements.
·Support local clinical operation data cleaning and management

General Office Duties
·Provide general office support to PDG China department staff (including
but not limited to photocopying, distributing mail/faxes, scanning, faxing,).
·Organize courier services for documents/ goods pick-up.
·Help to arrange meetings or meeting logistics
·Perform other tasks, as assigned by line manager

Qualification and Experience

Education/
• Qualifications
·Bachelor degree or above
·Major in public health, data science, computer science, pharmacy,
biology or related

Personality
·Good ownership and focus on details
·Logical and efficient with highly compliance
·Be willing to learn, think and practice

Job Required Competencies
·Strong computer skill for Window 7, Microsoft 2010 (PPT, Excel, Word)
·Strong communication skills
·Fluent English written and oral capability

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Department
We are a global team of 100+ biostatisticians and data scientists united by the ambition to advance diagnostic assays and elevate their use in clinical practice. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to provide robust quantitative methods for all stages of the product lifecycle—from early research to market registration. By combining our statistical expertise with a profound understanding of the clinical questions at hand, we extract actionable information from data and deliver customer-tailored insights.

Your Team
Our team thrives on creating innovative solutions for both novel and traditional challenges in data analysis. We are heavily involved in early biomarker discovery projects, aiming to identify new biomarkers and develop clinical algorithms that solve unmet medical needs. To achieve our goals, we leverage data from clinical trials as well as real-world data. Collaboration is at our core; we work in close partnership with colleagues across clinical science, clinical operations, business, and assay development.

Your Main Objectives and Tasks

• Conduct exploratory data analysis of clinical data and develop clinical algorithms by applying state-of-the-art statistical and machine learning methods.

• Perform statistical analysis for clinical studies and real world data, generate analysis reports, and present findings to stakeholders.

• Analyze data from biomarker discovery experiments using multivariate and machine learning techniques.

• Support peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate the clinical utility of your results.

• Proactively contribute to and support cross-functional project teams.

Who You Are

• You hold a university degree (Master’s) in (Bio-)Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, (Bio-)Informatics, or a comparable field; a Ph.D. is a plus.

• You possess proven expertise in applying biostatistical and machine learning methods to clinical data, ideally in the context of biomarker evaluation or similar research tasks.

• You have excellent knowledge of R or a comparable programming language.

• You bring exceptional communication and analytical skills, with a strong desire to continuously expand your knowledge and apply new quantitative methodologies.

• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
In this role, you join the global Talent Marketing team which aims to position Roche as the employer of choice for key candidates with targeted and innovative approaches to meet & address hiring and market needs.

• Shape our global brand by creating engaging video, social media, and visual content that showcases Roche as an employer of choice to talent worldwide.

• Gain experience through the support of high-impact content campaigns across LinkedIn, Instagram, and our global careers webpage.

• Master content management at scale by gaining hands-on experience with our global platforms, ensuring brand quality stays consistent across all channels.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Recruiting, Communications, and creative teams to bring authentic employer storytelling to life.

• D rive engagement by producing content that authentically represents Roche culture, helping to inspire and increase candidate applications.

• Innovate with new formats by experimenting with emerging digital trends and tools to keep our visual language at the cutting edge.

• Experience a culture of trust where your creative ideas are valued and you are empowered to take ownership of your projects.

Who you are
We are looking for a creative storyteller who is passionate about digital media and global collaboration.

• Visual Storyteller: You have demonstrable experience with video filming and editing , whether through academic projects, a personal portfolio, or professional work. Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) or similar platforms is an advantage.

• Brand-Aware: You understand how consistent visual language strengthens a message and enjoy working within brand guidelines to ensure quality.

• Curious and Self-Driven: You take initiative, enjoy experimenting with new content formats, and thrive in an environment that encourages continuous growth.

• Strong Communicator: You are fluent in English and feel comfortable collaborating with diverse, international teams across different time zones.

• Educational Background: You are a student or recent graduate in Communications, Marketing, Media, or a related creative field. Please note that your graduation date must not be more than 12 months prior to your start date.

Application process:
Please upload a current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship.

Additional Information:
Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship.

# Roche - Global Talent Marketing Internship ## Mansioni In questo ruolo, ti unirai al team globale di Marketing del Talento, con l'obiettivo di posizionare Roche come il datore di lavoro preferito per i candidati chiave attraverso approcci mirati e innovativi per soddisfare e affrontare le esigenze di assunzione e del mercato. - Crea contenuti video, sui social media e visivi coinvolgenti che mostrano Roche come il datore di lavoro preferito per i talenti in tutto il mondo. - Acquisisci esperienza attraverso il supporto di campagne di contenuti ad alto impatto su LinkedIn, Instagram e sulla pagina delle carriere globale di Roche. - Gestisci i contenuti a livello globale, acquisendo esperienza pratica con le piattaforme globali di Roche, garantendo la qualità del marchio in tutti i canali. - Collabora con le funzioni di recruiting, comunicazione e creative per portare alla vita storie autentiche del datore di lavoro. - Produci contenuti che rappresentano autenticamente la cultura di Roche, aiutando a ispirare e aumentare le candidature dei candidati. - Innovare con nuovi formati sperimentando con le tendenze e gli strumenti digitali emergenti per mantenere il nostro linguaggio visivo all'avanguardia. - Esperienza una cultura di fiducia in cui le tue idee creative sono apprezzate e sei autorizzato a prendere il controllo dei tuoi progetti. ## Chi sei
• Stiamo cercando un narratore creativo appassionato di media digitali e collaborazione globale. - Narratore Visivo: Hai esperienza dimostrabile nella ripresa e nel montaggio video, indipendentemente dal fatto che sia attraverso progetti accademici, un portfolio personale o lavoro professionale. La familiarità con gli strumenti come Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) o piattaforme simili è un vantaggio. - Consapevole del Marchio: Capisci come il linguaggio visivo coerente rafforza un messaggio e ti piace lavorare all'interno delle linee guida del marchio per garantire la qualità. - Curioso e Autodriven: Prendi l'iniziativa, ti piace sperimentare con nuovi formati di contenuti e prosperi in un ambiente che incoraggia la crescita continua. - Comunicatore Forte: Sei fluente in inglese e ti senti a tuo agio nel collaborare con team internazionali diversi in diversi fusi orari. - Background Educativo: Sei uno studente o un neolaureato in Comunicazione, Marketing, Media o un campo creativo correlato. Si prega di notare che la data di laurea non deve superare i 12 mesi dalla data di inizio. ## Processo di applicazione Carica un CV aggiornato e una Lettera di Motivazione, in cui si indica la data preferita per l'inizio del tirocinio. ## Informazioni aggiuntive Si prega di notare che, a causa dei regolamenti, i cittadini non UE/EEA devono fornire un certificato dall'università che attesti che un tirocinio è obbligatorio come parte dei documenti di applicazione e devono essere costantemente iscritti all'università per tutta la durata di questo tirocinio. Se sei entusiasta di contribuire e senti di avere la dedizione al lavoro di squadra e all'innovazione che cerchiamo, allora Roche è l'organizzazione per te. Ogni ruolo in Roche gioca un ruolo nel fare la differenza per le vite dei pazienti. Se vuoi lavorare in un team appassionato, lasciare il tuo segno e migliorare le vite, applica ora! ## Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge all'innovazione. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati ad avanzare la scienza, garantendo che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri medicinali e più di 30 miliardi di test effettuati utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici.

Die Vertrautheit mit Tools wie Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) oder ähnlichen Plattformen ist ein Vorteil. - Achtung der Marke: Verstehen Sie, wie konsistente visuelle Sprache eine Nachricht stärkt und Sie gerne in den Richtlinien der Marke arbeiten, um Qualität zu gewährleisten. - Kurios und Autodriven: Nehmen Sie die Initiative, Sie möchten mit neuen Inhaltsformaten und -reifen in einer Umgebung experimentieren, die ein kontinuierliches Wachstum fördert. - Pressemitteilung: Sie sind fließend in Englisch und fühlen sich wohl, mit verschiedenen internationalen Teams in verschiedenen Zeitzonen zu arbeiten. - Bildungshintergrund: Sie sind Student oder Absolventen in Kommunikation, Marketing, Medien oder einem verwandten kreativen Bereich. Bitte beachten Sie, dass das Abschlussdatum 12 Monate ab dem Startdatum nicht überschreiten sollte. Anwendungsprozess Hochladen eines aktualisierten Lebenslaufs und eines Motivationsschreibens, das das bevorzugte Datum für den Beginn des Praktikums anzeigt. Weitere Informationen Bitte beachten Sie, dass Nicht-EU/EWR-Bürger aufgrund der Verordnungen eine Bescheinigung der Universität vorlegen müssen, die bescheinigt, dass ein Praktikum im Rahmen der Bewerbungsunterlagen obligatorisch ist und für die Dauer dieses Praktikums an der Universität ständig eingeschrieben werden muss. Wenn Sie sich freuen, einen Beitrag zu leisten und das Gefühl haben Sie Engagement für Teamwork und Innovation, die wir suchen, dann ist Roche die Organisation für Sie. Jede Rolle in Roche spielt eine Rolle bei der Differenzierung des Patientenlebens. Wenn Sie in einem leidenschaftlichen Team arbeiten wollen, verlassen Sie Ihre Marke und verbessern Sie das Leben, bewerben Sie sich jetzt! Wer sind wir? Eine gesündere Zukunft führt uns zu Innovation. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass alle heute und für zukünftige Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung haben. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren diagnostischen Produkten durchgeführt werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Roche - Stage en marketing de talents mondiaux Expéditions Dans ce rôle, vous rejoindrez l'équipe mondiale Talent Marketing, dans le but de positionner Roche comme employeur privilégié pour les candidats clés grâce à des approches ciblées et innovantes pour répondre aux besoins de l'accueil et du marché. - Créer du contenu vidéo, sur les médias sociaux immersifs et les visuels qui montrent Roche comme l'employeur préféré pour les talents partout dans le monde. - Acquérir de l'expérience grâce au soutien de campagnes de contenu à fort impact sur LinkedIn, Instagram et la page de carrière mondiale de Roche. - Gérer le contenu à l'échelle mondiale, acquérir une expérience pratique avec les plateformes mondiales de Roche, assurant la qualité de la marque sur tous les canaux. - Collaborer avec le recrutement, la communication et les fonctions créatives pour donner vie à des histoires d'employeurs authentiques. - Produire du contenu qui représente authentiquement la culture de Roche, aidant à inspirer et à augmenter les candidatures. - Innovez avec de nouveaux formats en expérimentant les nouvelles tendances et outils numériques pour garder notre langage visuel avant-gardiste. - Vivez une culture de confiance dans laquelle vos idées créatives sont appréciées et vous êtes autorisé à prendre le contrôle de vos projets. Qui êtes-vous ? Nous recherchons un narrateur créatif passionné par les médias numériques et la collaboration mondiale. - Visive Narrator: Vous avez prouvé votre expérience dans le tournage et l'édition vidéo, que ce soit par des projets académiques, un portfolio personnel ou un travail professionnel. La familiarité avec des outils comme Adobe Creative Suite (Premier Pro, After Effects) ou des plateformes similaires est un avantage. - Connaissance de la marque: Comprenez comment un langage visuel cohérent renforce un message et vous aimez travailler dans les lignes directrices de la marque pour assurer la qualité. - Curious et Autodrived: Prenez l'initiative, vous aimez expérimenter de nouveaux formats de contenu et prospérer dans un environnement qui encourage la croissance continue. - Communiqué de presse: Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais et vous sentez à l'aise de travailler avec différentes équipes internationales dans différents fuseaux horaires. - Contexte éducatif: Vous êtes étudiant ou diplômé en communication, marketing, médias ou un domaine de création connexe. Veuillez noter que la date du diplôme ne doit pas dépasser 12 mois à compter de la date de début. Processus de demande Télécharger un CV mis à jour et une lettre de motivation, en indiquant la date préférée pour le début du stage. Informations complémentaires Veuillez noter que, en raison de la réglementation, les citoyens non européens/EEE doivent fournir un certificat de l'université qui certifie qu'un stage est obligatoire dans le cadre des documents de candidature et doit être constamment inscrit à l'université pour la durée de ce stage. Si vous êtes heureux de contribuer et de vous sentir dévoué au travail d'équipe et à l'innovation que nous recherchons, Roche est l'organisation pour vous. Chaque rôle de Roche joue un rôle dans la vie des patients. Si vous voulez travailler dans une équipe passionnée, laissez votre marque et améliorez vos vies, appliquez maintenant! Qui sommes-nous ? Un avenir plus sain nous conduit à l'innovation. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés du monde entier se consacrent à faire progresser la science, en veillant à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations futures. Nos efforts mènent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests effectués avec nos produits de diagnostic.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:

• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.

• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.

• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.

• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.

• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.

• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.

• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.

• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.

Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens: 10.06.2026
(Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist)

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugniss

jobs.title: P&C Enabling Support Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
People & Culture Enabling Support Specialist

The Opportunity

The P&C Enabling Support Network (ESN) is a global network of P&C professionals supporting the People & Culture organization through operational excellence, collaboration, coordination, and organizational enablement activities. As a member of the Enabling Support Network, you will contribute to and benefit from a broader ecosystem of enabling support functions across the P&C organisation in Roche, strengthening organizational capabilities and cross-functional alignment at scale.The P&C Enabling Support Specialist acts as a key connector across local and global P&C teams, Organizational Enablement teams, business stakeholders, and chapter organizations. The role supports alignment across the matrix organization by enabling collaboration, supporting follow-ups, coordinating actions, and helping ensure smooth communication and execution across teams.
The role also supports the operational effectiveness of the RSS P&C Leadership Team through coordination, communication, follow-up, and organizational enablement activities across cross-location initiatives and stakeholder groups.
This position is ideal for a proactive, organized, and collaborative professional who enjoys working in a dynamic global environment, connecting stakeholders, and enabling teams to operate effectively together.

• Act as the central coordination point between RSS P&C teams, global P&C stakeholders, Organizational Enablement teams, and business partners, serving as the primary contact point for cross-functional alignment and information flow

• Orchestrate and facilitate all collaborative forums and events including coordination of meetings, workshops, governance forums, and cross-functional discussions with full lifecycle support (agenda preparation, documentation, action tracking, and follow-up)

• Drive alignment and follow-through across RSS P&C leadership and cross-location initiatives by facilitating communication, collaboration, and coordination to ensure organizational and P&C priorities are understood and executed consistently

• Maintain comprehensive visibility and tracking of priorities, timelines, deliverables, and agreed next steps, proactively identifying and escalating dependencies, potential blockers, and risks to relevant stakeholders

• Identify and support operational improvements and continuous enhancement by partnering with P&C teams to surface alignment opportunities, streamline processes, and support transformation activities across local and global stakeholders

• Prepare and consolidate all supporting materials and insights including presentations, dashboards, reports, and stakeholder updates that enable informed leadership discussions and support organizational initiatives

• Execute administrative and coordination activities with excellence in a fast-paced global matrix environment, ensuring all work adheres to company guidelines, SOPs, and compliance expectations

Who You Are

• Formal education and relevant professional background: University degree or commercial diploma (or equivalent work experience) with demonstrated experience in People & Culture, business support, professional assistance, event management, dynamic project coordination, or organizational enablement

• Foundation for success in matrix and global environments: Proven ability to navigate complex matrix organizations, connect stakeholders across different reporting lines and geographies, and work effectively in global and/or cross-fun

jobs.title: Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

titleByLocale.fr: Architecte de données/d'information - Plateformes de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are seeking a visionary Data/Information Architect within the RDT Data Platforms function to lead the strategic design and implementation of our AI-driven Master Data Management (MDM) solutions. In this role, you will be the core architect enabling artificial intelligence across our MDM ecosystem, transforming legacy relational master records into intelligent, context-aware, and AI-ready data assets.

The first key priority of this architectural roadmap will focus on the modernization of Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Healthcare Organisation (HCO) master data programs , with a broader scaling strategy across alternative master data domains in future waves. A defining focus of your architectural design will be bridging the gap between traditional MDM platforms and advanced enterprise semantic layers, seamlessly transitioning master datasets into unified knowledge graphs that fuel cutting-edge Generative AI applications.

The Data Management and Data Quality Platforms area serves as the foundational intelligence engine of our global digital enterprise. Our mission is to scale a harmonized, FAIR-compliant master data framework that integrates heavily with an automated, AI-enabled Semantic Layer . By injecting contextual meaning, ontology standards, and relationship graphs into raw master data, we provide the enterprise with a single, high-trust, and discoverable view of our network. Joining this area means taking a leading role in ensuring that healthcare-specific data models remain contextually accurate, highly secure, compliant with global regulatory standards, and completely optimized for state-of-the-art machine learning deployment.

The opportunity:

• AI-Enabled MDM Architecture: Architect, design, and lead the technical execution of modernizing enterprise Master Data Management systems by integrating AI/ML capabilities for data matching, entity resolution, and data enrichment.

• HCP & HCO Program Leadership: Act as the primary technical architect for the foundational Healthcare Professional (HCP), Healthcare Organisation (HCO), and Business Partner/Vendor master data initiatives, ensuring high-fidelity modeling and scalability for subsequent domains.

• Semantic Layer Integration: Define the blueprints and mapping rules required to connect transactional master data with unified semantic layers, ontologies, and enterprise knowledge graphs.

• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Ensure that master data models are fully machine-readable and explicitly struct

Mansioni Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme di dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come squadra globale al centro di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi imprenditoriali impegnati a plasmare il futuro digitale della sanità. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso le tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidati dalla scopo e dalla passione, stanno preparando un futuro in cui il digitale è un punto di forza capace di crescere in tutta Roche, volendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, radicando il potenziale umano e guidando i progressi che contano veramente per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offrendo un modello di lavoro ibrido che abbina flessibilità con la collaborazione in presenza. Per ora, richiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici in ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni di squadra e altri eventi collaborativi.
• Stiamo cercando un architetto di dati/informazione visionario all'interno della funzione RDT Data Platforms per guidare la progettazione e l'implementazione strategica delle nostre soluzioni di gestione dei dati master (MDM) guidate dall'AI. In questo ruolo, sarai l'architetto centrale che abilita l'intelligenza artificiale nell'ecosistema MDM, progetta i registri master relazionali legacy in asset dati intelligenti, contestualmenteassunzione e pronta per l'AI. La prima priorità chiave di questa roadmap architettonica si concentrerà sulla modernizzazione dei programmi di gestione dei dati dei professionisti sanitari (HCP) e delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO), con una strategia di scalabilità più ampia per i domini dei dati master alternativi nelle future ondate. Un focus definito della tua progettazione architettonica sarà colmare il potenziale tra le piattaforme MDM e gli strati semantici aziendali avanzati, passando senza soluzione di continuità i dataset master in grafica della conoscenza unificati che alimentano le applicazioni di generazione dell'AI all'avanguardia. L'area di gestione dei dati e delle piattaforme di qualità dei dati servono come motore di intelligenza fondazionale della nostra impresa digitale globale. La nostra missione è scalare un framework di dati master armonizzato, conformi alle specifiche FAIR, che si integra pesantemente con uno strato semantico automatizzato, AI-abilitato. Inserendo il significato contestuale, gli standard ontologici e i grafici delle relazioni nei dati master grezzi, per all'impresa una visuale unica, ad alta fiducia e scopribile della nostra rete. Unendoti a questa area, assumonorai un ruolo di primo piano nell'assicurarti che i modelli dei dati specifici del settore sanitario paganono accurati contestualmente, altamente sicuri, conformi agli standardtivi globali e completamente ottimizzati per il deployment del machine learning all'avanguardia. Opportunità - Architettura MDM abilitata all'AI: Architettare, progettare e guidare l'esecuzione tecnica della modernizzazione dei dati master dell'impresa integrando le capacità AI/ML per la corrispondenza dei dati, la risoluzione delle elezioni e l'arricchimento dei dati. - Leadership del programma HCP & HCO: Fare da architetto principale tecnico per le iniziative di gestione dei dati dei professionisti sanitari (HCP), delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO) e dei partner commerciali/venditori, assicurando la modellazione ad alta fedeltà e la scalabilità per i domini successivi. - Integrazione dello strato semantico: Definire i progetti e le regole di mappatura obbligatoria per connettere i dati master transazionali con gli strati semantici un, le onlogie e i grafici della conoscenza aziendale. - Ingegneria dei dati pronta per l'AI: Assicurarsi che i modelli dei dati master siano completamente leggibili dalle macchine e strutturati esplicitamente.

La nostra missione è potenzaire Roche attraverso le tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell'intelligenza artificielle, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidati dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è un punto di forza croisale in tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, sbloccando il potenziale umano e guidando i rusting che contano veramente per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modelo di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaboration in presenza. Par ora, ritiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici dans les médias dus giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici in ufficiopossono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, ven workshop, conferenze, riunioni di scoulara e altri eventi collatorivi.
• Stiamo cercando un architetto di dati/informazione visionario all'interno della funzione RDT Data Platforms per guidare la progettazione e l'implémentation strategica delle nostre soluzioni di gestione dei dati master (MDM) guidate dall'AI. Dans questo ruolo, sarai l'architetto centrale che abilita l'intelligence artificielle nell'ecosistema MDM, trasformando i registri master relazioni legacy in asset dati intelligenti, contestualmente consapevoli e pronti per l'AI. La prima priorità chiave di questa feuille de route architettonica si concentrarà sulla modernizzazione dei programmi di gestione dei dati dei professionisti sanitari (HCP) e delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO), con una strategia di scalabilità più ampia per i domini dei dati master alternativi nelle future ondate. Un focus definito della tua progettazione architettonica sarà colmare il divario tra le piattaforme MDM tradizioni e gli strati semantici aziendali avanzati, passando senza soluzione di continuuità i dataset master in grafici della conoscenza unificati che alimentano le applicazioni di generazione dell'AI all'avanguardia. L'area di gestione dei dati e delle piattaforme di qualità dei dati serve come motrice di intelligenza fondazione della nostra impresa digitale globale. La nostra missione è scalare un framework di dati master armonizzato, conforme alle specifiche FAIR, che si integra pesantemente con uno strato semantico automatizzato, AI-abilitato. Inserendo il significato contestuale, gli standard onologici e i grafici delle relazioni nei dati master grezzi, forniamo all'impresa una visuale unica, ad alta fiducia e scopribile della nostra rete. Unendoti a questa a area, assumerai un ruolo di primo piano nell'assicurarti che i modelli dei dati specifici del settore sanitario rimangano accrati contestualmente, altamente sicuri, conformi agli standard normativi globali e completamente ottimizzati per il déploiement del machine learning all'avanguardia. Annexe - Architettura MDM abilitata all'AI: Architettare, progettare e guidare l'escuzione tecnica della modernizzazione dei sistemi di gestione dei dati master dell'impresa integrando le capacità AI/ML per la corrispondenza dei dati, la risoluzione delle entità e l'arricchimento dei dati. - Leadership del programma HCP & HCO: Fare da architetto tecnico principale per le iniziative di gestione dei dati dei professionisti sanitari (HCP), delle organizazioni sanitarie (HCO) e dei partner commerciali/venditori, assicurando la modellazione ad alta fedeltà e la scalabilità per i domini successivi. - Integrazione dello strato semantico: Definire i progetti e le regole di mappatura richiesti per connettere i dati master transazionali con gli strati semantici unificati, le ontologie e i grafici della conoscenza aziendali. - Ingegneria dei dati pronta per l'AI: Assicurarsi che i modelli dei dati master siano completamente leggibili dalle macchine e strutturati esplicitamente.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We believe that meaningful impact starts with how we connect—with patients, healthcare professionals, and each other. If you are passionate about building strong customer relationships and driving business growth in the healthcare space, this opportunity could be for you.

The Opportunity
As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for managing sales performance, developing strategic customer relationships, and promoting Roche Diagnostics’ product portfolio within your assigned territory. You will play a key role in driving sustainable business growth while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and alignment with Roche’s global standards.

In this role, you will:

• Achieve or exceed assigned sales targets through effective territory and account planning

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers to establish long-term partnerships

• Identify and develop new business opportunities across Roche Diagnostics products and services

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to execute commercial activities effectively

• Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and provide insights to support business strategy. Deliver timely and accurate reporting

• Ensure proper management of operational processes including contract documentation and supply coordination

• Contribute to a collaborative team environment with a strong focus on customer satisfaction

Who you are
You are driven, resilient, and able to navigate a dynamic, customer-facing environment. You take ownership of your territory, are proactive in identifying opportunities, and are committed to delivering results.

You bring:

• Bachelor’s degree in any field; Life Sciences background is an advantage, with a minimum of 3 years of sales experience in Diagnostics, Medical Devices, or Pharmaceutical industry

• Understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, including hospital or institutional structures

• Ability to work independently and deliver results with minimal supervision

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders effectively

• Proficiency in English (written and spoken) and basic digital literacy

• Demonstrated learning agility and willingness to adapt to new products and business areas

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Accounting Tax Integration
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Global Business Process Specialist (GBPS) – Accounting Tax Integration, you are part of the Global Business Process Management Organization in Roche Service & Solutions. In this position, you report into the Accounting Tax Integration Sub-Chapter Lead within the Finance BPM.

You act as Business Process Specialist for the APAC Regional Deployment team in the Finance/ Tax area. You roll-out the Aspire Global Template to the APAC countries, in particular for Chugai company codes in the area of Taxes, including Tax Localization.

You will work in close collaboration with stakeholders from Finance, Commercials, Demand-to-Pay, Supply Chain and IT, cross divisionally (Pharma and Diagnostics).

You will be :

• Responsible for global, cross divisional state-of-the-art process design within their business process area within the E2E proces. Empowered decision making for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Manager (GBPM)

• Work closely with the E2E GBPMs & GBPS network to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions. Supports the SAP S4/HANA Template deployment. Actively pursue the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, according to guardrails set by the E2E GBPO and GBPMs

• Deliver solutions including processes, ICFR, Authorizations, laws and regulations, technology, analytics for own dedicated area, in line with the E2E BPM strategy & guardrails as well as continuous improvements, with support of the GBPM and GBPSs. Support business acceptance globally across divisions and functions on a operating level for the dedicated business process area. Drive and implement the BPM strategy for your own dedicated area

• Roll-out Global template solutions for the area of Finance/ Tax, including solution documentation & implementation, test management, business process operations including integrated training management. Evaluate Local GAP and design localization extensions for the Global Template as part of the deployment activities for the Aspire roll out.

• Safeguard the global template and harmonized processes while collaborating with different project streams and other BPM networks to develop new processes for future releases. You translate local Tax business requirements into IT solutions and manage changes to such specifications. Actively drive and support the project deployment relevant deliverables throughout the full rollout lifecycle.

• Ensuring that all parallel deployments as well as the S/4Hana work package are on track Ensuring, monitoring and optimization of business processes with regards to efficiency and effectiveness. The position may involve a fair amount of travel (up to max. 25%). You liaise with the other stakeholder within the E2E processes. You lead process alignments/solution design with business stakeholders under template governance

Who you are:

• A business or finance degree with 4-5 years of relevant work experience. An SAP FI specialist with solid experience in business process management, SAP ERP, S/4Hana, IT, and ERP transformation programs.

• Extensive experience with SAP Tax solutions, covering Indirect Taxes, Withholding Taxes, and Corporate Income Taxes. Deep knowledge of SAP S/4Hana tax solutions, including SAP country versions, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, and implementation of SAP systems, particularly S4 Finance.

• Experience with other SAP Tax solutions like Sovos add-on for tax code determination is advantageous.

• Excellent analytica

jobs.title: China Biomarker Studies Asset Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
YOUR TEAM
You will report to the HGR Officer and partner closely with the global biosample operations teams across the enterprise. You will be recognized as a leader and work autonomously in both local as well as global cross functional study teams.
ROLE PURPOSE
As a China Biosample Operations Asset Lead, you will provide biosample operational expertise to one or more cross-functional local or global study teams through all phases and stages in accordance with the appropriate quality standards and applicable local regulations.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• PROVIDE BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS GUIDANCE TO CLINICAL CHINA STUDY TEAMS AND GLOBAL STUDY TEAMS FOR CHINA RELATED ACTIVITIES by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of study samples (collection, processing, analysis, data delivery and final disposition).

• LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CHINA SPECIFIC BIOMARKER MANAGEMENT PLAN WITHIN CLINICAL STUDIES based on input from scientific and operational stakeholders to execute biosample operational strategies in China

• PROVIDE INPUT TO HGRAC APPLICATION to support Country Study Managers - when applicable - and within Biosample Operations’ remit.

• PARTNER CLOSELY WITH BIOMARKER SCIENTISTS AND BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS PROGRAM LEADS LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY to align study specific activities with program sample collection strategies. Evaluate the operational feasibility of specific testing in China and provide input to global program teams.

• PROVIDE OPERATIONAL INPUT AND RECOMMENDATIONS INTO STUDY RELATED DOCUMENTATION AND PROCESSES (e.g. protocol, ICF, HGRAC applications)

• PRESENT CHINA STUDY SAMPLE COLLECTION STRATEGY AT OPERATIONS TEAM MEETINGS AND CHINA INVESTIGATOR MEETINGS

• CONTRIBUTE TO LOCAL LAB/ REGIONAL VENDOR SELECTION FOR SPECIFIC TESTING in collaboration with Biosample Ops Lead, biomarker scientist, Procurement and based on technology expertise, performance and compliance.

• ESTABLISH BIOSAMPLE ANALYSIS AND DATA DELIVERY MILESTONES AND ENSURE ACCURATE TRACKING AND REPORTING OF BIOSAMPLE METRICS (sample collection, assay status, analyses updates). Provide study level updates to the study and global biomarker teams. Support study teams in addressing local vendor/site sample queries. Actively partner with Data Management to oversee and coordinate data format, and delivery timelines.

• PROVIDE DAY TO DAY OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF CHINA BIOSAMPLE VENDORS. Partner with internal/external stakeholders in the central lab set up, providing sample collection and processing instructions. Review central lab documents to ensure alignment with protocol and HGRAC submissions. Perform ongoing biomarker vendor management including development and oversight of scope of work, budget and performance management. Interact with vendors to help evaluate data size for compliance, plan sample shipments, export, storage, define data retention, ensure samples are analysed and data are transferred.

• IDENTIFY AREAS OF BEST PRACTICE AND PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS. Contribute to the development of internal guidelines within Biosample Operations’ remit, based on HGRAC process and local regulations as well as program needs. Partner with relevant stakeholders, both locally and globally, to optimize processes for sample management in China.

• DEMONSTRATE AGILITY AND ABILITY TO PERFORM IN A HIGHLY FAST-PACED, MATRIX ENVIRONMENT WHERE CROSS-TEAM COLLABORATION IS CRUCIAL. Leverage excellent verbal and written communication skills to motivate teams, neg
