jobs.title: Disease Area Lead (Oncology / Lung)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Disease Area Lead (Oncology / Lung) is an empowered leader responsible for the respective DA business in Roche Turkiye, leveraging the global Roche network as an active catalyst. In this role, you will report to the Leadership Team Member responsible for all disease areas and develop a clear business strategy for identifying, leveraging, scaling, adapting, and executing the business by providing launch and commercial excellence for the DA portfolio. DA experience is required for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Establish strategic direction and lead the execution of the Strategy

• Responsible for setting the DA vision, high ambitions, and outcomes for the squad by harnessing insights from Primary Point of Contacts (PPOCs) and other key stakeholders across the enterprise. Holding overall accountability for delivering market leadership and the P&L, whilst working in the context of shared responsibility.

• Responsible for developing effective strategies to manage the lifecycle and the financial and resource planning for the products.

• Promote innovation and the development of projects and pull in resources from the broader Roche network to deliver value-added solutions.

• Maximize opportunities and synergize across other disease areas and establish a strong collaboration within the affiliate and cross-affiliates within Pharma International.

• Closely collaborate with stakeholders and customer-facing teams to translate disease area needs into clear execution.

• Ensure Cross-Functional Leadership by inspiring teams to meet ambitious outcomes, fostering an environment where cross-functional teams can collaborate, develop, and achieve outcomes

• Manage DA Members by embracing the role of recruiter, coach, and retainer of talent & performance, sharing the responsibility with leaders in other disciplines.

• Ensure the right resource prioritization, with an enterprise mindset, taking into account the affiliate strategy and portfolio priorities. Within this context, effectively prioritize DA outcomes and ensure resource requirements are met to deliver outcomes

• In collaboration with the PPOCs, ensure that key stakeholders are well-supported and view us as their preferred partner. Mobilize the network with speed when necessary to meet the urgent needs of these key stakeholders.

People Leadership & Mindset

• Provide Inspirational leadership by uniting people around a shared vision and a common purpose, inspiring them to achieve squad-aligned outcomes. Ensure individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with the needs of the organization

• Build High-Performing Teams that deliver business outcomes by promoting a collaborative, innovative & creative environment

• Stay at the leading edge of learning & adapting according to external insights (strategy, outcomes & execution) for impact

• Ensure clarification of outcomes for the team so everyone is aligned on their role in delivering ambitious outcomes, and play an active role in execution as required.

• Act as a People Manager of Patient Journey Partners (PJP), and you are a thought partner for all DA members and others in the DA to bring perspective as a matrix lead. The role embraces the performance dynamics of all members.

• Have a very strong Entrepreneurial Mindset (We before Me) with outstanding partnering & leadership capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question, and understand).

• A catalyst and mobilize appropriate resources around common goals/outcomes to genera

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mit der Zukunft im Blick gestalten wir den Standort von Roche in Rotkreuz aktiv weiter. Einen wichtigen Beitrag hierzu leistet die Abteilung Engineering & Project: Hier liegt die Verantwortung für die strategische Weiterentwicklung des Standortes und sämtliche Investitionen in Gebäude und Anlagen. Dazu gehören Bauprojekte im Bereich Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur. Dabei legen wir besonderen Wert auf Nachhaltigkeit, Sicherheit, Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit und Wirtschaftlichkeit.

In dieser anspruchsvollen Schlüsselfunktion bist du die zentrale Instanz für die operative Exzellenz und die baurechtliche Strategie auf dem Areal Rotkreuz. Du vereinst tiefgreifendes technisches Verständnis mit strategischem Prozessmanagement und repräsentierst das Unternehmen gegenüber Behörden und Partnern.

Die Möglichkeit
Strategisches Construction Management

• Standardisierung: Definition und Überwachung globaler Standards für die Auswahl, das Onboarding und die Steuerung von CM-Partnern, Generalplanern und Unternehmern.

• Schnittstellenmanagement: Agieren als entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Vendor Management und Projektleitung zur Sicherstellung prozesskonformer Projektabläufe.

• Beratung: Fachspezifischer Input bei komplexen Ausschreibungen und strategische Beratung der Projektleiter in allen Belangen des Construction Managements.

Bebauungsplanung & Bewilligungsmanagement

• Arealstrategie: Verantwortung für die Einhaltung und strategische Weiterentwicklung bestehender Bebauungspläne in enger Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.

• Process Ownership: Zentrale Steuerung sämtlicher Baubewilligungsprozesse sowie Definition standortweiter Bewilligungsstrategien für alle Investitionsprojekte.

• Behördenmanagement: Repräsentation der Unternehmensinteressen in städtebaulichen Gremien und erste Ansprechperson für Ämter und Behörden im Bereich Baurecht.

Areal-Koordination & Safety (SHE)

• Sicherheitsstrategie: Implementierung von SHE-Standards (Safety, Health, Environment) und Befähigung der Projektteams zur sicheren Durchführung komplexer Bauvorhaben.

• Logistiksteuerung: Strategische Koordination der zeitlichen und logistischen Abfolgen aller Baustellen, um einen unterbrechungsfreien Betrieb der Kernprozesse am Standort zu garantieren.

Capex-Projekt Manager

• Projektsteuerung (End-to-End): Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Erreichung der Projektziele (Termine, Kosten, Qualität, Sicherheit) von der Initiierung bis zum Projektabschluss.

• Anforderungs- & Scope-Management: Gemeinsame Definition der Projektanforderungen mit den internen Nutzern, Aufzeigen von Lösungsalternativen sowie konsequentes Risiko- und Change-Management.

• Teamführung & Stakeholder Management: Fachliche Anleitung des (agilen) Projektteams sowie zielgerichtete Kommunikation und Interessenvertretung gegenüber internen Schnittstellen und externen Partnern.

• Governance & Reporting: Strukturierte Fortschrittsverfolgung, regelmässiges Berichten an das Steering Committee und proaktives Herbeiführen von notwendigen Entscheidungen.

Wer Du bist

• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Architektur, des Bauingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Expertise (z. B. MAS Baumanagement, eidg. Diplom als Bauleiter/Techniker HF) mit langjähriger Praxis.

• Fundierte Erfolgsbilanz in der Bau- oder Projektleitung von Hochbauprojekten innerhalb der Schweizer Baubranche.

• Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Teams innerhalb komplexer Matrixorganisationen.

• Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken, Verhandlungsgeschi

jobs.title: Facharbeiter Ansatz/Abfüllung
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Pharmafacharbeiter Ansatz / Abfüllung (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine, der Gefriertrocknungsanlage und den optischen Kontrollmaschinen verantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten
In dieser Rolle bist Du für die sichere Durchführung von Standardaufgaben und komplexen Prozessen in der Wirkstoffverarbeitung verantwortlich:

• Du gewährleistest den reibungslosen Ablauf der Abfüllung von sterilen Lösungen in Vials unter Berücksichtigung aseptischer Arbeitsweise nach Herstellanweisung und Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen an der Abfüll- und Gefriertrocknungsanlage

• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.

• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du Geräte und Kleinteile

• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)

• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe

• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln.

Das bringst du mit

jobs.title: 实习医药信息顾问
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1 ）在校大学生
• （ 2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件
• （ 5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力
• tag#LI-DNI

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• We are looking for a Product Manager at Roche Diagnostics Central Asia and Caucasian countries.
• Location: Kazakhstan, Almaty

• What will you do?
• · You will join the healthcare innovation team.
• · You will be responsible for growing the portfolio; delivering on the marketing plan and working cross functionally with related colleagues.
• · You will prepare short term (annual) and medium term business/marketing plans for the products.
• · You will be expected to maintain and communicate a high level of market and product knowledge.
• · You will organize training programs for commercial team about products, product marketing strategies and competition.
• · You will organize product related marketing events (congresses, conferences, etc.) in cooperation with related parties

• Who are you?
• · Bachelor's Degree in medicine, biology, chemistry
• · Preferably 1-2 years’ experience of product management in the diagnostic, pharmaceutical or related industry
• · Budget management and product launch experience preferred
• · Strong communication, analytical and presentation skills
• · At least upper-intermediate level of English and fluent Russian
• · Having driving license and willing to travel as required to support business needs, attend events, and engage with stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Internship - Account Payable
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As an Intern – Accounts Payable supporting the China region , you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of our financial operations. You will ensure our accounting processes deliver exceptional impact through meticulous document handling, timely invoice processing, and effective communication in Mandarin — helping our global business units maintain the financial health required to deliver care to patients.

The Opportunity

• You manage the full cycle of AP documentation , from receiving and sorting to barcoding and pre-archiving, ensuring all records are ready for further processing.

• You validate and process PO and contract-based invoices, Non-PO invoices, and prepayments with high attention to detail.

• You support financial accuracy by reviewing supplier open items, investigating non-successful payments, and performing balance sheet account reconciliations.

• You contribute to month-end excellence by participating in closing activities and preparing operational KPI reports based on affiliate requirements.

• You act as a bridge for our China stakeholders , handling internal and external queries in Mandarin and building effective partnerships with vendors.

• You engage in continuous improvement by supporting system integration testing, participating in team projects, and initiating process enhancements.

Who You Are

• You are currently pursuing or hold a Degree or Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• You are fluent in Mandarin (Mandatory) , as this role specifically supports our affiliates and vendors in China ; you are also proficient in English.

• You have a strong interest in corporate finance and accounting , with a desire to learn best practices in a global shared services environment.

• You have a working knowledge of MS Office tools ; familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems is a significant advantage.

• You are a proactive communicator who enjoys resolving queries and working collaboratively within a "Buddy System" framework.

• You are available for a minimum internship duration of six (6) months .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di software medico - Manipolazione di reclami
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur en logiciel médical - Traitement des plaintes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective. Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues , growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

Main tasks:

• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• Independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.

• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

Requirements:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired

• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sant Cugat del Vallès. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti, e siamo coraggiosi sia nella decisione che nell’azione - crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Ecco perché andiamo al lavoro ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo al rigore scientifico, all'etica insopportabile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità . Con oltre 100 iniziative di tecnologia digitale e dati già in corso, Roche sta lavorando con aziende innovative nei campi dei dati, analisi e software per trasformare la fornitura di assistenza sanitaria attraverso soluzioni digitali. Inoltre, Roche è uno dei più alti spender per la ricerca e lo sviluppo (R&D) tra i farmaci globali, spendendo più del 20% di ricavi. Questo sostanziale investimento ha portato a prodotti che hanno avanzato la comprensione della malattia e trasformato la pratica della medicina. In qualità di Ingegnere del Software nella Qualità del Mercato Postale (PMQ), sarete in prima linea nel garantire la qualità e le prestazioni delle Soluzioni Digitali di Roche, la gestione delle lamentele relative ai Sistemi Informativi Ospedalieri/Laboratori (HIS/LIS), reti di dati medici, soluzioni middleware, comunicazione dei dati, app e algoritmi. Unire il Capitolo Soluzioni Digitali significa lavorare in un ambiente software altamente trasversale, dandovi l'opportunità di impegnarsi con tecnologie all'avanguardia e linguaggi di programmazione diversi per il software on-premise e cloud-based. La vostra missione principale sarà quella di agire come un investigatore approfondito: Analizzerai casi, file di registro e codice sorgente per determinare la causa principale o il fattore causale di un malfunzionamento/problema del software. Mentre la vostra attenzione è sull'analisi della causa principale, non sarete responsabili per le correzioni di bug finali. Questo ruolo è ambientato in un ambiente Agile dove le tue idee e le tue proposte innovative sono altamente apprezzate, contribuendo direttamente a un team focalizzato sul miglioramento continuo.
• Mansioni principali - Sei responsabile per la gestione di reclami complessi del software medico, problemi di sicurezza e richieste di prodotti software (su premessa, cloud, mobile, applicazioni,...). - Potrai gestire l'intero ciclo di vita dei casi, dalla creazione iniziale e classificazione all'indagine approfondita, collaborazione con il team di risoluzione dei problemi in loco, documentazione e risoluzione finale. Per i casi che non possono essere risolti direttamente, si prende la proprietà di aumentare al reparto sviluppo. - Lei agisce come esperto tecnico per la risoluzione dei casi, utilizzando la capacità di leggere e comprendere il codice sorgente per identificare la causa principale/fattore causale dei malfunzionamenti software. Si consulterà con esperti tecnici senior sugli aspetti tecnici e relativi al processo, se necessario. - Lei è l'interfaccia critica con affiliati e organizzazioni di paese. Sarete responsabili della comunicazione tempestiva delle informazioni essenziali e delle iniziative di supporto alla qualità che migliorano i nostri partenariati regionali. - Si utilizzano le competenze di automazione e analisi dei dati per migliorare il processo di gestione dei casi e monitorare proattivamente i dati sulle prestazioni dei prodotti
• Requisiti - Una laurea in informatica o un campo relativo all'IT. - Forti competenze IT, in particolare la capacità di leggere e debug codice sorgente di diversi linguaggi di programmazione per comprendere la causa principale dei problemi segnalati - Le forti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) sono essenziali - L'esperienza di lavoro nell'area dell'ingegneria del software o delle funzioni relative al supporto IT è desiderata - Automazione

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms. Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software. Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective. Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues , growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement. Main tasks:
• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).
• Independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.
• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.
• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues
• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data Requirements:
• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.
• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired
• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly
• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)
• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche sind wir leidenschaftlich daran, das Leben der Patienten zu transformieren, und wir sind mutig in Entscheidung und Tat - wir glauben, dass gutes Geschäft eine bessere Welt bedeutet. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Strenge, unerklärlicher Ethik und Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun das heute, um morgen besser zu werden. Unser Erfolg basiert auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Mit mehr als 100 digitalen Technologie- und Dateninitiativen arbeitet Roche mit innovativen Unternehmen in den Daten-, Analyse- und Softwarebereichen zusammen, um die Gesundheitsversorgung durch digitale Lösungen zu transformieren. Darüber hinaus ist Roche einer der höchsten Ausgaben für Forschung und Entwicklung (FuE) unter globalen Arzneimitteln, die mehr als 20 % des Umsatzes ausmachen. Diese beträchtliche Investition hat zu Produkten geführt, die das Verständnis der Krankheit vorangebracht haben und die Praxis der Medizin transformiert haben. Als Software-Ingenieur in Post Market Quality (PMQ) sind Sie an der Spitze der Sicherstellung der Qualität und Leistung von Roche’s Digital Solutions, Behandlung von Beschwerden im Zusammenhang mit Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medizinische Datennetze, Middleware-Lösungen, Datenkommunikation, Apps und Algorithmen. Mit dem Digital Solutions Chapter arbeiten Sie in einem hochtransversalen Software-Umfeld und bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, sich mit modernsten Technologien und verschiedenen Programmiersprachen sowohl für On-Premise als auch für Cloud-basierte Software zu engagieren. Ihre Kernaufgabe wird es sein, als tiefgreifender Ermittler zu fungieren: Sie analysieren Fälle, Log-Dateien und Quellcode, um die Ursache oder den Kausalfaktor einer Software-Fehler/Problem zu bestimmen. Während Ihr Fokus auf der Wurzelursanalyse liegt, werden Sie nicht für die letzten Fehlerbehebungen verantwortlich sein. Diese Rolle ist in einer Agile-Umgebung festgelegt, in der Ihre innovativen Ideen und Vorschläge hoch geschätzt werden und direkt zu einem Team beitragen, das sich auf eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung konzentriert.
• Mansioni principali - Sie sind verantwortlich für die Behandlung von komplexen medizinischen Softwarebeschwerden, Sicherheitsfragen und Produktanfragen für Softwareprodukte (auf Prämisse, Cloud, Mobile, Apps,...). - Sie verwalten den gesamten Fall-Lebenszyklus, von der ersten Erstellung und Klassifizierung bis zur eingehenden Untersuchung, Zusammenarbeit mit dem fehlerbefreienden Team vor Ort, Dokumentation und abschließende Auflösung. Für Fälle, die nicht direkt gelöst werden können, nehmen Sie das Eigentum an der Eskalation an der Entwicklungsabteilung. - Sie fungieren als technischer Experte für Fallauflösung, indem Sie Ihre Fähigkeit verwenden, Quellcode zu lesen und zu verstehen, um die Ursache/Kausalfaktor von Softwarestörungen zu identifizieren. Sie werden bei Bedarf mit hochrangigen technischen Experten zu technischen und verfahrensbezogenen Aspekten beraten. - Sie sind die kritische Schnittstelle zu Affiliates und Country Organizations. Sie werden für die rechtzeitige Kommunikation wesentlicher qualitätsbezogener Informationen und unterstützende Initiativen verantwortlich sein, die unsere regionalen Partnerschaften verbessern. - Sie nutzen Ihre Automatisierungs- und Datenanalysefähigkeiten, um den Fallbearbeitungsprozess zu verbessern und Produktleistungsdaten proaktiv zu überwachen Voraussetzungen - Ein Abschluss in Informatik oder ein IT-bezogenes Feld. - Starke IT-Fähigkeiten, insbesondere die Fähigkeit, Quellcode verschiedener Programmiersprachen zu lesen und zu debuggen, um die Hauptursache gemeldeter Probleme zu verstehen - Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen) sind essentiell - Arbeitserfahrung im Bereich Softwaretechnik oder IT-Unterstützung sind erwünscht - Automatisierung

Cet investissement important a permis d'obtenir des produits qui ont permis de mieux comprendre la maladie et transformé la pratique de la médecine. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel en qualité post-commercialisation (PMQ), vous serez à l'avant-garde de la qualité et des performances des solutions numériques de Roches, du traitement des plaintes liées aux systèmes d'information hospitaliers/laboratoires (HIS/LIS), aux réseaux de données médicales, aux solutions intermédiaires, à la communication de données, aux applications et aux algorithmes. Rejoindre le chapitre Solutions numériques signifie travailler dans un environnement logiciel hautement transversal, vous donnant la possibilité de vous engager avec des technologies de pointe et divers langages de programmation pour les logiciels sur site et cloud.
• Votre mission principale sera d'agir en tant qu'enquêteur en profondeur : Vous analyserez les cas, les fichiers log et le code source pour déterminer la cause fondamentale ou le facteur causal d'un dysfonctionnement ou problème logiciel. Bien que votre attention soit sur l'analyse de la cause racine, vous ne serez pas responsable de la correction finale du bug. Ce rôle est établi dans un environnement agile où vos idées et propositions innovantes sont très appréciées, contribuant directement à une équipe axée sur l'amélioration continue. Autres - Vous êtes responsable du traitement des plaintes complexes concernant les logiciels médicaux, des problèmes de sécurité et des demandes de renseignements sur les produits logiciels (sur place, cloud, mobile, applications,...). - Vous gérerez tout le cycle de vie de l'affaire, de la création et de la classification initiales à l'enquête approfondie, la collaboration avec l'équipe de dépannage sur place, la documentation et la résolution finale. Pour les cas qui ne peuvent être résolus directement, vous prenez en main l'escalade vers le département du développement. - Vous agissez comme un expert technique pour la résolution de cas, en utilisant votre capacité à lire et comprendre le code source pour identifier la cause racine / facteur causal de dysfonctionnements logiciels. Vous consulterez des experts techniques de haut niveau sur les aspects techniques et liés aux processus au besoin. - Vous êtes l'interface critique avec les affiliés et les organisations de pays. Vous serez responsable de la communication en temps opportun de l'information essentielle liée à la qualité et des initiatives de soutien qui améliorent nos partenariats régionaux. - Vous utilisez vos compétences d'automatisation et d'analyse de données pour améliorer le processus de traitement des cas et surveiller de manière proactive les données de performance des produits
• Requisiti - Diplôme en informatique ou en informatique. - Fortes compétences en TI, en particulier la capacité de lire et de déboguer le code source des différents langages de programmation pour comprendre la cause profonde des problèmes signalés - De solides compétences en communication en anglais (écrit et parlé) sont essentielles - Une expérience de travail dans le domaine de l'ingénierie logicielle ou des fonctions de support informatique est souhaitée - Automatisation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Basel arbeiten 650 Mitarbeiter im Bereich Drug Substance Manufacturing und produzieren Large und Small Molecule APIs (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients) für die kommerzielle und klinische Versorgung.

Die Möglichkeit

• Als User-Vertreter in technischen Projekten sind Sie für die Produktionsanlagen von der Planung bis zur Inbetriebnahme verantwortlich.

• Sie planen und koordinieren Werkstattarbeiten wie Revisionen, Umbauten und die Behebung von Störungen.

• Sie optimieren, entwickeln innovativ weiter und harmonisieren technische Lösungen innerhalb der Manufacturing Unit.

• Sie arbeiten bei der Erstellung von technischen Risikoanalysen sowie bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Validierungsaktivitäten mit.

• Sie sind zuständig für die Kosten-Nutzen-Analyse und die Beantragung der finanziellen Mittel für Projekte.

• Sie führen anlagen- und prozessspezifische Schulungen für die Mitarbeiter durch und erstellen und prüfen SOPs für die Anlagen.

• Sie arbeiten konstruktiv mit anderen Abteilungen und externen Lieferanten zusammen.

Wer du bist

• Sie verfügen über einen Hochschulabschluss oder sind ein erfahrener Produktionsexperte mit abgeschlossener Berufsausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich der pharmatechnologischen Herstellung oder einem verwandten Gebiet.

• Sie besitzen ein sehr gutes GMP-Verständnis sowie ein hohes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein.

• Sie haben Erfahrung mit hochautomatisierten Anlagen im Produktionsmaßstab und ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an technischen Aspekten der Produktion.

• Sie zeigen eine hohe Motivation, Flexibilität und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise in einem komplexen Umfeld.

• Sie verfügen über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità.

La Posizione À Bâle, 650 employés travaillent dans la région de la Fabrication de substances médicamenteuses, produisant des IPA (ingrédients pharmaceutiques actifs) aux fins commerciales et cliniques. La Possibilità - En tant que représentant dans les projets techniques, vous êtes responsable des installations de production de la planification à la mise en service. - Vous planifiez et coordonnez les activités de recherche d'atelier comme révisions, modifications et dépannage. - Vous optimisez, innover et harmoniser les solutions techniques au sein de l'unité de fabrication. - Vous travaillez sur l'analyse technique des risques, la planification et la mise en œuvre d'activités de validation. - Vous êtes responsable de l'analyse coûts-avantages et de l'application des ressources financières pour les projets. - Vous fournissez une formation sur les plans et les processus aux employés et créez des SOP d'examen pour les installations. - Vous coopérez avec d'autres services et fournisseurs externes. Chis - Vous avez un diplôme universitaire ou êtes un expert de production expérimenté avec une formation professionnelle complète, idéalement dans la production technologique pharmaceutique ou un domaine connexe. - Vous avez une très bonne compréhension des BPF et une grande connaissance de la qualité et de la sécurité. - Vous avez l'expérience d'installations hautement automatisées à l'échelle industrielle et un fort intérêt pour les aspects techniques de la production. - Vous montrez une forte motivation, flexibilité et travail indépendant dans un environnement complexe. - Vous avez de très bonnes compétences en langue allemande et anglaise dans la parole et l'écriture. Contatto Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant pour découvrir cette opportunité passionnante! Chi siamo Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 personnes à travers le monde sont dédiées à la promotion de la science, la garantie a accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions au plus haut niveau, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche è un datore di lavoro che offre uguali opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns bewegt, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft ständig voran und sorgen dafür, dass alle Menschen heute und in Zukunft Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung haben, die sie brauchen. Eine Welt zu schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben – das ist es, was uns zu Roche macht.

Im Bereich R&D an unserem Standort Mannheim bist Du Teil eines hochinnovativen, interdisziplinären Teams. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an der Entwicklung zukunftsweisender Sensoren für das kontinuierliche Glukosemonitoring (CGM). In dieser Schlüsselposition bringst Du Deine Expertise in der Chemie und Biophysik ein, um das Leben von Millionen Menschen mit Diabetes nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Die Möglichkeiten

• Entwicklung & Design: Du verantwortest eigenverantwortlich die Planung und chemische Formulierung sowie das Design von elektrochemischen Sensoren zur Messung diabetesrelevanter Parameter im Rahmen globaler Entwicklungsprojekte.

• Qualitäts- & Schnittstellenmanagement: Du erstellst Material-, Prozess- und Prüfspezifikationen für chemische Einsatzstoffe im regulierten Umfeld und stimmst Dich eng mit Schnittstellen wie der Produktion und der Messtechnik ab.

• Lieferantenbetreuung: Du identifizierst strategische Lieferanten für Roh- und Einsatzstoffe und betreust diese kompetent bei komplexen technischen sowie physikochemischen Fragestellungen.

• Zukunftsorientierung: Du hast aktuelle wissenschaftliche und technische Entwicklungen stets im Blick und prüfst diese kontinuierlich auf ihre Anwendbarkeit in zukünftigen Produkt-Lifecycles im Sinne eines integrierten, personalisierten Diabetes Managements.

Wer bist Du

• Ausbildung: Du bringst ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes, promoviertes naturwissenschaftliches Hochschul- oder Universitätsstudium (Promotion / PhD) der Chemie oder Biophysik mit.

• Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Medizinprodukten sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Formulierung von elektrochemischen Sensoren.

• Spezialwissen: Idealerweise besitzt Du vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Polymerchemie, der Elektrochemie sowie im Bereich der Anforderungen von in-vivo -Systemen.

• Systeme & Regularien: Ein sicherer Umgang mit Dokumentenmanagementsystemen im regulierten Umfeld (z. B. ISO 13485 / GMP) ist für Dich selbstverständlich.

• Kompetenzen: Du zeichnest Dich durch hohe soziale Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke in internationalen, fachübergreifenden Teams sowie durch Leidenschaft und Motivationsfähigkeit aus.

• Sprachen: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Dein Profil ab.

Die Bewerbung:
Wir machen es Dir leichter: Bitte lade online nur Deinen aktuellen und aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf sowie das Zeugnis Deines höchsten Studienabschlusses hoch.

Wir freuen uns auf die Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing he

jobs.title: PostDoc Position in Bioorganic Chemistry (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Developing enzymes for Roche internally as well as externally means for us the development of tailor-made biocatalysts and biological targets for creating the best-in-class molecules for Roche and our clients. Combining several biotechnological methods such as expression profiling, cell cultivation, enzyme purification portfolio, enzyme engineering and biochemical investigations, we always try to improve, to maintain or to design new enzymes. Mandatory, the complete value chain as a platform thought of Roche is given. We are working cross-functional for both the diagnostic and pharma division of Roche worldwide. Being an R&D function we always try to keep close contacts with our clients as with our production for ensuring a fast, but qualitatively high development which should result in functional Roche products finally.

As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. Become part of an innovative research team that consolidates a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab to develop customized enzymes for our diagnostics. We offer you a unique opportunity to translate your scientific ideas into practice and thus contribute to the improvement of patient health.

The opportunity

• You ensure the development of new enzymes using a combination of biotechnological and bioinformatic methods

• You are responsible for the independent production of tailored proteins/enzymes using molecular biological methods or the establishment of new production and screening methods for protein variants

• You support the consolidation of a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab, suitable for the protein engineering of novel enzymes

• You implement new biochemical and biophysical readouts suitable for the screening and development of tailored enzymes

• You pursue scientific and technical education by continuously following and reading the relevant scientific literature

Who you are

• You possess a university degree (Dr. / Ph.D.) in a relevant field

• You have specialized knowledge in the areas of protein engineering, bioinformatics, and molecular biology

• Experience in microbiology, downstream and upstream processing, as well as chemistry, is an advantage

• You demonstrate knowledge and expertise in recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and the development of protein analytical methods for protein characterization

• You are willing to provide consultation and troubleshooting regarding enzyme challenges in Research & Development and Production

This position is limited to 2 years.

Application documents
To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only a motivation letter and your updated CV . References and certificates are not required at this stage.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Marketing Intern (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Starte deine Karriere im Marketing mit einem 12-monatigen Praktikum bei Roche Diagnostics – und erlebe, wie vielfältig und sinnstiftend es ist, Innovationen im Gesundheitswesen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Das Praktikum ist als Vollzeitstelle ausgeschrieben.

Was dich erwartet:

• Vollständige und eigenständige Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von kleineren Projekten (z.B. Marketing-Kampagnen, Newsletter Design & Erstellung, Social-Media & Website Updates, Erstellung von Landing Pages)

• Unterstützung der Marketing Manager:innen bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Nachbereitung von komplexen Marketing-Projekten (z.B.: Omnichannel-Kampagnen, Webinar-Kampagnen)

• Kontakt und Steuerung von Agenturen und internen Stakeholdern

• Pflege und Aktualisierung von Marketing-Tools

• Freigaben von Marketingmaterialien

Wer du bist:
Damit du bei uns aktiv mitgestalten kannst, bringst du Eigeninitiative, Teamgeist und eine gute Portion Organisationstalent mit – genauso wie Kreativität und sichere Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch. Außerdem sind folgende Qualifikationen von Vorteil:

• Erste Erfahrungen im Marketing, vorzugsweise durch Berufserfahrung oder mehrere Praktika (bspw. in Medien- /Marketingagenturen oder inhouse Marketing-Abteilungen) sind von Vorteil

• Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium mit Schwerpunkt Marketing / Digitale Medien (bevorzugt), oder Kommunikation

• Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Marketing-Tools wie Social Media Ads, Google Ads, Marketing-Automation, CMS-Plattformen sowie Design-Tools (z. B. Canva).

• Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und mit Datenauswertungen ist von Vorteil

• Verständnis für grafisches Design, UX/UI Kenntnisse

Es erwartet Dich ein Jahresgehalt ab 37.000€ brutto (auf Vollzeitbasis), sowie attraktive Benefits. Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Betriebsrestaurant, betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung und vielfältige Sportangebote sind nur einige davon. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Partner Business Excellence
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love
Purpose
The purpose of this position is to actively promote Roche DIA product under responsibility to all targeted HCP/Labs. To ensure that all activities are in accordance with the SOP standards & to achieve all set sales budgets of all assigned products on cycle basis. The Position is responsible for sales and profitability objectives from existing and new accounts or clients

Your Opportunity
Sales Management

• Achievement of monthly/quarterly/yearly sales targets.

• Stock/expiry monitoring at institutional, customer and distributor levels.

• Implementation of marketing strategies and plans.

• Prospecting and developing new client relationships within a defined geography or market

• Build & maintain strong & credible relationships with HCP(s).

• Visit HCP(s) to collect market feedback and build product advocacy.

• Continuously improve the product, disease, market knowledge and promotion skills through self-reading and attending all products, marketing and medical training as assigned by the Management.

• To achieve all the agreed timelines planned for the assigned official tasks.

• Effective & productive database sales call

• Corporate image building with ethics and behaviour.

• In-Dept knowledge of HCPs, Customers, and accounts profile of his territory & update when required

• Focus on developing non-users HCP, customer and accounts

• Preparation/recommendations for tender business

• Maintaining existing accounts

• Regular reporting on day to day activities

• Additional tasks assigned by the management from time to time

Performance Management

• Align with supervisor to set mutually agreed objectives and tasks.

Resource Utilization

• Strive to the best for utilization of resources provided in the best interest of the business-like; data, team & financial resources etc.

Team Coordination

• Interdepartmental & intradepartmental coordination & collaboration to achieve overall business objectives

Additional Responsibilities

• Employees are expected to perform their duties to the benefit of the company, using common sense and the best of their knowledge. They are personally responsible for SHE in line with their know-how, skill and experience. They are required to learn and follow all programs, procedures and instructions relating to SHE, to report unsafe conditions or acts and to inform their line managers/supervisors if they are uncertain or unable to deal with a particular situation.

• It is mandatory for all employees to always display the company badge when inside the office, highlight or if necessary, stop or report the unauthorized movement to the site security officer.

• Comply with all applicable guidelines of Symphony, compliance and PRI/PSI

Who you are

• University degree (in science / related field/Lab) or

• Marketing degree with an aptitude for medical/technical information

Experience and knowledge

• Minimum 3-5 years of sales experience

• Understanding of the Diagnostic Industry

• Product Knowledge

• Market Knowledge

• Computer Literate (especially Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word & Microsoft PowerPoint).

• Sales Data Analysis

Competencies

• Roche Leadership Competencies:

Job Specific Competencies

• Outstanding written and oral communication skills

• Superior business and negotiation skills

• Extensive industry contacts

• Ability and willingness to travel

• Negotiation & Influencing skills

• Teamwork

• Organization and planning skill

jobs.title: Patient Safety Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose

Support the implementation, maintenance and oversight of the local PV system for the assigned affiliate(s)/country(ies), to ensure an efficient and effective PV system that complies with global Roche and local legal/regulatory authority PV requirements, safeguarding our License to Operate.
Support the execution of IPS & Affiliate’s Patient Safety (APS) strategies, ensuring high-quality implementation of global and local safety solutions, while demonstrating leadership in ownership, collaboration, and decision-making within assigned responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

PV System

• Execution of safety-related activities relevant to the PV (Pharmacovigilance) system through partnership with key stakeholders such as Patient Safety Operations and Affiliate PV Net, to ensure monitoring of the safety profile of Roche products and their safety risk management, meeting regulatory requirements, and ensuring license to operate. Proactively identify opportunities to optimize the PV system.

Key areas of activities include the following in line with Roche standard operating procedures (where applicable):

• Individual Case Safety Reports (e.g. data collection)

• Signal Detection & Signal Management for Local Products

• Aggregate safety reports (e.g. submission to Health Authority)

• Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. PVA, Safety Data Exchange Agreement)

• Risk Management and Safety Communication (e.g., Direct Healthcare Professional Communication, Risk Minimization Measures, emerging safety issues)

• Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., ICT, NIS, PASS, PAES, MAP, PAA, CUP, PTAP, Dicela)

• Safety Labeling and PV Commitments

• (Local) Pharmacovigilance System Master File

• As a contributor, shape country PV regulations and the broader country pharmacovigilance ecosystem according to APS grouping, particularly to promote regulatory reliance and international harmonization in partnership with (including but not limited to) local pharma industry associations, healthcare organizations, patient groups etc. (e.g. simplification of local implementation of aRMM together with trade associations and HA).

Local Safety Risk Management (according to APS grouping)

• Identify, analyze and share safety insights by understanding disease areas (Roche portfolio, patient journey), engaging with key stakeholders, and ensuring timely, proactive integration into Affiliate and global strategies.

• Implementation of safety solutions and launch readiness activities: Implement global safety solutions locally within the integrated therapeutic strategy, and execute product safety launch readiness activities.

• Risk management and safety communication: Support the country-level risk management strategy to optimize patient outcomes in collaboration within relevant networks and ensure compliant and transparent PV communications (e.g., DHPCs) to healthcare professionals, patients, and external partners in collaboration with Medical Affairs and the cross-functional team.

Further responsibilities may include assuming additional roles (e.g. RMP IC, core or extended member of the Affiliate Safety Disease Area Communities (ASDACs), Safety Responsible for MAP and DiCELA, Disease Area Expert, PV System Expert).

Who you are:

Education/Qualifications

• Qualification and/or Degree in life science or healthcare-related discipline (e.g., PharmD, MSc, BSc, Nursing, etc.).

Experience

• Proven experience in pharmacovigilance, ideally in an affiliate setting

•

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Payroll, Time and Benefits Senior Team Lead

What we do:
The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We work closely together as a team to ensure strong employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

Your day to day responsibilities:
As a Payroll Time & Benefits Team Lead, you are responsible for leading a Payroll Time & Benefits Operations (PTB) team across multiple countries (a country cluster) and performing all people leadership activities in line with Roche People Practices. You will ensure local PTB performance targets are met at both the team and individual levels, and that regular operations reviews are held internally, as well as externally with relevant stakeholders.

As a Qualified Lead you are:

• Leading and managing the Payroll Time and Benefits Operations (PTB) team by delivering best services and solutions towards the clients.

• Ensuring delivery of services in accordance with agreed performance levels (KPI) and in line with legal/regulations (compliance), continuously driving improvement activities/projects (simplification, standardization, automation) for service excellence and consistent customer experience.

• Working in line with overall People Support Solutions strategy, seeking better/creative solutions to support business needs as well as leveraging advanced technology to continually drive teamwork efficiency and enhance customer experience.

• Leading and facilitating people processes in line with Roche Leadership commitments, People Practices and policies, Roche values.

• Role Modeling our people practices, ensuring that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions.

• Developing team member’s knowledge, skills, capabilities in line with the Roche People Practices to retain and develop talented staff.

• Driving employee retention, engagement and talent management.

• Creating a safe and positive team culture and environment, ensuring the team is demonstrating the right mindset and attitude (trust, growth mindset, customer centricity, E2E accountability, problem solving).

• Ensuring consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced, maintaining strong customer satisfaction within the area of responsibility, pro-actively providing feedback/inputs to stakeholders from a service perspective.

• Setting and monitoring team working plan, resource allocations, workload.

• Seeking, identifying and driving continuous service and process improvement (in terms of standardization, automation, and simplification), and service enhancement based on monthly performance, customer feedback.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, you will ensure that Roche’s people practices work seamlessly for the business by managing the end-to-end execution of payroll, tax, and social insurance. You will play a vital role in providing advisory support and maintaining data integrity while keeping customer-focused principles at the heart of every interaction.

• Execute end-to-end payroll activities , including data maintenance for tax, social insurance, and local/global benefits administration with high accuracy.

• Provide expert customer service by resolving complex inquiries, managing requests, and troubleshooting issues related to pay, time, and benefits.

• Oversee time and absence management , collaborating with managers to ensure compliance with local policies and accuracy in employee records.

• Manage technical data flows , monitoring Workday integrations and processing mass upload files to ensure vendor accuracy and timely processing.

• Ensure regulatory compliance across various countries and jurisdictions, keeping up-to-date with evolving legal requirements and internal documentation.

• Foster key stakeholder relationships , partnering proactively with P&C Chapters and providing guidance to first-level support teams to enhance service delivery.

• Drive continuous improvement by participating in global projects and implementing initiatives to optimize performance and service quality.

Who You Are
You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for customer centricity. You thrive in fast-paced, multicultural environments and take full accountability for delivering consistent, high-quality results across borders.

• Professional Experience: You bring 1–3 years of experience in payroll services and benefits administration , ideally within a Shared Service Center environment.

• Language Skills: You are fluent in German and English

• Technical Proficiency: You have advanced Excel skills (v-lookup, pivot tables) and a solid understanding of the payroll cycle and HR processes.

• Analytical Ability: You have an excellent eye for detail and can navigate complex data structures to resolve errors and ensure accuracy.

• Matrix Collaboration: You have a proven track record of delivering results in a matrix organization and are comfortable working independently with competing priorities.

• Solution Orientation: You demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, utilizing active listening and critical thinking to drive process improvements.

• Growth Mindset: You are adaptable to change, enjoy learning new tools (such as Workday or ServiceNow), and thrive in ambiguous situations.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• Exécuter de bout en bout des activités de paie, y compris la maintenance des données pour l'impôt, l'assurance sociale, et l'administration des prestations locales/mondiales avec une grande précision.
• Fournir un service à la clientèle expert en résolvant les demandes complexes, en gérant les demandes et en dépannant les problèmes liés à la rémunération, au temps et aux avantages.
• Superviser la gestion du temps et de l'absence, collaborer avec les gestionnaires pour assurer le respect des politiques locales et l'exactitude des dossiers des employés.
• Gérer les flux de données techniques , surveiller les intégrations Workday et traiter les fichiers de téléchargement de masse pour assurer l'exactitude du fournisseur et le traitement en temps opportun.
• Assurer le respect de la réglementation dans divers pays et juridictions, en tenant compte de l'évolution des exigences juridiques et de la documentation interne.
• Favoriser les relations avec les principaux intervenants, établir des partenariats proactifs avec les chapitres sur les P et C et fournir des conseils aux équipes de soutien de premier niveau pour améliorer la prestation des services.
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue en participant à des projets mondiaux et en mettant en œuvre des initiatives visant à optimiser les performances et la qualité des services. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel axé sur les détails avec une forte mentalité analytique et une passion pour la centricité des clients. Vous prospèrez dans des environnements multiculturels et rapides et vous êtes pleinement responsable de la prestation de résultats cohérents et de haute qualité au-delà des frontières.
• Expérience professionnelle: Vous apportez de 1 à 3 ans d'expérience dans les services de paie et l'administration des prestations, idéalement dans un environnement de centre de services partagés.
• Compétences linguistiques: Vous maîtrisez couramment l'allemand et l'anglais
• Compétence technique : vous avez des compétences Excel avancées (v-lookup, tables pivotantes) et une bonne compréhension du cycle de paie et des processus RH.
• Capacité d'analyse : Vous avez un excellent œil pour les détails et pouvez naviguer dans des structures de données complexes pour résoudre les erreurs et assurer l'exactitude.
• Collaboration matricielle : Vous avez fait la preuve de vos résultats dans une organisation matricielle et vous êtes à l'aise de travailler indépendamment avec des priorités concurrentes.
• Orientation à la solution: Vous démontrez de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, en utilisant l'écoute active et la pensée critique pour conduire à des améliorations de processus.
• Growth Mindset: Vous êtes adaptable au changement, profitez de l'apprentissage de nouveaux outils (comme Workday ou ServiceNow), et prospèrez dans des situations ambiguës. En échange, nous vous fournissons:
• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constantes, des cours de langues et de formation gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position interne et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière.
• Excellents avantages: Forfait de salaire et de cafétéria compétitif, bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, possibilité de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances.
• Flexibilité : Nous soutenons également la flexibilité pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre. Le bureau à domicile est généralement disponible (habituellement 2 jours/semaine en moyenne). Nous créons l'occasion de la liberté dans le travail, où votre vie privée et d'entreprise coexistent en harmonie.

titleByLocale.en: Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery
titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe PT Insights & Data Delivery

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery (Product Manager) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.
Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Description of the area
PT Insights and Data Delivery focuses on the reliable delivery of high quality data combined with the use of data in analytics solutions for both existing and anticipatory business needs with a cross-functional scope and mandate.
The role will lead a team of over 20 people to bring the following key benefits to PT

• Reusable and scalable systems that are efficiently operated

• Faster and more robust solutions to meet business challenges

• Reliable delivery of key metrics and performance indicators

• Identifying areas for cost savings and where to invest

• Data/evidence driven decisions

• Process enabling efficient maintenance of reliable enterprise data

The role will need knowledge and experience in the following areas
Analytics excellence for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality

• Supports business process from Make, Assess to Release

• GMP and Non-GMP Reporting

• Different Levels of Views (Helicopter vs Front Line)

• Enhanced Business Planning

• Self service reporting

• Reducing workload for knowledge workers

• Drive towards actionable insights

• Reliable key performance indicators and metrics

• Comparison across manufacturing sites

Data Delivery for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality

• Reliable and high quality delivery of core manufacturing, supply chain and quality dataDevelopment and support of FAIR data pipelines and data products across PT

• Efficient and reliable DataOps

• Brings together information from multiple systems, so that interdependencies between data can be managed and resolved

Job Responsibilities

• Strategy & Vision
Accountable for setting the direction for a product and ensuring that it achieves defined outcomes and financial objectives. Defines product strategy, roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user needs and organisational policies. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.

• Customer-Centricity
Actively collect, understand, and prioritize the needs of internal users. Act as the primary owner of the “customer's” problem and be responsible for defining and delivering a solution that provides tangible value. Define and track key metrics related to user satisfaction, engagement, and value delivery, and use this data to inform product iterations.

• Product Lifecycle Mgmt.
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, guide its development, and manage its gro

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Payroll, Time & Benefits Team focuses on payroll, benefits, absence management, customer service and advisory support to employees, manager and business partners ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.

The Opportunity
As a Payroll Time Benefits Specialist - French speaking , you are responsible for payroll, time, benefits data maintenance and administrative activities in a timely and accurate manner. You are also contributing to the continuous improvement of the People Support Solutions delivery. This is coupled with strong customer focus, communication skills and solution orientation.

• Performing a variety of payroll, time and benefits administrative and analytical activities in support of the EMEA countries/affiliates and serving as a Tier 2 point of contact for all payroll, time & benefits customer inquiries

• Interpreting People & Culture policies and practices for EMEA payroll administration and ensuring Roche local time & absence policies are met

• Providing timely responses to customer payroll inquiries by using an internal case management system and proactively identifying and troubleshooting payroll issues to determine root cause and solutions for resolution

• Analyzing multiple payroll audits during processing to ensure accuracy and validity and corresponding with managers and leaders to confirm accuracy of employee time & absence entry

• Managing, processing and reconciling mass upload files for all pay frequencies and supporting inquires resolution, escalating requests to the appropriate resources as necessary

• Monitoring data flows to/from Workday to Vendor for accuracy and ensuring integrations are processed timely and resolving any errors ensuring accurately processed

• Analyzing and controlling payroll processes, accruals and employer obligations for EMEA countries and actively participating in the development and implementation of continuous improvement initiative

​
Who you are

• We are seeking an individual with 2+ years of experience in payroll services, in a shared service center environment preferably

• Strong communication skills in English and French (written and spoken) is essential.

• High learning agility on different payroll country practice and able to provide remote support in payroll, time, benefits administration operations with timely manner

• Excellent attention to detail and analytical ability

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot table, v-lookup, etc.)

​
In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average. We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
